jd:
B usiness Function
Technology and Operations (T&O) enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and innovation. In T&O, we manage the majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels.
Job Objectives
The T&O COO Office plays a critical role in enhancing the Bank's focus on enterprise-wide risk management, driving firm-wide strategic initiatives in procurement and business continuity preparation, and fostering workforce engagement and development ready for digital transformation across our operational functions. This department is central to maintaining a robust control environment and adapting to the evolving regulatory landscape.
This role will lead the convergence of Operational Risk Management and Technology Risk Management. The team is dedicated to driving effective operational risk management in the digital age, utilizing a consistent operational risk control framework that leverages advanced data analytics. This includes overseeing risk governance forums and implementing improvement programs across all operational functional levels. The TRM function focuses on proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating technology-related risks across the organization, ensuring the resilience and security of our technology landscape, including emerging technologies such as Generative AI and Public Cloud. This role will also oversee the New Product Approval team, ensuring a streamlined and rigorous risk assessment process for all new offerings.
Responsibilities
As Team Head of Technology and Operational Risk Management, you will be responsible for providing strategic leadership and executive oversight, encompassing the following:
Strategic Leadership & Risk Culture Champion:
Formulate and execute a comprehensive strategy for Technology and Operational Risk Management within the HK T&O unit, aligning with group-level objectives and regulatory expectations
Act as the primary champion for the risk culture agenda across the HK T&O unit, fostering a strong, proactive, and embedded risk-aware mindset among all staff
Lead and inspire both the Operational Risk Management and Technology Risk Management teams, setting strategic direction, empowering staff development, and ensuring high performance
Represent HK T&O at all major local and regional risk forums, committees, and regulatory engagements, effectively communicating the unit's risk posture and mitigation strategies
Drive the continuous enhancement of the risk management framework, policies, and procedures across both operational and technology domains, ensuring alignment with industry best practices and evolving regulatory requirements (e.g., HKMA's TM-E-1, TM-G-1, SA-2, C-RAF)
Operational & Technology Resilience:
Lead the development and implementation of robust operational resilience frameworks, encompassing both technology and non-technology risks, with a strong emphasis on third-party risk management and critical business services
Oversee the end-to-end management of third-party risk, including due diligence, ongoing monitoring, and incident response, ensuring the resilience of critical services outsourced to vendors
Drive initiatives to identify, assess, and mitigate technology risks across various domains, including Site Reliability Engineering, Emerging Technology (e.g., Generative AI, Public Cloud), in partnership with Group and Local Technology, Cybersecurity and Risk Management functions
Develop and implement proactive strategies for managing and enhancing the resilience of critical banking services, ensuring business continuity and minimal disruption during unforeseen events
Oversee the investigation, analysis, and advisory on significant risk events and material technology incidents, ensuring root causes are identified and effective mitigation strategies are implemented
Risk Governance & Oversight:
Provide executive oversight and strategic guidance for the unit's Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) programme, ensuring thorough risk identification, assessment methodologies, and effective control implementation across both operational and technology landscapes
Direct the collation, monitoring, and comprehensive reporting of Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) for the unit, providing insightful analysis and actionable recommendations to senior management and risk committees
Lead the New Product Approval team, streamlining processes and ensuring comprehensive risk assessments are conducted for all new products and services in close collaboration with BU/SU stakeholders
Ensure timely coordination and completion of all operational and technology risk-related regulatory submissions, compliance reviews, and audit engagements
Oversee the tracking and monitoring of risk issues and the completion status of corrective actions, holding relevant teams accountable for timely remediation
Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory:
Cultivate strong relationships with senior leaders across Operations units, Technology teams, Business Units, and Support Units to embed risk management practices and foster a collaborative risk culture
Provide expert technology and operational risk subject matter guidance and advisory to T&O and line of business teams, supporting strategic initiatives and change management
Engage proactively with technology stakeholders to identify detailed and technical risks, ensuring effective remediation activities and continuous improvement of the IT risk posture
Liaise effectively with legal and compliance, internal and external auditors, regulators, and regulatory agencies on risk and compliance reviews pertaining to T&O activities
Provide guidance on operational and technology risk management best practices, emerging risks, and regulatory changes to the unit and relevant stakeholders
Requirements
Experience & Leadership:
Demonstrated progressive experience in risk management within a financial services or banking environment at senior leadership role overseeing both operational and technology risk functions
Proven track record of strategic leadership, team management, and influencing senior stakeholders in a complex organizational structure
Demonstrated expertise in managing operational risk and technology risk in a large-scale financial institution, with comprehensive knowledge and experience in operational processes, controls, and technology infrastructure
Extensive experience in regulatory engagement and a deep understanding of regulatory requirements, particularly those set forth by the HKMA (e.g., TM-E-1, TM-G-1, SA-2, C-RAF)
Technical & Domain Expertise:
Strong understanding of Information Security, System Resiliency & Availability, Software Development practices and frameworks
In-depth knowledge of emerging technologies such as Generative AI and Public Cloud, and their associated risks
Expertise in developing and implementing frameworks for governance, risk, and control, as well as operationalizing processes and procedures
Proficiency in risk assessment methodologies, including RCSA, KRI development, and incident management
Demonstrated experience in managing third-party risk and ensuring the resilience of critical business services
Education & Certifications:
Degree holder (or equivalent) in Risk Management, Information Systems, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline
Relevant professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ECF-ORM are highly advantageous

Superior communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and collaborate effectively with diverse cross-functional teams and senior executives
Proven ability to foster and lead a strong risk culture, driving awareness and accountability across the organization
High integrity, professional work practice, and a strong commitment to ethical conduct
Ability to be competent people manager capable of handling multiple priorities and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

title: Production Assistant
teaser: Fashion company Production Assistant to support the full production lifecycle from product development through to bulk production and delivery.
jd:
About SAU LEE
SAU LEE is a modern Chinese fashion brand redefining femininity through contemporary design inspired by Chinese culture. Since launching in 2014, we have grown into a global business stocked by leading retailers including REVOLVE, Nordstrom, Bloomingdale’s and Ounass. Our designs have been worn by Lady Gaga, Jessica Alba, Olivia Culpo, Gemma Chan, Barbara Palvin, Joey King, Lana Condor and Laufey.
Following another year of significant growth, we are entering an exciting new chapter with our first retail store opening in New York, continued global wholesale expansion and further investment across our product categories.
As our collections and production volumes continue to grow, we are expanding our Production team to strengthen our product development, manufacturing and quality capabilities.
About This Role
We are looking for an organised, detail-oriented and technically capable Production Assistant to join our growing Production team.
Reporting to the Production Manager, you will support the full production lifecycle from product development and purchase orders through to bulk production and final delivery. You will work closely with factories, suppliers and internal teams to ensure products meet our quality standards and delivery schedules.
This is a hands-on role for someone with practical garment production experience, strong technical knowledge and the confidence to independently follow up with factories and suppliers.
Key Responsibilities
Product Development & Production
Support the full production lifecycle from product development and purchase orders through to bulk production and delivery.
Follow up on development, fit, pre-production and production samples, ensuring comments and approvals are completed on schedule.
Track production against critical paths and flag potential delays, quality issues or production risks.
Maintain accurate purchase orders, production records, order summaries and supporting documentation.
Factory, Quality & Technical
Coordinate directly with factories and suppliers on sampling, production status, workmanship, quality and delivery schedules.
Conduct workmanship and construction checks against approved specifications and quality standards.
Identify production or quality issues and work with the Production Manager and factories to resolve them.
Communicate comments, approvals and corrective actions clearly to suppliers and follow through to completion.
Maintain and upload accurate sample, quality and production information.
Production Operations
Coordinate sample and parcel movements between SAU LEE, factories and suppliers.
Work closely with Design, Merchandising and Logistics to support smooth product handovers and deliveries.
Support improvements to production processes, documentation and ways of working.
Travel occasionally to factories and suppliers in Mainland China when required.
Support other production-related projects and responsibilities as required.
About You
Diploma or Higher Diploma in Fashion, Textiles, Clothing, Merchandising or a related discipline.
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in garment production, apparel merchandising or manufacturing.
Good technical understanding of garment construction and the production process from sample development through to bulk production.
Practical experience working directly with garment factories and suppliers.
Good understanding of workmanship and garment quality standards.
Proactive, organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple styles, deadlines and priorities.
Confident communicating with factories and following issues through to resolution.
Able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Good command of spoken and written English and Chinese.
Willing to travel occasionally to Mainland China.
Nice to Haves
Experience within contemporary, premium or luxury womenswear.
Experience with occasionwear, dresses, tailoring or technically detailed garments.
Knowledge of different fabrics, trims, embellishments and garment construction techniques.
Experience managing multiple seasonal collections or a high volume of styles.
Experience with ERP, PLM or other production management systems.
Strong Excel skills and experience with production trackers or critical paths.
Mandarin and/or Cantonese proficiency for direct factory communication.

title: Product Manager / Builder
location: Lai Chi Kok, Sham Shui Po District
teaser: Job opportunity for autonomous builders who own decisions end-to-end, fix their own specs, and unite product with design.
bullet_points: 0–4 years (T1: 0–2; T2: 1–4) experience
Direct with management
Builder mode
jd:
What you’ll own
Every product decision for your surface area. Flows, states, edge cases, copy, sequencing, and what ships first versus what gets cut — decided by you, inside an agreed scope and metric.
The design. You design your own flows and screens. We care about the design itself, not the tool — Figma, HTML, or anything else is fine. On first-run, brand-carrying, or payment surfaces our design team works alongside you; the work stays yours. And you can ask our designers to look at anything, any time, for any reason — early on we expect you to ask often.
Talking to users. BNS has no UXR function — PMs own user research end-to-end. Interviews, surveys, and testing what you built with people who actually use it.
Defending your decisions to management. Directly, in the room.
Shipping narrow. Solve the real problem for real users now — don’t build for every future case. Ship the narrow thing, learn from it, and let engineering generalise whatever survives. Say plainly in your spec where it’s deliberately narrow and what would break if we stretched it.
What you won’t own: how it’s built. API contracts, call order and state transitions, scaling and performance sit with engineering.
>
Requirements:
0–4 years (T1: 0–2; T2: 1–4) — and zero is a real number here. If you’ve owned product outcomes end-to-end, show us. If you haven’t held the title yet, show us the closest thing you have owned end-to-end: a research project, a product you designed, an analysis someone acted on.
You design — and this is the one that doesn’t flex. You can produce flows and screens complete enough that an engineer builds from them without interpreting. We look at the design itself: not the file format, and not where you learned it. We’re firm here because the design handoff is the part of our process that already works, and we’re not willing to regress it.
You settle edge cases before handoff, not during implementation. If a flow has four failure states, all four are in the spec.
Direct with management. You can take a decision into a room with senior stakeholders, defend it with evidence, and change your mind in public when the evidence says so.
You talk to users yourself — and you do it without being asked to.
Builder mode — a hard bar here, not a bonus. The “/ Builder” in the title is the job:
You prototype your own ideas with AI tools (Claude Code, Claude Design, Figma Make, or equivalent). The bar is a clickable demo in a day, to make an idea concrete before engineering invests in it — not production-grade.
You self-serve your own data questions — funnel, retention, cohort — without queueing a request. Natural-language-to-SQL counts; hand-writing joins is not the bar.
You write a 10-row eval set for any AI feature you touch: concrete examples of what good output looks like.
And you review what AI produces rather than passing it on. That review is the part we’re hiring for.
Proficient in Cantonese, Mandarin, and English — our users, suppliers, and team move across all three.
>
Nice to have:
A design background — or a data, CS, information-systems, or analytical one. All of them feed this role well, and none is required. They tend to arrive with opposite halves: design backgrounds bring craft and flow thinking; data, CS and analytical backgrounds bring the instinct that a claim might be wrong — which is most of the “verified” bar above — and usually a head start on the builder bar. Expect us to press you hardest on the half you didn’t arrive with — bring evidence for both.
Shipping small changes yourself via PR — copy, a config value, a flag — with a reviewer. Above the bar, not at it.
Experience somewhere the design and the product decision already sat with the same person.
Growth product work, or comfort being measured partly on metrics moved.
Working with engineering teams of 3–8
>
The Opportunity for Talent:
Best fit for someone who would rather decide than escalate, who treats an unanswered question in their own spec as a defect, and who wants the design call and the product call to be the same job rather than two.
>
Buy&Ship is Hong Kong’s leading cross-border shipping platform. Hong Kong shoppers source from Japan, Korea, the US and beyond, and we’re the bridge that makes those purchases land at their door.
This role is unusual in one specific way: you own the product decision and the design, together. Not a PM who briefs a designer, and not a designer who executes someone else’s spec — one person who decides what we build, decides what it looks like, and hands engineering something complete enough to build from without coming back.
The “/ Builder” is literal, and it’s bounded. You prototype to discover — a demo that makes an idea concrete enough to put in front of someone. Production and scaling stay with engineers. You’re not hired to write the shipped code; you’re hired so that fewer wrong things get built.
We work this way because the limit on how fast we ship is no longer how fast code gets written. It’s whether the decisions upstream of the code were actually settled. When they aren’t, engineering stops and comes back — and every one of those round trips costs more than making the decision properly the first time would have.
The role is open at T1 (Associate PM, 0–2 yrs) or T2 (PM, 1–4 yrs). Apply once; we’ll set the level to your experience and capability.
If you’re graduating, or coming from data or design rather than product management — apply. We’re hiring for a profile that is genuinely new: product judgment, design, and real AI fluency in one person. The people who have that combination often haven’t held a PM title yet, and we’d rather find them than wait. What we test is whether you can do the work.

jd:
Position Overview
The ARD PM/Planning Manager – Advanced R&D & Innovation Portfolio will bridge the gap between applied innovation and practical execution. Reflecting MOMAX’s immediate strategic focus, this role shifts away from broad, long-term conceptual research to prioritize the delivery, optimization, and AI-driven evolution of our core digital platforms and hardware lines.
The ideal candidate will drive the product planning and cross-functional coordination of key applications, spearhead AI upgrades for existing product collections, and ensure the practical implementation of our signature safety and communication frameworks.
>
Key Responsibilities:
1. Digital Platform & App Product Planning
Recharge Hub (Energy Management App): Drive product planning, feature prioritization, and user experience (UX) path optimization. Act as the primary coordinator with the Shenzhen App team and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and timely delivery.
M.I.N.D (Voice Management App): Oversee product lifecycle planning, feature optimization, and cross-functional alignment to enhance the app's practical value and user engagement.
2. Product Line Evolution & AI Upgrades
AI Integration: Lead the practical intelligence upgrade of current product lines, with an immediate focus on the 1-Power (Power Bank) series, 1-World (Travel Adapter) series, and 1-Charger (Charging Socket) series.
Feature Deployment: Translate emerging AI and smart capabilities into tangible, user-centric features for consumer power products.
3. Safety & Communication Framework Alignment
Visible Safety Features: Integrate innovation planning with MOMAX’s Safety Assurance & Communication Framework .
Value Proposition Delivery: Ensure that the brand promise of "Visible Safety, Carefree Charging" ( 安全看得見、放心充) is engineered directly into product features, user interfaces, and telemetry.
4. Pragmatic Portfolio Review & Coordination
Manage a focused portfolio of immediate-to-mid-term R&D initiatives, ensuring resources are aligned with active, core projects.
Establish structured, lightweight approaches for internal alignment, project tracking, and cross-functional delivery excellence.
>
Job Requirements:
Degree: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Applied Science, Product Design Engineering, Industrial Design Engineering, Computer Science, or a related disciplined execution field.
Experience: 8+ years of experience in consumer electronics, product planning, R&D program management, or technical product management.
Proven Track Record: Direct experience in managing consumer-facing software/App lifecycles and coordinating with remote/mainland development teams (e.g., Shenzhen).
Cross-Functional Leadership: Exceptional coordination skills with the ability to sync hardware teams, software developers, and product marketers.
Execution Focus: Strong practical problem-solving abilities, shifting from high-level strategy to hands-on feature optimization and quality assurance.
Technical Familiarity: Hands-on experience in AI-related feature deployment, smart hardware integration, or IoT app ecosystems.
Communication: Excellent presentation and stakeholder management skills; fluent in communication across regional offices.
>
職位概述
高級研發與創新組合規劃經理（Planning Manager – Advanced R&D & Innovation Portfolio） 將負責填補應用創新與實際執行之間的鴻溝。因應 MOMAX（摩米士）當前的即時戰略重心，此職位將擺脫寬泛、長期的概念性研究，轉而優先推動核心數位平台與硬體產品線的交付、優化以及 AI 驅動的演進。
理想的候選人將負責核心應用程式（App）的產品規劃與跨部門協調、帶領現有產品系列的 AI 升級，並確保公司招牌的「安全與溝通框架」得以落實於實際產品中。
>
主要職責
1. 數位平台與 App 產品規劃
Recharge Hub（能源管理 App）： 主導產品規劃、功能優先順序制定及使用者體驗（UX）路徑優化。擔任與深圳 App 團隊及內部持份者（利益相關者）之間的主要協調人，以確保無縫整合與按時交付。
M.I.N.D（語音管理 App）： 負責產品生命週期規劃、功能優化及跨部門協調，以提升 App 的實用價值與使用者參與度。
2. 產品線演進與 AI 升級
AI 技術整合： 引領現有產品線的實用智能化升級，近期重點為 1-Power（行動電源）系列 、1-World（旅行轉接頭）系列 以及 1-Charger（充電插座）系列 。
功能落地部署： 將新興的 AI 與智慧功能轉化為以使用者為中心、觸手可及的消費級電源產品功能。
3. 安全與溝通框架對齊
可視化安全功能： 將創新規劃與 MOMAX 的「安全保障與溝通框架（Safety Assurance & Communication Framework）」相結合。
價值主張傳遞： 確保品牌承諾「安全看得見、放心充」直接內嵌於產品功能、使用者介面（UI）與遙測數據（Telemetry）中。
4. 務實的組合審查與協調
管理聚焦於即時至中期研發項目的投資組合，確保資源與當前的核心專案保持一致。
建立結構化、輕量化的方法，用於內部對齊、專案追蹤以及跨部門的卓越交付。
>
職位要求
學歷背景： 擁有工程學、應用科學、產品設計工程、工業設計工程、資訊科學（電腦科學）或相關執行導向領域的學士或碩士學位。
工作經驗： 8 年以上消費電子行業、產品規劃、研發專案管理或技術產品管理經驗。
成功案例： 具備管理面向消費者的軟體/App 生命週期，以及與遠端/內地開發團隊（如深圳團隊）協調溝通的直接經驗。
跨部門領導力： 具備卓越的協調能力，能夠同步硬體團隊、軟體開發人員和產品行銷人員。
執行導向： 強大的務實問題解決能力，能從高層次的戰略迅速切入到前線的功能優化與品質保證（QA）。
技術熟悉度： 在 AI 相關功能部署、智慧硬體整合或 IoT（物聯網）App 生態系統方面擁有實操經驗。
溝通能力： 出色的簡報與持份者管理技巧；具備跨區域辦公室的流利溝通能力。

Bachelor's degree or higher in Food Science, Food Technology, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
Minimum 4–6 years of solid hands-on experience in food product development (R&D) or flavor chemistry.
Direct experience working with contract manufacturers (OEM/ODM) for sauces, condiments, or liquid seasonings is highly preferred.
Proven ability to work autonomously, transition recipes from a lab bench to an industrial factory environment, and solve manufacturing anomalies directly on the production floor.
Excellent command of written and spoken English and Mandarin. Fluent Mandarin is critical for daily technical communication and on-site factory collaboration with mainland partners.

Passionate about flavor innovation, highly organized, detail-oriented, and possessing the leadership skills needed to hold external manufacturers accountable.

title: Compliance Officer (Securities, Trust and Company Secretarial Services)
teaser: This position functions as an independent and objective body that reviews and evaluates compliance issues/concerns within the organization.
jd:
This position functions as an independent and objective body that reviews and evaluates compliance issues/concerns within the organization. The position ensures the management and employees are: (i) in compliance with the rules and regulations of regulatory agencies, (ii) that Company policies and procedures are being followed, and (iii) that behavior in the organization meets the Company’s standards of conduct. This position will include the development, supervision and monitoring of compliance programs, compliance testing audit, customer complaints and resolution programs.
>
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES (include, but are not limited to)
The Compliance Officer reports to the Compliance Manager by monitoring and reporting results of the compliance/ethics issues and providing guidance for the senior management team on matters relating to compliance.
The Compliance Officer, together with the Compliance Manager, shall implement all necessary actions to ensure achievement of the objectives of an effective compliance program.
Preparing, maintaining, and updating policies and procedures for the general operation of the Company to comply with the latest laws, regulations and requirements.
Providing guidance and advice to management and employees of the Company from compliance perspective.
Collaborating with other departments of the Company to direct compliance issues to appropriate existing channels for investigation and resolution. Consulting with legal counsels as needed to resolve difficult legal compliance issues.
Responding to alleged breach or violation of rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and standards of conduct by recommending effective investigative procedures and sensible solutions.
Preparing submission to regulators including but not limited to, licensing, investigation, annual questionnaire and annual returns.
Acting as an independent review and evaluation body to ensure that compliance issues/concerns within the organization are being appropriately evaluated, investigated and resolved.
Being familiar with status of all compliance activities and able to identify trends.
Managing customer complaint process and conducting analysis on trends regarding compliance and regulatory activities.
Identifying potential areas of compliance vulnerability and risk; developing and implementing corrective action plans to tackle problematic issues, and providing guidance and advice on how to avoid or deal with similar situations in the future.
Providing work reports on a regular basis, and as directed or requested, to keep the senior management team and the Compliance Manager informed of the operation and progress of compliance matters.
Ensuring proper and timely reporting of violations or potential violations to duly authorized enforcement agencies as appropriate and/or required.
Establishing and managing a compliance “hotline” within the Company.
Raising awareness of compliance throughout the Company, and being familiar with all relevant laws, rules, regulations, guidelines, and requirements of regulators to ensure compliance.
Working with the Human Resources Department and Legal & Compliance Department as appropriate to develop an effective compliance training program, including appropriate introductory training for new employees as well as ongoing training for all employees.
Monitoring and improving effectiveness of the compliance program.
Maintaining professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, and reviewing professional publications.
Any other responsibilities as directed by the senior management team or the Compliance Manager.
>
KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS
University degree in law, accounting, finance or related disciplines.
A minimum of 2-5 years’ experience of compliance in a securities company, trust company or company secretarial firm.
Must have good understanding of securities, trust and company secretarial operations.
Must be familiar with securities, trust and company secretarial related rules and requirements for conducting regulated activities.
Familiar with operational, financial, quality assurance, internal controls procedures and regulations.
Must have the ability to safekeeping confidential information.
Must possess excellent time management skills, organizational and communication skills, both oral and written and present professional image and be strongly customer-oriented.
Must be able to plan, prioritize, delegate, and follow through to successful completion, all assignments and ability to work effectively with minimum direction and supervision.
>
BENEFITS & OTHERS:
Five-day work week
Medical & Dental Insurance
Performance Bonus
>

All information received will be used for recruitment purpose only and will be treated as strictly confidential.

A. Core Electronic Servicing Skills (Fundamental)

a. Unit level (no power, no sound, no display)
b. Module/PCB level (amplifier board, power board, signal board)
2. Use of systematic troubleshooting methods
3. Identifying recurring or design‑related faults for reporting

b. Electronic Repair & Component Replacement
1. Desoldering and soldering of components:
a. Capacitors, resistors, ICs, connectors
2. Repair of:
a. Power supply circuits
b. Audio amplification stages
c. Signal processing boards
3. PCB inspection for dry joints, burnt components, and corrosion
>
c. Use of Test & Measuring Instruments
1. Confident use of workshop tools:
a. Digital Multimeter (DMM)
b. Oscilloscope (basic audio/video waveform checking)
c. Signal generator
d. Power meters/load testers
2. Ability to interpret test results against service manuals

B. Audio / Video Product Knowledge
>
a. Audio Systems Knowledge
1. Basic understanding of:
a. Audio signal flow (input → processing → amplification → output)
b. Analog vs digital audio
c. Common audio faults (noise, distortion, imbalance, no output)
2. Familiarity with:
a. Amplifiers, soundbars, speakers, AV receivers
>
b. Video & Display Knowledge
1. Understanding of:
a. Display panels, backlight systems
b. Video signal paths (HDMI, digital processing boards)
c. Common video faults (no picture, lines, flicker, color issues)

a. Reading Technical Documents

a. Service manuals
b. Circuit diagrams

This includes strategic planning, program development and working closely with business units across front and back office functional stakeholders to implement a resiliency strategy that complies with Firm and regional regulatory requirements. The Resilience portfolio coverage includes:
Key Business Services ensure that the Firm can respond to operational disruption of its critical and important business services, and that plans/workarounds are in place to facilitate response and recovery.
Business Continuity program which is an adaptive risk-based program and methodology that ensures the Firm's business continuity capability is fit for purpose through tests and exercises in order to protect the Firm's assets, facilitate the life safety of employees, and enable operational resilience.
Third Party Resilience which establishes the proper governance, processes and controls to support the resilience of the Firm's business services where there is a reliance on external third parties.
Resilience Governance supports a robust governance across Firm Resilience programs through committee reporting, synchronizing lessons learned and continuous improvement of policies and procedures
The Resilience Testing and Exercise Program collaborates with key stakeholders to design, sequence, and deliver a series of risk-based cyber, technology, business continuity exercises and technical recovery tests to enhance operational resilience and preparedness for the

bullet_points: Newly created opportunity, grow with us!

jd:
Our Company
Vuly Play is a globally recognised, award-winning leader in outdoor play equipment, specialising in trampolines, swing sets, and monkey bars. We are committed to designing the safest, highest quality, and most fun products on the market. Headquartered in Brisbane, we operate across domestic and international markets, experiencing rapid growth and innovation.
About the Role
Provide strategic leadership, governance, and rigorous analytical oversight over Vuly Play's operational footprint globally. Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer (COO), you'll lead, coach, and hold accountable a team of Regional Operations Managers (ROMs) driving local execution across inventory planning, 3PL warehousing, fulfilment, freight, installation, systems, and customer experience. This is a hands-on, executive-level role that combines elite diagnostic capability with strategic oversight - surgically dissecting complex operational failures, isolating systemic root causes, and implementing practical, lasting solutions across our global regions.
Core Accountabilities
Lead, coach, and hold accountable a global team of Regional Operations Managers (ROMs) driving local execution across inventory planning, 3PL warehousing, fulfillment, freight, installation, systems, and customer experience
Perform deep-dive, forensic diagnosis of persistent operational bottlenecks — from 3PL pick-and-pack workflows to last-mile freight routing and inventory reconciliation — and translate findings into permanent SOPs
Guide regions through Crawl (launch), Walk (margin protection & growth), and Run (aggressive scale) phases, including WMS/ERP integration, 3PL SLA audits, and freight network optimisation
Identify, evaluate, and establish operational foundations for new international markets, including new 3PL networks and freight corridors
Protect global margins by auditing freight bills, carrier charges, and 3PL storage fees, and lead high-stakes negotiations for 3PL, freight, and carrier contracts
Enforce invoice approval and budget variance sign-off frameworks across regions
Trace customer delivery complaints back to root operational failures and direct systemic fixes across warehouse and freight vendor networks
Partner with R&D, Quality Control, Demand Planning, and Marketing to align packaging, freight cubing, and inventory levels with product and promotional plans
Act as the final internal escalation point for severe operational disruptions, presenting root-cause analysis and strategic options to the COO/CEO
Key Experience
8–10+ years of progressive operational leadership, with hands-on experience managing complex multi-site warehousing, fulfillment networks, and multi-modal global freight (ocean, air, line-haul, last-mile)
Proven track record of entering underperforming operational environments, rapidly diagnosing root causes, and deploying high-impact solutions
Deep familiarity with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Freight Management Systems (FMS), and inventory management platforms
Extensive experience negotiating 3PL and carrier contracts, setting SLAs, and auditing vendor performance
Strong financial and analytical acumen - experience managing operational P&Ls, unit-economics analysis, and forensic freight billing audits
Why Join Vuly?
Global Scope - Own the operational footprint of a fast-growing, internationally recognised brand - with full authority across fulfillment, logistics, and trading regions spanning multiple continents.
Real Impact - This is a role where diagnostic rigour translates directly into margin protection and growth - your work shapes how Vuly scales into new markets.
Great Culture - Join a passionate, energetic team global team.
Career Growth - Step into an executive-level role with a direct line to the COO/CEO, and the autonomy to build high-performing logistics networks from the ground up.
Perks - Enjoy generous staff discounts on our award-winning products so your family can get in on the fun too.
How to Apply
Please apply with your resume and/or cover letter.

title: Registered Safety Officer
teaser: A Subsidized Sale Flats Project in Yuen Long
jd:
We are looking for the following site staff who is capable of carrying out supervision and co-ordination work for a Subsidized Sale Flats Project in Yuen Long. The project include superstructure works which will commence in Sep 2026.
Registered Safety Officer
1. Purpose
1.1 Under the direct supervision of the Authorized Person (AP)/Project Architect, to distribute the duties of site safety supervision and monitoring of the AP/Architect in relation to administration, full-time supervision and inspection of on-site works. This is to ensure compliance with the requirements of the developer and adhere to established site safety and environmental standards. The below duties and responsibilities are not exhaustive and shall not be considered as a limit of responsibility.
>
2. Requirement
• Degree or Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety Management or equivalent.
• Holding a valid registration as a Registered Safety Officer (RSO).
• Not less than 5 years or above post-RSO experience in the construction field.
• Knowledge of local regulations, procedures, standards, and code of practice on construction site safety.
• Confident English report writing on health and safety issues.
• Good communication and interpersonal skills.
>
3. Responsibilities
3.1 As the employee of the AP/Project Architect and as a member of the full-time site supervisory team responsible for the supervision of the Contractors' works particularly on the site safety and environmental aspects.
3.2 Report to and advise the AP/Project Architect and notify the developer's Construction Management colleagues on the site safety and environmental aspects of the works.
3.3 As AP/Project Architect's representative on site, ensure that the Contractors' works are in compliance with contractual and statutory requirements on the site safety and environmental aspects.
3.4 Perform statutory duties as required by the AP/ Project Architect, including those relating to site safety requirements pursuant to the Supervision Plan of the Buildings Department.
>
4. Duties
(A) Site Inspection, Monitoring & Compliance
1. Carry out full-time supervision on safety and environmental aspects of all site activities.
2. Conduct daily on-site safety inspections and audits to identify risks / hazards, assess safety performance, and ensure compliance with specifications, contractual and statutory requirements. Perform re-inspections for non-conformities and recommend corrective actions. Coordinate Management Safety Inspections led by the Architect.
3. Ensure that the site activities are carried out in strict accordance with the safety management plans and environmental plans as well as contractual and statutory requirements.
4. Implement and monitor the developer's integrated quality assurance system, site safety and environmental systems on site.
5. Ensure that all statutory and daily safety records are maintained properly and are readily available for inspection. This includes ensuring contractors prepare and maintain necessary forms (e.g., SOSS Form 2A/3A) in a timely manner.
(B) Incident Investigation & Reporting
6. Investigate accidents, incidents, and near-miss occurrences, identify root causes, propose mitigation plans to prevent recurrence, and compile accident statistics.
7. Prepare bi-weekly site safety and environmental reports, inspection reports, conformity reports, site records and other necessary reports.
8. Prepare clear and proper records in writing of all events relating to the site safety and environmental aspects of the site activities and site works, including date, venue, time, direct and communication with any external parties including government authorities / adjacent owners/public/district board members/councillors/utility companies who have made any complaints on the project during construction or at the Defects Liability Period (DLP). Safe-keep and hand over this information to the AP/Project Architect and notify the developer's Construction Management colleagues as soon as possible.
(C) Communication, Coordination & Advisory
9. Coordinate with site representatives of other Consultants and the Contractors on all matters relating to the safety on construction and performance on site in mitigating and controlling risks in design, planning and execution of site works in construction stage.
10. Evaluate the Contractors' performance on site safety and environmental aspects to the AP/Project Architect.
11. Advise the AP/Project Architect, Resident Site Staff, and contractors on measures to eliminate or control hazards, and provide safety suggestions and recommendations for improving safety practices to achieve high standards in safety and health. Assist in resolving site safety and health issues.
12. Participate in Site Safety Committee Meetings and Project Safety Management Committee Meetings. Attend all Site Progress Meetings, QA/QC Meetings, Defects Rectification Meetings, Risk Management Workshops, method statement review workshops, and any other necessary meetings. Provide safety advice to stakeholders during these meetings.
13. Proactively anticipate interface and construction safety problems and liaise with contractors to determine and implement solutions to mitigate safety risks. Proactively communicate with resident site supervision team and contractors' staff to continually improve site safety.
(D) Training, Promotion & Safety Culture Development
14. Identify safety training needs for key contractor teams, subcontractor directors, and representatives, and verify the training matrix. Prepare and monitor safety training and promotion programs based on a training needs analysis. Regularly review and revise training needs, programs, and materials, and assess the quality of external training providers. Support and participate in safety promotional activities organized by contractors.
15. Drive the contractors to maintain a safe working environment and promote a culture of safety in the workplace.
16. Introduce new working procedures for safety enhancement and legislative compliance. Inform contractors of any changes in the workplace that may affect the safety and health of workers.
(E) Risk Management & Hazard Control
17. Facilitate the efficient and adequate coordination and implementation of site safety management plans and environmental plans.
18. Ensure compliance with project objectives in safety management policies/procedures and standards of the projects.
19. Proactively manage the performance of the contractors to implement safety management system ensuring the works is delivered in a safe manner.
20. Stop work and report to the AP/Project Architect if any imminent risks occur.
(F) General Supervision & Administrative Duties
21. Maintain an effective, neat, orderly, and readily accessible filing system and safe-keep all correspondence, site records and reports.
22. Carry out additional duties as required by the AP/Project Architect.
Tentative employment for the above position is to commence in September 2026 for an approx. period of 36 months with gratuity payable on satisfactory completion of the employment contract.

In October 2024, JETCO has joined as the participant in Project Ensemble and has connected to Ensemble Sandbox, as well as completed PoC by partnering with banks to testify Payment-versus-Payment (“PvP”) and Delivery-versus-Payment (“DvP”) scenarios. Support incident management activities including triage, root cause analysis, control gap identification, and corrective/preventative actions.

Provide constructive challenge and practical support to control owners to improve outcomes, balancing risk discipline with business delivery.
Identify and coordinate enhancements across GTS through collaboration with country, regional and global GTS teams.
Support delivery of relevant programmes as required (e.g., BIRO, Operational Resilience, Records Management), in line with local and Group expectations.

Experience in project management and/or coordinating multiple workstreams is an advantage.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders across Product, Operations, Technology/Change, COO and second line functions, including providing constructive challenge to control owners.
Strong written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear governance minutes, senior forum materials and concise risk narratives.
Strong analytical skills, able to interpret control testing outcomes, issue trends and MI, and translate insights into practical actions and recommendations.
Strong delivery focus and sense of ownership, with proven ability to drive actions to closure, manage dependencies, escalate appropriately, and work effectively under time pressure.
Customer/service mindset, with a focus on improving the efficiency and effectiveness of customer service processes.
Proficient in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint and Excel); experience with dashboarding/reporting tools and workflow tracking systems is an advantage.
Proficiency in both English and Chinese (written and spoken).
Great sense of ownership and servicing mindset to ensure efficient and effective customer service processes.
Professional qualifications such as Enhanced Competency Framework (ECF) and/or Certified Banker (CB) under Hong Kong Institute of Bankers (HKIB) would be an advantage.

Established in 2000, we are a well-established consultancy firm specializing in design and project management for luxury and premium clients in the APAC region. The following responsibilities apply to all roles within the design and project management streams. The depth of involvement, degree of autonomy, and leadership expectations will scale based on the candidate’s experience level.
Project Execution & Coordination: Engage in daily coordination with clients, landlords, consultants, contractors, and suppliers to ensure smooth project delivery.

Site & Schedule Management: Conduct site and factory visits, monitor construction progress, attend project meetings, and ensure timelines are met.
Reporting & Administration: Prepare meeting reports, assemble status reports, and manage necessary project administration.

Role Breakdown & Depth of Involvement
1. Entry Level (0 – 3 Years Experience)
(Roles: Project Assistant / Architectural Assistant)
Focus: Assisting, supporting, learning, and foundational preparation
Expectations: Fresh graduates and junior staff will support senior team members in executing the core responsibilities. You will actively assist in meeting preparation, such as drafting meeting minutes; drafting technical details, organizing sample boards, coordinating daily communications, and documenting site progress under direct supervision.
>
2. Mid-Level (4 – 7 Years Experience)
(Requires post-qualification experience in mid- to high-end luxury projects.)
Focus: Independent execution and specific track specialization.
Expectations: You will handle core responsibilities with minimal supervision, driving specific elements of the project based on your track:
o Project Designer: Independently handle interior layouts, spatial planning, and material sourcing to match luxury aesthetics. Preparation of presentations.
o Architectural Designer: Drive the architectural elements, structural coordination, and statutory compliance of the technical drawings.
o Assistant Design Project Manager: Independently manage project timelines, daily contractor coordination, and assist with tender process and budget tracking.
>

(Requires proven experience leading luxury and premium projects).
Focus: Project leadership, quality assurance, and client management.
Expectations: You will take full ownership of the core responsibilities from concept to handover. The Design Project Manager drives design development, technical execution, project schedules, cost control, site quality assurance, and client communication. The Project Architect shares overlapping responsibilities while leading technical troubleshooting, managing statutory or landlord approvals, and ensuring flawless design integrity across all drawings. Both roles guide and review the work of mid-level team members.
>

(Roles: Senior Project Architect / Senior Design Project Manager)
Focus: High-level operational leadership, complex project execution, and strategic mentorship.
Expectations: Building directly upon the mid-senior level, you will continue to provide hands-on leadership for daily task execution, but at a significantly higher and more complex level. You will personally drive the most intricate design developments and large-scale project rollouts across luxury and premium sectors, oversee multiple concurrent projects, negotiate major contracts, manage executive relationships with clients, and drive overarching departmental standards while mentoring junior, mid-level and mid-senior team members.

Strong communication, organization, time management, and interpersonal skills.

Proficiency in written and spoken English, Mandarin, and Cantonese.
Willingness to make necessary site visits; some traveling might be required.

jd:
About the Research Centre
In collaboration with CityU, the University of Oxford and Karolinska Institutet, the Hong Kong Centre for Cerebro-cardiovascular Health Engineering (COCHE) was established with the support of the ITC-InnoHK Programme to develop new ways to tackle cardiovascular disease (CVD), which is the world's leading cause of morbidity and mortality. To address the most pressing health challenges caused by CVD, COCHE focuses on developing innovative technologies such as flexible and wearable devices, biomedical and molecular imaging, nano-biosensing, micro-robotics, healthcare AI systems, and other ground-breaking methods to enable early prevention, diagnosis and intervention of the disease. These technologies can reduce human costs while alleviating the healthcare system's financial and social burdens. The COCHE research centre, located in Hong Kong Science Park, has several openings in research areas and administration.
Job Description:
We are seeking a highly organised and performance-oriented Assistant Manager to support the safe, efficient and reliable day-to-day operation of our research-dedicated MRI Centre. Reporting to the MRI Associate Director and MRI Associate Director and MRI Associate Head, the appointee will focus on internal operations, scanner scheduling, workflow and SOP improvement, KPI monitoring, resource coordination and service quality.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Centre Operations & Scheduling
· Coordinate daily MRI Centre operations to support safe, orderly and efficient delivery of research activities.
· Manage the central booking schedule, balancing study requirements, staffing, equipment availability, planned maintenance and operational constraints.
· Monitor scanner utilisation, downtime, cancellations, no-shows and schedule adherence, and recommend practical improvements.
· Coordinate participant flow and operational handovers while ensuring approved check-in, documentation and escalation procedures are followed.
· Maintain accurate operational records, booking data, equipment logs and supporting documentation.
2. Workflow & SOP Optimisation
· Review workflows and identify bottlenecks, recurring delays and avoidable operational risks.
· Draft, update and implement operational SOPs, checklists and work instructions under the direction and approval of the MRI Associate Director and MRI Associate Head.
· Coordinate staff training when approved workflows or SOPs are introduced or revised.
· Track corrective actions and follow through on agreed process improvements.
3. Performance & KPI Monitoring
· Maintain an operational KPI dashboard covering utilisation, downtime, cancellations, turnaround time, service quality, incidents and other agreed indicators.
· Prepare regular performance reports for the MRI Associate Director and MRI Associate Head, highlighting trends, exceptions, risks and recommended actions.
· Support operational planning by analysing demand, capacity, workload and resource requirements.
· Monitor completion of agreed actions and report delays or barriers promptly.
4. Resources, Quality & Compliance
· Coordinate staffing rosters, consumables, procurement requests, equipment servicing and vendor visits in accordance with approved procedures and budgets.

· Perform other internal operational duties assigned by the MRI Associate Director and MRI Associate Head.

· At least three years of relevant experience in research facility operations, medical imaging services, healthcare operations, clinical research administration or a related environment.
· Experience in MRI, medical imaging or a regulated healthcare or research environment is strongly preferred.

>About Us
IQ Hong Kong Ltd is a dynamic and fast-growing licensed product trading company specializing in world-class brand partnerships. We design, source, and deliver high-quality consumer products globally. We are currently expanding our portfolio focusing on licensed hardgoods , managing everything from product ideation and engineering compliance to mass production and global shipping.
>Position Overview
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Sourcing Merchandiser to join our Hong Kong team. In this role, you will be the core driver behind sourcing, developing, and managing our hardgoods categories—specifically clocks, play mats, arts & crafts, stationery, paper goods, lighting, and electronic products . You will work closely with our design, engineering, quality control, and sales teams, acting as the key bridge between our operations and our manufacturing partners.
Key Responsibilities
Category Sourcing & Vendor Management: Identify, evaluate, and onboard qualified Tier 1 and Tier 2 manufacturing partners capable of producing hardgoods, electronics, stationery, and paper goods under strict global licensor standards.
Product Development & Sampling: Coordinate the end-to-end sample development process for licensed hardgoods, ensuring prototypes meet rigorous functional, aesthetic, and safety compliance requirements.
Cost & Price Negotiation: Negotiate competitive pricing, MOQ and favorable payment terms with factories without compromising quality or delivery timelines.
Production Tracking & Quality Control: Monitor manufacturing progress from pre-production to final shipment. Collaborate with internal Quality team to manage factory audits, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and compliance testing (e.g., CE, RoHS, EN71).
Cross-Functional Coordination: Align closely with internal sales, logistics, and management teams to ensure timely product launches and smooth supply chain workflows.
Requirements & Qualifications
Experience: Minimum 5 years of solid sourcing, merchandising, or product development experience within the trading or manufacturing sector, ideally with hands-on experience handling hardgoods, electronics, stationery, or toys .
Licensing Knowledge: Prior experience working with global brand licenses and adherence to strict brand compliance guidelines is a major advantage.
Education: Degree in Supply Chain Management, Merchandising, Product Design, Business, or a related discipline.
Skills & Competencies:
Strong technical comprehension for managing mixed categories (from paper goods and electronics to plastics and lighting).
Excellent negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Fluent in written and spoken English and Cantonese, with native/business-level Mandarin (essential for factory communication in mainland China).
Proficient in MS Office and ERP/supply chain management tools.
Mindset: Well-organized, resilient under pressure, and capable of managing multiple product categories simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

title: Regional Product Manager
teaser: Manage IT distribution growth by packaging new and refurbished vendor hardware into competitive reseller solutions.
jd:
About DCSS Technology Hong Kong
>
DCSS Technology is a value-added IT distributor serving the Hong Kong and regional market. We partner with leading global technology principals — and source high-quality refurbished / certified pre-owned infrastructure — to deliver enterprise-grade solutions spanning servers, storage, and networking to a broad ecosystem of authorised resellers and system integrators.
>
Role Summary
>
We are seeking an experienced Regional Product Manager to own the commercial and technical relationship between our upstream principals (vendors) — covering both new and refurbished hardware sources — and our downstream authorised reseller channel. The successful candidate will act as the central hub that translates vendor programs, pricing, and roadmaps into competitive, ready-to-sell offerings that our partners can take to end-customers with confidence.
>
This is a channel-facing, business-development-oriented product role — ideal for someone who understands enterprise IT infrastructure deeply, thrives on deal structuring, and enjoys building win-win commercial packages on a regular cadence.
>
Key Responsibilities
>
Principal & Vendor Management
- Serve as the primary liaison with assigned principals/vendors (server, storage, and networking OEMs — new or refurbished) across the region.
- Manage relationships with both authorised OEM channels and reputable refurbished / certified pre-owned suppliers, ensuring source traceability, warranty coverage, and quality assurance for all inbound hardware.
- Maintain strong working relationships with vendor product managers, channel managers, and pre-sales teams to secure preferential pricing, rebates, MDF, SPIFFs, and program registrations.
- Stay current with each vendor's product roadmap, EOL / EOSL schedule, promotions, and certification requirements — leveraging EOL transitions as opportunities for refurbished-market plays.
- Represent DCSS in Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), joint planning sessions, and vendor enablement events.
>
Partner & Reseller Enablement
- Package vendor offerings — new, refurbished, or hybrid new+refurb configurations — into competitive bundles, promotional SKUs, and configured solutions tailored to reseller demand.
- Publish and distribute regular offer sheets, price lists, and campaign flyers to the authorised reseller network (weekly / bi-weekly / monthly cadence).
- Provide pre-sales technical guidance to resellers on product positioning, BOM configuration, sizing, and new-vs-refurbished TCO comparisons for competitive replacement plays.
- Drive reseller adoption of new products and refurbished alternatives through webinars, roadshows, and hands-on training.
>
Product & Portfolio Management
- Own the P&L and inventory strategy for assigned product lines (x86 & ARM servers, SAN/NAS/object storage, LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi/data-center switching, firewalls, etc.) across both new and refurbished tiers.
- Analyse win/loss data, pipeline coverage, and stock turn to fine-tune the product mix and grade refurbished stock (Grade A / B / C) appropriately.
- Identify portfolio gaps and recommend new vendor lines, SKUs, or refurbished sources to onboard.
- Manage demo units, evaluation hardware, NFR (Not-for-Resale) inventory, and refurbished stock aging.
- Define and enforce quality, testing, and warranty policies for refurbished inventory (e.g., burn-in testing, wipe/erase certification, DCSS-backed warranty terms).
>
Deal Support & Commercial Structuring
- Lead special bid pricing (SBP) and deal-registration submissions to principals for large or strategic opportunities.
- Structure competitive quotations that balance margin, vendor rebate qualification, refurbished cost advantage, and reseller/end-customer expectations.
- Work closely with the internal sales team to accelerate opportunities from pipeline to PO.
>
Market Intelligence
- Track competitor (distributor, OEM, and secondary-market broker) pricing, promotions, and channel programs across Hong Kong and the region.
- Monitor the secondary / refurbished market for pricing signals, supply availability, and emerging suppliers.
- Provide feedback to principals on market trends, pricing sensitivity, and product feature gaps.
>
Requirements
>
Experience
- 6+ years in product management, product marketing, business development, or channel management within IT distribution, a vendor, a value-added reseller, or a refurbished-IT specialist.
- Solid hands-on knowledge of at least two of the following categories:
- Servers: rack / tower / blade / hyperconverged (e.g., Dell PowerEdge, HPE ProLiant, Lenovo ThinkSystem, Supermicro)
- Storage: SAN, NAS, all-flash arrays, object storage, backup appliances (e.g., NetApp, Pure Storage, Dell PowerStore, HPE Alletra, Huawei OceanStor)
- Networking: switching, routing, wireless, SD-WAN, firewalls (e.g., Cisco, Aruba, Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto, H3C)
- Familiarity with the refurbished / certified pre-owned IT hardware market — including sourcing channels, grading standards, third-party maintenance (TPM) providers, and licensing/transfer implications — is highly desirable.
- Proven track record of managing a multi-million HKD product line or vendor relationship.
- Demonstrated experience running a channel / reseller program — not purely end-user sales.
>
Skills & Competencies
- Strong commercial acumen: comfortable modelling margins, rebates, refurbished cost basis, and landed cost.
- Excellent negotiation skills with both upstream vendors (OEM and secondary-market) and downstream partners.
- Ability to translate technical specs into a compelling partner-ready value proposition, including new-vs-refurbished positioning.
- Advanced Excel (pricing models, config sheets) and confident with quoting/ERP systems.
- Highly organised — can maintain a disciplined publishing cadence of offer sheets and promotions.
>
Language & Communication
- Business-level English and Cantonese required; Mandarin strongly preferred for regional partner and principal communication.
- Confident public speaker for reseller webinars and vendor pitches.
>
Education
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
- Vendor certifications (e.g., Cisco CCNA/CCNP, HPE ASE, Dell Technologies Proven Professional, Fortinet NSE, NetApp NCDA) are a strong plus.
>
What We Offer
- Competitive base salary with performance-linked bonus tied to product-line GP and vendor program achievement.
- Direct exposure to tier-1 global technology principals, the regional refurbished-IT ecosystem, and reseller partners.
- Sponsored vendor certifications and overseas training opportunities.
- Medical, MPF top-up, and standard Hong Kong statutory benefits.
- A lean, entrepreneurial team where your product decisions translate directly into channel wins.
>
How to Apply
Send your CV and a short cover note outlining
(1) the vendor lines (new and/or refurbished) you have managed,
(2) your largest deal or program win, and
(3) your expected package.

About Hong Kong Genome Institute
The Hong Kong Genome Institute (HKGI), established and wholly owned by the Hong Kong SAR Government, commenced full operations in 2021. With the vision “to avail genomic medicine to all for better health and well-being” and supported by the Health Bureau, HKGI works in close collaboration with the Department of Health, Hospital Authority, medical schools of local universities and other stakeholders to accelerate the development of genomic medicine in Hong Kong along four strategic foci: integrate genomics into medicine, advance research, nurture talents and enhance public genomic literacy.
As the first step towards achieving its vision, HKGI launched the Hong Kong Genome Project (HKGP) in 2021. As the city’s first large-scale genome sequencing project, HKGP serves as a catalyst to benefit patients and their families with more precise diagnosis and personalised treatment through whole genome sequencing. It also aims to establish genome database of the local population, testing infrastructure and talent pool to address the healthcare needs of Hong Kong in the long run.
For more information, please visit www.hkgi.org.

title: VP, Information Security and Digital Risk Management (Retail Banking)
teaser: For establishing, maintaining and enhancing governance and oversight of the Bank’s technology, information, and cyber risk domains.
bullet_points: Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of the Bank’s technology
Formulate, review and update risk management framework
Prepare and deliver regular risk reports, analyses and metrics
jd:
Job Summary:
This position reports into and supports the Head of Information Security and Digital Risk Management (ISDRM). As part of the second line under the Three Lines Model, ISDRM is responsible for establishing, maintaining and enhancing governance and oversight of the Bank’s technology, information, and cyber risk domains.
What you will be doing:
Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of the Bank’s technology, information and cyber risk management framework, in collaboration with relevant stakeholders including Group counterparts, technology teams, business and support units, and other risk management functions.
Formulate, review and update risk management framework, policies and guidelines, ensuring alignment with applicable Group standards, supervisory expectations, and industry best practices.
Act as secretariat for ISDRM-related risk management committee and working groups, and represent ISDRM at relevant Group and local risk governance meetings and forums as required.
Prepare and deliver regular risk reports, analyses and metrics (e.g. KRIs) to the Board and senior management, providing clear insights into the Bank’s overall risk posture.
Provide independent advice, support and effective challenge on technology, information and cyber risk domains associated with new products, major technology or Fintech initiatives, strategic digital transformation projects and third-party arrangements (e.g. cloud computing).
Lead or participate in thematic reviews and compliance assessments related to emerging risks (e.g. AI-enabled attacks) and regulatory requirements (e.g. facilitation of CRAF Maturity Assessment & iCAST).
Monitor and perform independent review of specific aspects of first-line risk management activities, including risk assessment and acceptance, incident response, change management processes, and the implementation of key controls or remediation actions.
Collaborate with Group counterparts to plan and deliver risk awareness, training and testing programs to enhance staff awareness and vigilance across the Bank.
Drive and oversee the implementation of Bank-wide information risk mitigation initiatives, including enhancements to data loss prevention controls, application remote access controls, and the detection and management of system access misuse.
Coordinate and facilitate internal and external audits, regulatory examinations and ongoing regulatory communications relating to technology, information and cyber risk domains.
>
Who are we looking for:
A university degree in Technology, Computer Science, Information Security, Business, Risk Management, or a related discipline.
Relevant professional certifications such as CISM, CISSP, CISA under the Enhanced Competency Framework (ECF) on Cybersecurity for a second line of defence role required.
A minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in information security, cyber / technology risk management or technology audit, gained within the financial services industry (FSI) or professional services firms serving FSI clients.
Strong risk management mindset with a solid understanding of IT environments, evolving threat landscapes, and technology/information/cyber security controls, including relevant industry standards (e.g. ISO/IEC27001) and regulatory guidelines (e.g. HKMA’s SPM TM-G-1, C-RAF).
Good communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at various levels and articulate complex risk issues clearly and confidently.
Proven ability to provide constructive challenge and influence risk-informed decision-making through practical, balanced, and commercially sound recommendations.
Demonstrates sound judgement, with the ability to prioritise issues, assess materiality, and escalate risk issues appropriately.
Self-motivated, well-organized and able to work independently while contributing effectively in a collaborative team environment.
Good command of both spoken and written English and Chinese.
Experience in conducting risk assessments, threat modelling or audits will be an advantage.
>

title: Business Analyst (Supply Chain Systems & Decision Intelligence)
teaser: This role offers an exciting chance for those passionate about creating great products and innovative solutions using cutting-edge technology.
bullet_points: 2 mins to MTR station

jd:
About the Role
We are looking for a Business Analyst who thinks from first principles , challenges assumptions, and enjoys solving complex operational problems. This role is not simply about gathering requirements or documenting processes. It is about understanding how supply chain operations truly work, how decisions are made, where operational friction exists, and how better systems can create better outcomes.
You will work at the intersection of:
Supply chain operations
Routing and planning
Operational decision-making
Product thinking
Process improvement
Automation and AI
Data and business intelligence
We are not looking for analysts who simply document what users ask for. We are looking for analysts who can:
Observe how work is done
Understand why decisions are made
Identify root causes
Challenge assumptions constructively
Translate operational knowledge into scalable system capabilities
Whether the challenge involves routing freight, allocating carrier capacity, handling exceptions, improving visibility, coordinating shipments, or designing operational workspaces, the goal remains the same:
Help build systems that enable better decisions and better operational outcomes.
The Kind of Problems You Will Work On
Operational Workspaces & Visibility
Help design systems that allow operations teams to understand and manage the complete operational picture.
Connect shipments, bookings, containers, schedules, documents, customer instructions, exceptions, and operational knowledge into coherent workflows.
Understand how operators coordinate work and identify opportunities to improve visibility and efficiency.
Routing, Planning & Allocation
Analyze how routing decisions are made across customers, carriers, schedules, allocations, and operational constraints.
Help define decision logic for routing recommendations, carrier selection, allocation management, and exception handling.
Translate customer SOPs, routing rules, carrier priorities, allocation commitments, and business constraints into scalable solution designs.
Support initiatives involving routing automation, planning optimization, and decision-support systems.
Process Improvement & Automation
Study operational processes and identify bottlenecks, workarounds, manual effort, and sources of complexity.
Recommend improvements that simplify workflows while maintaining business effectiveness.
Help design automation capabilities that reduce repetitive work and allow operators to focus on higher-value decision-making.
Product & Solution Design
Work closely with product owners, engineers, and operations teams to shape new features and capabilities.
Define business requirements, workflows, business rules, user journeys, acceptance criteria, and solution behavior.
Ensure solutions remain practical, scalable, and aligned with operational realities.
What We Value
We care more about how you think than how many methodologies or tools you know.
We value people who:
Think from first principles.
Seek to understand root causes rather than symptoms.
Ask thoughtful questions and challenge assumptions.
Enjoy understanding complex systems, workflows, and operational behavior.
Balance analytical thinking with practical execution.
Can simplify complexity without losing important business requirements.
Care about business outcomes, not just project completion.
Earn trust through ownership, reliability, and clear communication.
Maintain high standards in analysis, documentation, testing, and delivery.
Stay curious and continuously learn.
Key Responsibilities
Understand the Business
Learn how global supply chain operations function in practice.
Work closely with operations teams, customer service, planners, managers, and customers.
Understand booking processes, routing decisions, allocation management, scheduling, exception handling, and operational coordination.
Identify pain points, inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Analyze & Design Solutions
Translate business challenges into clear solution concepts.
Create process maps, system flows, user journeys, business rules, and functional requirements.
Define how systems should behave in normal and exception scenarios.
Support solution design discussions and evaluate trade-offs between business needs and system complexity.
Support Product Delivery
Manage requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Work closely with engineering teams during analysis, development, testing, and rollout.
Clarify requirements, answer questions, and ensure business intent remains clear.
Support release planning, rollout preparation, and change management activities.
Validate & Improve
Design test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
Validate that delivered solutions solve the intended business problem.
Analyze data, user feedback, and operational results after deployment.
Continuously identify improvement opportunities.
Who We’re Looking For
3+ years of experience in business analysis, product analysis, operations analysis, project delivery, or related roles.
Enjoy solving business and operational problems.
Are naturally curious and ask thoughtful questions.
Like understanding how systems, processes, and people interact.
Can break down ambiguous problems into structured, actionable pieces.
Are comfortable balancing detailed analysis with big-picture thinking.
Communicate clearly with both business users and technical teams.
Take ownership and follow through on commitments.
Are interested in learning supply chain operations and logistics if you do not already have experience.
Capabilities That Are Valuable
Supply Chain & Operational Analysis
Routing and planning analysis
Allocation and capacity management
Operational workflow analysis
Exception management
Business rules definition
SOP interpretation and translation
Process improvement
Supply chain and logistics operations
Business Analysis & Product Thinking
Requirements gathering and analysis
User story development
Process mapping
Impact analysis
Solution design
Stakeholder management
Acceptance criteria definition
Product discovery and validation
Data & Analytical Skills
Data investigation and validation
SQL querying and analysis
Reporting and trend analysis
Root cause investigation
KPI and operational performance analysis
Data-driven decision making
Delivery & Collaboration
Agile delivery practices
Testing and validation
Release support
Jira and collaboration platforms
Working effectively with software engineers
Cross-functional stakeholder coordination
Technologies & Tools You May Encounter
Our environment may include:
Supply chain and logistics platforms
SQL Server and relational databases
APIs and system integrations
Event-driven applications
Business intelligence and reporting tools
Jira and collaboration platforms
AI-assisted productivity tools
Documentation and knowledge-management platforms
Carrier integrations, EDI, routing engines, and operational planning systems
You do not need experience with every tool.
Strong analytical thinking, business understanding, curiosity, and learning ability are more important than tool familiarity.
You May Enjoy This Role If...
You often ask "Why?" before asking "What should we build?"
You enjoy understanding how complex organizations and operations work.
You like uncovering hidden assumptions and root causes.
You enjoy solving operational and business problems.
You are interested in logistics, routing, planning, optimization, and decision-making.
You prefer meaningful business impact over documentation for its own sake.
You enjoy working with both operators and engineers.
You like turning complexity into clarity.
What Success Looks Like
Success is not measured by the number of requirements documents produced.
Success means:
Operational problems are clearly understood.
Solutions address root causes rather than symptoms.
Routing and planning decisions become more effective and scalable.
Operational processes become simpler and more efficient.
Business and engineering teams remain aligned.
Users trust and adopt the solutions delivered.
Decision-making improves through better visibility, data, and automation.
The organization gains systems that are practical today and durable for the future.
Why Join Century
This is an opportunity to work on meaningful challenges at the intersection of:
Supply Chain + Operations + Product Thinking + Data + Automation + Decision Intelligence
You will help shape systems that directly influence how freight moves around the world.
If you enjoy understanding problems deeply, challenging assumptions, simplifying complexity, and helping build systems that create real operational impact, we would love to hear from you.
Benefits
5-days work week, public holiday
Monday to Friday, 9am to 5:30pm
Double pay and discretionary bonus
Medical & Dental Insurance
Friendly and stable working environment
Convenient working location, 2 mins to MTR station
Career development and growth opportunities

jd:
About RedotPay
RedotPay is a global crypto payment fintech that integrates blockchain solutions into traditional banking and finance infrastructure.
