About the Role
Own on-chain risk detection, prevention, and mitigation for our wallet and deposit infrastructure. You’ll build and operate monitoring rules, alerts, and response workflows to protect user funds, prevent illicit/sanctioned inflows, and support AML/CFT compliance—while enabling business growth.
>
Key Responsibilities
On-chain Risk Monitoring & Detection
Design and continuously improve on-chain monitoring rules/models for deposits, address interactions, fund source analysis, and anomalous patterns.
Monitor company wallet activity (hot/warm/cold), deposit addresses, and high-risk interactions in real time/near real time.
Detect and investigate suspicious behaviors (e.g., mixers/tumblers, risky protocols, rapid layering, abnormal deposit patterns).
Wallet & Deposit Risk Controls
Implement risk controls such as deposit credit gating, address screening, exposure limits, and intervention workflows (automated/manual).
Define thresholds by network/token/wallet tier (hot/warm/cold).
Support decisions such as delaying/returning deposits, freezing addresses, and escalating cases with Ops/Compliance.
Investigation, Case Management & Response
Lead/support investigations and produce clear risk assessment reports with recommended actions (hold/block/release/escalate, SAR/STR/referral).
Maintain case workflows, escalation matrices, and documentation standards.
Partner with Compliance on sanctions screening and regulatory reporting.
Rules, Tooling & Continuous Improvement
Work with Product/Engineering/Data to define tooling, dashboards, alerting, and decision engines.
Tune rules to balance detection quality, false positives, and operational efficiency.
Track KPIs (coverage, true positive rate, handling time, residual risk).
Collaborate with Wallet/Deposit Ops, Product, Compliance, Legal, and Treasury.
>
Requirements
3 years in crypto risk, blockchain analytics, AML transaction monitoring, or digital asset compliance/operations (with on-chain/wallet exposure).
Strong blockchain fundamentals and fund flow analysis (UTXO vs account-based, clustering, fund paths).
Hands-on experience with blockchain analytics tools (e.g., Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM, Arkham, or equivalent).
Experience designing/operating risk rules, alerts, and case investigations.
Familiarity with AML/CFT and sanctions expectations for virtual asset service providers.
Strong analytical/investigative skills and clear communication.
>
Preferred
Experience at an exchange/custody provider/analytics firm
Wallet risk experience beyond deposit screening.
SQL/data analysis and dashboarding experience.

Establish and implement charging station safety operation standards in compliance with Hong Kong Electricity Ordinance and Occupational Safety and Health Ordinance , and regularly revise Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Conduct daily safety inspections and hazard identification. Organize safety training and emergency drills (e.g., electric leakage, fire response).
2. 充電站日常運營管理Daily Operation Management of Charging Stations
統籌場站運營調度，保障充電樁（直流 / 交流）、配電設備、監控系統 24 小時穩定運行。跟進設備運行數據監控（充電量、故障率、使用率），分析運營瓶頸幷提出優化方案。負責場站環境管理（清潔、照明、標識完好）、用戶體驗優化（故障響應、諮詢解答）。協調與物業、電力公司、政府部門的日常溝通，確保運營合規。
Coordinate station operation scheduling to ensure 24/7 stable operation of EV chargers (DC/AC), power distribution equipment, and monitoring systems. Monitor operation data (charging volume, failure rate, utilization rate), analyze bottlenecks, and propose optimization solutions. Manage station environment and user experience. Coordinate with property management, power companies, and government authorities to ensure compliance.
3. 設備維修與故障處置Equipment Maintenance and Fault Handling
開展充電樁、變壓器、配電櫃等設備的日常保養、定期檢測（如絕緣測試、接地測試）。快速響應設備故障（如充電中斷、通信异常、硬件損壞），現場排查維修，降低停機時間。
Routine maintenance and periodic testing of EV chargers, transformers, and power distribution cabinets (e.g., insulation test, earthing test). Respond promptly to equipment failures, conduct on-site troubleshooting and repair to minimize downtime.
>
任職資格 | Job Requirements
1. 大專【高級文憑（Higher Diploma, HD）、副學士（Associate Degree, AD）】及以上學歷，電氣工程、電力系統、新能源科學與工程等相關專業優先。
Higher Diploma / Associate Degree or above; Electrical Engineering, Power System, New Energy Engineering or related majors are preferred.
2. 持有香港有效電工牌照（B牌或以上，C牌/H牌或相關專項認證優先），熟悉香港電力規例及充電設施安全標準。
Holder of a valid Hong Kong Electrical Worker License (Grade B or above，C / H or with relevant specialized certification preferred); familiar with Hong Kong electricity regulations and charging facility safety standards.
3. 具備充電站 / 電力設施運營維修經驗優先。
experience in charging station /power facility operation and maintenance is preferred.
4. 具備粵語、英文商務溝通能力，流利者優先。
Proficiency in business communication in Cantonese and English; fluency is a strong advantage.

企業簡介 | Company Profile

潤超充致力于推動超快速充電基礎設施布局，在香港投資、建設、運營電動車超充網絡「充美好」，2025 年新增簽約充電車位超過 1000 個，新增投運太陽能電站裝機容量 1862kWp，項目規模迅速躍升，位居行業前列。未來公司將持續加大在港固定資産投資，目標是成爲香港規模第一的充電網絡及技術領先的綜合能源運營商。
CR Supercharge Technology Company Limited is a wholly-owned comprehensive energy investment platform of China Resources Gas in Hong Kong. About Hong Kong Genome Institute
The Hong Kong Genome Institute (HKGI), established and wholly owned by the Hong Kong SAR Government, commenced full operations in 2021. As the first step towards achieving its vision, HKGI launched the Hong Kong Genome Project (HKGP) in 2021. As the city’s first large-scale genome sequencing project, HKGP serves as a catalyst to benefit patients and their families with more precise diagnosis and personalised treatment through whole genome sequencing. Inspectorate

Provide Compliance advisory coverage of the firm’s electronic trading services and products, including providing advice, handling regulatory reporting, coordinating risk assessments and testing, and dealing with Compliance related queries, alerts and incidents.
Represent the Compliance team to participate in, and work with other business and support functions on, major business proposals and regulatory change initiatives.
Assist to implement and maintain the firm’s Compliance program, including policies and procedures.
Prepare and deliver Compliance training addressing employee needs and Compliance requirements as well as enhancing employee awareness and knowledge of regulatory requirements and sensitivities.

The Director, APAC & China Trade owns end‑to‑end trade outcomes, spanning trade operations in APAC and regional trade compliance across APAC markets and Mainland China. This role serves as the single accountable regional leader for customs compliance, broker governance, duty payments, audit readiness, and trade execution, ensuring alignment to global standards while managing region‑specific regulatory complexity. Lead duty stewardship across jurisdictions by approving assessments, ensuring accurate and on‑time duty and tax payments and reconciliations, and reporting duty spend, savings, opportunities, and exposure.
Oversee Free Trade Agreement (FTA) and duty‑optimization programs to ensure correct eligibility and supplier evidence, prevent misuse, realize savings, and support readiness for new and expanding distribution centres (e.g., Singapore and Japan).
Set regional audit readiness standards by defining audit playbooks and recordkeeping requirements, leading responses to customs authorities, and managing material findings and escalations in partnership with Trade Compliance CoE.
Lead the regional operating model and talent strategy, managing a multi‑country organization, setting SLAs with Fulfilment, Supply Chain and Finance, and developing leaders to scale consistent execution.
Act as the regional owner of trade systems and data stewardship by ensuring trade data quality (HTS, COO, MID, valuation, entries), signing off on data requirements and UAT for trade‑critical changes, and escalating systemic issues to the Trade Compliance CoE.

title: Procurement Specialist
teaser: Supporting the end-to-end flow of raw materials, packaging, and finished goods from our manufacturing partners to our customers
jd:
IM8 is a next-generation health and longevity brand co-founded by David Beckham and Prenetics (NASDAQ: PRE), on a mission to make world-class nutritional science accessible to everyone. Launched in late 2024, IM8 grew Q1 2026 revenue nearly 6x year-over-year to $33.8M, and the company has raised full-year 2026 IM8 revenue guidance to $190M-$210M. Over 60% of revenue is generated outside the US. We ship to 43 countries, and our athlete partner roster includes David Beckham, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Aryna Sabalenka, Ollie Bearman, and Inter Miami CF.
We are built on science, not story - our flagship Daily Ultimate Essentials carries 90 active ingredients, we run randomized controlled trials on our products, and we hold a clinical-grade standard in a category notorious for shortcuts.
Our business is subscription at its core. Every shipment that lands on time, in full, and to spec is a brand promise kept - and on a subscription model, those promises compound into loyalty, LTV, and the freedom to keep growing.
>
Why This Role Is Different
Most procurement roles inherit bloated processes and spend their days pushing paper. This one does not. At IM8’s growth rate, procurement is the difference between a product that ships flawlessly and a stockout that reads as a broken promise to a subscriber. Every ingredient sourced, every shipment tracked, and every document filed correctly protects the customer experience our brand is built on. We need someone who treats procurement as a brand asset, not a back-office function - and who wants to help build the playbook, not just follow one.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a Procurement Assistant - IM8, based in Hong Kong (on-site), to support the end-to-end flow of raw materials, packaging, and finished goods from our manufacturing partners to our customers. You will work hand-in-hand with Operations, Quality Assurance, and Product Development to keep our supply chain accurate, on time, and audit-ready as we scale. Your mandate: make sure what we promise customers is delivered flawlessly - every ingredient, every shipment, every time.
What You’ll Do
Procure-to-Pay
Create, issue, and manage purchase orders (POs) in the ERP system based on demand forecasts and inventory reorder points.
Track PO status through the full lifecycle (issued, confirmed, in-transit, received, closed).
Support 3-way matching—resolve invoice discrepancies (price, quantity, freight charges) and escalate to SPM when resolution exceeds your authority.
Cross-Functional Coordination
Partner daily with Operations, Quality Assurance, and Product Development to align on components, packaging requirements, lead times, and new product iterations.
Anticipate and resolve supply issues before they surface.
Liaise with Finance on invoice resolution, payment status, and supplier inquiries.
Supplier Communication & Follow-Up
Chase suppliers for order confirmations, production timelines, and shipping documentation (BOL, packing lists, commercial invoices).
Request and organize compliance documents (Certificates of Analysis, Certificates of Origin, MSDS, insurance certificates).
Relay supplier inquiries (specifications, artwork, shipping instructions) to internal stakeholders.
Maintain supplier records—contacts, pricing, lead times, MOQs, and performance data.
Shipment Tracking & Logistics Coordination
Track all inbound shipments (raw materials, packaging) from origin to warehouse.
Coordinate with freight forwarders on booking confirmations and shipment schedules.
Manage import/export documentation—customs declarations, certificates, and regulatory paperwork.
What We’re Looking For
1-3 years’ experience in purchasing, freight coordination, or operations support.
A strong analytical mindset with exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
Proven ability to juggle multiple priorities and hit tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication (English; Cantonese/Mandarin a plus) to work with vendors and internal stakeholders.
Proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets for cost analysis, reporting, and data management.
Experience with ERP systems (Dynamic 365, Procurify, NetSuite, or equivalent).
Non-Negotiable
You are on-site in Hong Kong, ready for real-time collaboration and vendor coordination.
You are meticulous. When a Certificate of Analysis, a customs declaration, or a cost figure is wrong, you catch it before it becomes a problem. If “close enough” is your standard, this is not your role.
Nice to Have
Exposure to consumer products, manufacturing, or health-science categories.
Familiarity with import/export regulations and international shipping documentation.
Experience with supplier scorecarding and performance tracking.
>

title: Product Design Lead
teaser: Lead Industrial Design for a global toy brand from Hong Kong - Asia's manufacturing gateway, direct CEO access, real products at scale.

Close proximity to Shenzhen tooling, DFM and supply chain.
High-trust, low-bureaucracy leadership role, full autonomy.
jd:
About Vuly
Vuly is an Australian-owned outdoor play company designing category-leading products used by families worldwide. We're known for engineering-driven design, high safety standards, and products that ship at scale into global markets.
Great ideas here don't stay ideas for long - they get manufactured, tested, certified and delivered into the hands of families worldwide.
The Opportunity
We're looking for a Product Design Lead to help shape what Vuly builds next, working directly with the CEO on new product concepts and category opportunities.
The mandate is broad: turn market insight and play trends into product concepts that are genuinely ready to be engineered, tooled and shipped.
The Role in Practice
Vuly's product range spans trampolines, swing sets, cubbies and next-generation play - physical, digital and everything in between. You'll shape concepts at the front end of that pipeline, partnering with:
A dedicated DFM specialist in Malaysia
A shared services group of plastics engineers, toolmakers and safety specialists across Kuala Lumpur and China
Your job is to make sure every concept that leaves your desk is desirable, differentiated and buildable - not just good in a render.
What You'll Do
Generate and pressure-test new product concepts, from customer insight through to early prototypes
Partner with the CEO on category strategy and where Vuly plays next
Translate concepts into design briefs that engineering, DFM and tooling teams can execute against
Champion the customer experience - unboxing, assembly, first use - not just the object itself
Stay close to play, outdoor and consumer product trends to keep Vuly's range differentiated
Prototype quickly, using both physical and digital tools, to test ideas before committing to tooling
Work with marketing and commercial teams to make sure design supports the product story
How This Role Works
This is a front-end, ideas-first role. Expect close, regular collaboration with the CEO on direction, concepts and category bets - more back-and-forth than a typical design leadership role. Once a concept is validated, it's handed to the engineering and DFM teams for delivery.
Success is measured by the strength and hit-rate of what makes it to market - concepts that resonate with customers and translate cleanly into production.
What We're Looking For
5+ years' experience in product, industrial or consumer design, ideally including physical products
A strong portfolio of concepts that made it from idea to shelf, not just renders
Genuine curiosity about customers, play and outdoor culture
Comfort presenting and defending ideas directly to senior leadership
Working knowledge of how physical products get manufactured - enough to design within real plastics and tooling constraints
Proficiency in CAD and prototyping tools (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Rhino or similar)
Strong storytelling and visual communication skills
Comfort with ambiguity - this role creates the brief, it doesn't just execute one
Why This Is Worth a Look
Direct, regular access to the CEO on category strategy and new concepts
Genuine influence over what Vuly builds next
Global manufacturing and DFM support ready to take your concepts to production
High trust, low bureaucracy
>
How to Apply
Send your CV and examples of products you've engineered from concept to production to ••••@vulyplay.com . We're most interested in seeing how you think through a problem - the trade-offs, the failed prototypes, the test that changed the design - alongside the finished part.
>

About Us: Asia International School Limited (AISL)
Asia International School Limited (AISL) is a leading provider of premium K-12 education in Asia, operating the prestigious AISL Harrow family of schools across Thailand, Hong Kong SAR, Mainland China, and Japan. Bringing over 450 years of educational heritage from the UK to dynamic Asian markets, we blend traditional British excellence with modern innovation. Joining our headquarter team means becoming a key architect in shaping future-ready education and inspiring the next generation of global leaders.
Role Overview
The role is responsible for driving consistent, high-quality operational performance across AISL Harrow schools, combining group-level governance with hands-on, on-the-ground execution. Working closely with school and Group leadership, the role will strengthen operational standards, optimize cost and revenue performance, support new school and facility openings, and continuously enhance the parent and student experience across our multi-site network.
>
Roles & Responsibilities
1. School Operations Supervision & On-Ground Governance
Supervise and mentor Regional Operations Leads and school-level operational managers across designated campus clusters (GBA, Greater China, Asia)
Establish strong supervision protocols over school operations, ensuring daily campus execution aligns strictly with AISL Harrow operating standards, local regulations, and brand expectations.
Alongside AD of Operations Excellence to conduct regular on-site operational reviews and quality checks, partnering directly with School Head of Operations to identify operational bottlenecks and drive immediate remediation.
2. P&L Management & Commercial Optimization
Take ownership of operational cost drivers across school campuses, partnering with Centralized Procurement and Operations Excellence to drive vendor savings, commercial partnership deals, and economies of scale.
Identify and drive local revenue enhancement opportunities across campuses, including auxiliary service monetization, facility utilization, summer programs, and commercial venue usage.
Support Director, Group Operations Monitor financial operational metrics across all schools, delivering transparent financial reporting and performance variance analysis to Group Leadership.
3. Pre-Opening, Facility Buildout & Expansion Leadership
Support Director, Group Operations to lead the operational pre-opening framework for new school launches, campus extensions, and digitalised operations workflows.
Support school Head of Operations to oversee new school/facility readiness playbooks, ensuring catering, transportation, safety, and facilities management infrastructure are fully operational prior to school opening dates.
Work with Construction/ project teams and school Head of Operations to ensure human-centric, customer-focused facility design principles are embedded into new construction and renovation projects.
4. Operations Excellence & Customer Experience
Standardize core AISL operating procedures and enforce the Quality Assurance Framework (QAF) across all school campuses.
Maintain an uncompromised customer-centric focus, using parent and student feedback to continuously refine campus dining, safety, facility cleanliness, and daily operational touchpoints.

title: Manager/ Senior Manager – Cyber Security (DarkLab) Consulting
teaser: We are looking for a cyber leader with broad practice knowledge, deep expertise in 1–2 areas, and strong client-facing commercial ability.
bullet_points: 6+ years of relevant experience
Opportunities for professional development and career advancement
The chance to work with leading organizations across various industries.
jd:
Position overview
DarkLab is PwC Hong Kong's cyber defence practice — over 150 practitioners delivering managed defence, advisory and technology solutions to enterprise clients across Hong Kong, Mainland China and South East Asia. We are CREST-accredited, we publish original vulnerability research, and we operate managed detection and response, exposure management and attack surface management as live services.
We are now scaling the next generation of that business: an AI-powered Security Operations Centre and a portfolio of AI-enabled cyber solutions built on our own detection engineering, our threat intelligence, and partnerships including watchTowr, Microsoft, AWS and Palo Alto Networks.
>
DarkLab practice areas
You should expect to lead work drawing on any of these, and to be genuinely strong in one or two. Whether your strength is technical or advisory matters far less than that it is real.
Managed Cyber Defence
Cyber-as-a-Service: 24/7 monitoring, managed detection and response, detection engineering, SOC operations, and our AI-powered SOC
Exposure & Attack Surface Management
Continuous exposure validation, external attack surface discovery, vulnerability management, watchTowr-based services
Offensive Security
Penetration testing, red and purple teaming, adversary simulation, SDLC security, CREST-accredited and intelligence-led testing
Threat Intelligence
Digital footprint reporting, dark web monitoring, threat research, bespoke intelligence assessments, vulnerability research
Digital Forensics & Incident Response
Incident readiness, investigation, containment and remediation, threat hunting, post-incident review
Cyber Strategy, Governance & Regulatory
Strategy and maturity assessment, NIST and ISO 27001 frameworks, HKMA C-RAF and iCAST, SFC requirements, third-party risk
Privacy & Data Protection
PDPO, GDPR and PIPL compliance, privacy impact assessment, China Cybersecurity Law, MLPS certification, cross-border data transfer
Cloud & DevSecOps
Cloud security strategy and architecture, CSPM/CNAPP, secure landing zones, container security, secure development pipelines
Emerging Technology Security
AI security and AI governance, blockchain and digital asset security, wallet and key management, security engineering and internal products
>Key responsibilities
Leading delivery across the practice
• Lead cyber security engagements that draw on more than one DarkLab specialty — assembling the right specialists, holding the parts together, and owing the outcome end to end.
• Scope, price and plan work across the full portfolio, including areas where you are not personally the practitioner. You are expected to know what good looks like, who to put it on, and when something is off.
• Quality-review deliverables across specialties, and act as a senior escalation point on major incidents and difficult engagements.
• Convey pragmatic solutions to complex business problems through written reports and presentations to boards, audit committees and regulators.
• Maintain and raise the quality bar — methodology, deliverable standards, peer review, and risk and quality management on every engagement.
>
Depth in your own specialties
• Set the technical direction in the one or two practice areas where you are the specialist — owning methodology, tooling decisions and the standard of the work.
• Act as the final technical reviewer in those areas, and as the firm’s subject matter expert in front of clients and regulators.
• Develop the capability behind you: build the bench, run technical training, and grow the next specialists in your domain.
• Stay current in your field and bring what is useful back into practice — research, tooling, tradecraft, new regulatory expectations.
>
Managed services and AI
• Own the technical design of managed security service solutions: detection engineering, use case development, SIEM/SOAR architecture, client onboarding and transition, service levels and run-state operating models.
• Bring AI into the detection and response lifecycle — automated triage and enrichment, agentic workflows for tier-1 and tier-2 analysis, LLM-assisted detection engineering and threat hunting — with measurable outcomes in mean time to triage, alert fatigue and detection coverage.
• Advise clients on securing their own AI adoption, covering model and data risk, prompt injection, data leakage and AI governance.
>
Solutioning and business development
• Act as solution lead for DarkLab's AI-powered SOC and AI security offerings, taking them to market with our client-facing teams in Hong Kong and the region.
• Run the pre-sales cycle: qualify the opportunity, scope it, shape the commercial and technical business case, and build the solution.
• Prepare proposals, presentations and statements of work, and lead technical responses to RFIs, RFPs and tenders.
• Work with commercial constructs that suit managed services — tiered, consumption-based and multi-year models — and understand the margin behind them.
• Present to audiences from CISO and CIO through to CEO, CFO and the board, and run workshops, proofs of concept and executive briefings that convert interest into signed work.
• Build and sustain your own network of client relationships and industry contacts, and act as a trusted adviser across both the pre-sales and post-sales lifecycle.
• Own the handover from sale to delivery, so that what we sold is what the client receives.
• Contribute to offering development — service design, reference architectures, pricing constructs and enablement material — and to our alliances with security and cloud vendors.
• Represent DarkLab externally through thought leadership, research publication, conference speaking and industry bodies.
>
People and practice
• Supervise, coach, develop and lead multi-disciplinary teams of consultants and SOC analysts, including performance management and career development.
• Build the capability bench — recruitment, technical training, certification pathways and knowledge management.
• Contribute to the commercial management of the practice: resourcing, engagement economics, utilisation and delivery profitability.
>
Requirements
Essential
• University degree majoring in computer science, information systems, engineering, information security or related discipline.
• Professional qualifications: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, OSCP, CREST, GIAC or other security-related qualifications.
• Minimum of 6 years of cyber security experience with a reputable professional / consulting firm, managed security service provider, system integrator, security vendor or multi-national corporation, including at least 2 years leading engagements or service delivery. Candidates with more experience will be considered for the Senior Manager or Associate Director position.
Depth. Genuine strength in one or two of the DarkLab practice areas listed above — deep enough that you set the direction, own the methodology, and are the person who signs off the work in that area. Depth in an advisory domain counts as much as depth in a technical one: cyber strategy, governance and regulatory, or privacy and data protection, sit on the same footing here as offensive security or detection engineering.
Breadth. Working command of most of the remainder — enough to scope it, price it, quality-review it, lead a specialist team delivering it, and hold a credible conversation with a client across the whole portfolio. You are not expected to be the technical expert in every area. You are expected to know what good looks like, who to put on it, and when something is off.
• A demonstrable commercial track record: shaping and winning work, contributing to proposals and bids, or carrying a solution or revenue target.
• Working knowledge of the Hong Kong regulatory environment, including HKMA C-RAF and iCAST, SFC requirements and the PDPO; and where relevant Mainland China’s Cybersecurity Law, MLPS and PIPL.
• Excellent communication skills in both oral and written English and Chinese. Cantonese is required for Hong Kong client delivery; Mandarin is a strong advantage for regional work.
• Proven experience as a team leader and coach.
• Ability to interact with executive levels of client and firm management.
• Flexibility to travel to out-of-town engagements within Greater China and South East Asia.
>
Preferred background (any of the following)
• Practical experience building, running or selling a managed detection and response or SOC service — not just consuming one.
• Genuine fluency in applying AI to security operations: agentic workflows, LLM-assisted analysis, automation of triage and response, and an honest view of where it works and where it does not.
• Experience securing enterprise AI adoption, or in AI red teaming.
• A track record of taking a new service offering to market — building it, pricing it, positioning it and selling the first deals.
• Vendor experience across the platforms we work with, including watchTowr, Microsoft Security, Palo Alto Networks and AWS.
• Published research, CVE credits, conference speaking or an active presence in the security community.
• Experience operating across Hong Kong, Mainland China and Southeast Asia.

title: Corporate Cleaning Manager
teaser: Oversee cleaning operations across multiple property portfolios and lead the cleaning function team.
jd:
About the role
Oversee the overall cleaning operations across multiple property portfolios (e.g., industrial parks, commercial buildings). Develop cleaning service standards, operational SOPs, and pest control management systems; establish a quality assurance framework and take overall accountability for the company's environmental hygiene and service quality.
Key responsibilities
Build and lead the cleaning function team. Manage Cleaning Managers and Supervisors across various projects; drive talent development, performance appraisals, and role assessments; design training systems and optimize workforce planning.
Lead budget preparation and cost control for the cleaning department. Manage expenses for cleaning consumables, equipment, and outsourced service providers; conduct cost analysis and drive cost-efficiency initiatives; review proposals for large-scale procurement and equipment upgrades.
Manage the sourcing, contract review, performance monitoring, and evaluation of outsourced vendors for pest control, waste collection, and specialized cleaning services. Ensure vendor service quality and handle any vendor disputes.
Establish cross-site inspection and unannounced audit mechanisms. Conduct regular specialized environmental hygiene inspections across projects, consolidate quality issues, drive closed-loop rectification, and present quality reports to senior management.
Ensure full compliance with local regulations (e.g., Hong Kong Public Health and Municipal Services Ordinance, waste classification, and chemical control regulations). Maintain compliant cleaning, hazardous waste disposal, and pest control operations across all projects to mitigate compliance and safety risks.
Manage major environmental hygiene complaints and emergency responses: support for large-scale events, post-typhoon environmental restoration, pandemic-related disinfection, and sudden pollution incidents; develop and execute specialized operational plans.
Introduce new technologies, equipment, and innovative cleaning processes to optimize operational workflows; review and approve operational plans for large-scale post-construction cleaning and deep-cleaning projects.
Oversee safety management. Establish safety protocols for chemical handling, working at heights, and cleaning equipment operation; prevent occupational injuries and safety incidents; build and oversee the safety training system.
Report regularly to senior management on cleaning operational KPIs, quality metrics, and budget execution. Serve as the primary liaison for key clients, address escalated client requests, participate in bid preparation, and draft technical cleaning proposals.
About you
Extensive senior management experience in cleaning/facilities operations for commercial properties, border control facilities, or large-scale industrial parks, with proven multi-site management capabilities.
Solid working knowledge of Hong Kong's environmental hygiene regulations, waste disposal, pest control, and chemical safety management.
Demonstrated capabilities in vendor management, budget control, and tender/bid documentation.
Relevant Hong Kong safety and pest control certifications are highly preferred.
Strong strategic planning and decision-making skills, with excellent team leadership and cross-departmental coordination abilities.
>

jd:
About the Role
We are seeking a proactive and hands-on Business Development Specialist to support the strategic expansion of our business in Mainland China and South-East Asia, while leading the implementation of Microsoft Business Central and supporting the continuous improvement of business processes across our organization, as well as introducing greater technologies such as AI to grow efficiency and success.
Reporting directly to the Managing Director & General Manager, you will work closely with internal stakeholders and our implementation partner to ensure the successful deployment of Business Central, improve operational efficiency, document key processes, and identify opportunities to leverage technology and AI to support business growth. You will use these systems and technologies to identify new projects, customers, vendors and strategic partners, strengthen market intelligence and support the company’s expansion in Mainland China and South-East Asia.
This is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact on a growing company specializing in luxury hospitality OS&E, while contributing directly to its regional market development and expansion.
>
Key Responsibilities
(1) Business Development & Market Expansion
>
• Execute strategic market development initiatives to expand the company’s luxury hospitality OS&E business in Mainland China and South-East Asia and identify new project and business opportunities.
• Conduct market research on target industries in Mainland China and South-East Asia, analyse customer requirements, vendor capabilities and market trends, and use the findings to support the company’s business development strategy.
• Establish and expand customer, vendor and strategic partner networks in Mainland China and South-East Asia and build long-term industry cooperation channels.
• Use Business Central, business intelligence and AI-enabled tools to organise and analyse customer, vendor, project and market information and coordinate internal and external resources in support of new business opportunities.
• Evaluate market expansion outcomes, optimise business development strategies and enhance the company’s market presence in Mainland China and South-East Asia.
>
(2) Microsoft Business Central Implementation
• Lead business process reviews and requirements gathering across departments.
• Perform fit-gap analysis and support system configuration and enhancements.
• Act as the primary liaison between internal users and ACW throughout the implementation.
• Coordinate data preparation, migration, validation, testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
• Support issue management, training and go-live activities.
• Administer user access rights and support vendor and customer portals.
• Develop user guides, training materials and operating handbooks.
• Utilise Business Central data, reporting and customer and vendor records to support business development, supplier sourcing and market expansion initiatives in Mainland China and South-East Asia.
(3) Business Central Phase 2 Planning

As a Customer Service Officer in the food supply chain industry, you will be the vital bridge connecting the company with our clients. You will not only resolve customer enquiries and issues but also serve as the direct ambassador of our brand values — Fresh, Convenient, and Reliable. Respond efficiently to customer enquiries regarding product information, order status, delivery progress, and after-sales requests through multiple channels including online chat, phone, and email. Handle after-sales requests professionally and in accordance with company policies, promptly and reasonably resolving typical food-related after-sales issues such as product freshness concerns, quality defects, missing or incorrect items, and delivery delays.
Exercise sound judgment in assessing issues based on photo/video evidence provided by customers, and determine appropriate compensation solutions (e.g., refunds, replacements, discount vouchers).
Effectively calm and reassure customers who are dissatisfied with received products.
Accurately record and categorise core customer feedback, and generate daily work reports.
Escalate recurring issues related to product quality, packaging, and delivery to the relevant responsible departments — procurement, quality control, warehousing, and logistics — to drive internal improvements and reduce customer complaints at the source.
Familiarise yourself with and proficiently operate the company's CRM system, ERP system, and customer service workbench.
Continuously learn and master product knowledge, promotional campaigns, and after-sales policies.
About you
Minimum 3 years of customer service experience.
Familiarity with the characteristics and common pain points of the F&B ingredients industry.
Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel.
Typing speed of 120 characters per minute or above.
Basic English reading and writing skills.
Excellent communication and empathy skills; able to listen patiently and defuse conflicts.
Fast learning and adaptability; able to quickly grasp fresh product knowledge and company procedures.
Basic computer literacy; proficient in office software and customer service systems.
Strong stress tolerance and emotional regulation; able to thrive in a fast-paced environment and handle occasional negative customer interactions.
Integrity, responsibility, patience with customers, and a strong service mindset.
About us
Hopfresh One Stop Catering Ingredients Supply Platform is operated by Hophing Food Supply Chain (Hong Kong) Limited. It is a B2B one stop online ingredients supply platform dedicated to catering merchants including cha chaan tengs, Chinese restaurants, Western restaurants, chain eateries, banquet restaurants, hotels, bakeries and wholesale produce stalls. Our team has long standing expertise in B end ingredients supply. We consolidate sourcing and supply resources for a full spectrum of catering ingredients, including local and overseas vegetables, frozen foods, grains and oils, dried goods, seafood, fruits, seasonings, processed vegetables and pre prepared dishes. We operate in house temperature controlled cold chain warehouses and compliant food processing and sorting workshops, and hold relevant food trading licences issued by the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department of Hong Kong. Powered by our digital mall system, we deliver integrated procurement services for catering merchants, encompassing one click ordering via the online mall, scheduled delivery, online account reconciliation and invoice issuance.

This is a unique opportunity for a hands-on procurement professional to influence business decisions, strengthen supplier partnerships, and contribute to operational excellence across the organization.
In this role, you will lead sourcing initiatives from market assessment and vendor evaluation through to negotiation, contract development, and supplier performance management. You will work closely with stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal & Compliance, giving you broad exposure to both commercial and strategic business matters. Reporting to the Legal & Compliance Manager, you will also play a key role in contract management, ensuring commercial terms are practical, enforceable, and aligned with governance requirements while mitigating business risks.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
Lead end-to-end procurement activities for LPG-related equipment and materials, including LPG tanks, cylinders, vaporizers, piping systems, valves, meters and related components, ensuring quality, safety and cost-effectiveness.
Manage the sourcing and procurement of services, including transportation, contractor services, engineering works, pipework projects, and lease renewals.
Develop and execute effective procurement strategies, including RFQ, RFP, and tendering processes, to maximize commercial value, mitigate risk, and support business objectives.
Conduct commercial negotiations with suppliers on pricing, contractual terms, service levels, and delivery schedules to achieve budget targets and key performance indicators.
Contribute to ERP and procurement system enhancement initiatives, driving process improvements, data accuracy, and procurement best practices.
Perform supplier evaluations, audits, and quality assurance reviews to ensure compliance with internal policies, safety regulations, and technical standards.
Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to resolve product quality issues, manage supply risks, and ensure the timely delivery of critical equipment and services.
Build and maintain strong supplier relationships, driving continuous improvement, reliability, and long-term partnership value.
Support ad-hoc procurement initiatives and projects assigned by the supervisor.
>
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Bachelor’s degree or above in Procurement & Supply Chain management, Business Administration, Finance, Law, Engineering or relevant discipline.
At least 5 years’ experience in procurement or supply chain management, exposure to utilities, energy or engineering industries is an advantage.
Proven experience in sourcing, tender management, supplier relationship management, contract negotiation, and procurement governance.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to assess cost, quality, operational impact, and business risk when making procurement decisions.
Demonstrated negotiation skills and experience managing supplier relationships
Excellent organizational skills and communication skills.
Pro-active, self-motivated and able to work with minimal supervision.
Proficient in MS Office applications; ERP system implementation or enhancement experience is an advantage.
Excellent written and spoken Cantonese and English; Mandarin is an advantage.
Candidates with exposure to finance, legal, compliance, contract management, or other business disciplines are highly valued, as this role requires a broad commercial perspective beyond traditional procurement responsibilities.
>WHY JOIN US
If you are looking for a position that would make significant impact to the business this is the role for you. This is more than a traditional procurement position. As a key individual contributor reporting to Legal and Compliance, you'll gain broad exposure to commercial, operational, legal, and financial aspects of the business while working closely with senior stakeholders. The role offers a unique opportunity to influence business decisions, strengthen supplier partnerships, and create tangible value across the organization.

Good knowledge of financial operations, including cash management, bank and gateway settlement, transaction-level reconciliation, accounting entries, controls, exception management and month-end closing.

The Senior Building Services Engineer plays a key role in delivering M Moser's integrated Engineering, Technology & Sustainability (ETS) services across Asia.
We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong understanding of both engineering design and project delivery. Candidates with experience working for leading contractors, design-build organisations or engineering consultancies are encouraged to apply. Practical delivery experience, constructability and engineering judgement are as important as technical design capability.
As ETS continues to evolve, this role places increasing emphasis on concept engineering, technical due diligence, Basis of Design development and protecting engineering intent throughout the project lifecycle. Rather than focusing solely on detailed design production, the role helps clients and project teams make better technical decisions earlier, reducing risk and improving project outcomes.
Working closely with our Architecture, Workplace Strategy, Sustainability, Smart Buildings and global engineering teams, you will contribute to integrated solutions that improve building performance, workplace experience, operational efficiency and long-term value.
We are looking for engineers who are curious, adaptable and committed to improving how work is performed. Technical excellence remains fundamental, but we increasingly value engineers who think beyond their own discipline, contribute to better methods and help build capability across the wider practice.
Primary Responsibilities
Concept Engineering & Technical Leadership
Lead technical due diligence and early engineering engagement for workplace and building projects.
Develop Basis of Design documents that establish clear engineering intent, system strategies and project priorities.
Support clients and project teams by identifying technical risks, opportunities and alternative approaches early in the design process.
Protect engineering intent throughout design, procurement and construction.
Integrated Project Delivery
Work closely with Architecture, Workplace Strategy, Sustainability, Smart Buildings and Building Physics teams to develop coordinated technical solutions.
Ensure engineering decisions support constructability, workplace performance, sustainability objectives and commercial outcomes.
Act as a trusted engineering advisor throughout project delivery, supporting project teams, consultants, contractors and clients.
Delivery Excellence & Constructability
Apply practical delivery experience to improve engineering quality, buildability and commissioning outcomes.
Review engineering proposals, contractor submissions and technical solutions from the perspective of delivery, risk and operational performance.
Support value engineering while maintaining design intent and long-term building performance.
Resolve technical issues proactively to reduce downstream rework and project risk.
Quality & Design Guardianship
Lead engineering reviews throughout the project lifecycle.
Ensure engineering solutions remain aligned with the agreed Basis of Design.
Maintain technical quality, consistency and engineering standards across projects.
Support technical governance and quality assurance across regional teams where appropriate.
Practice Development
Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering methods, workflows and technical standards.
Share lessons learned and support development of reusable engineering knowledge across ETS.
Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve coordination and strengthen delivery capability.
Support the adoption of improved tools, methods and digital workflows where they create practical value.
Leadership & Capability Building
Mentor junior engineers and support their technical and professional development.
Contribute to knowledge sharing across offices and disciplines.
Build capability across the wider team through coaching, collaboration and technical leadership.
Actively contribute to the development of the future ETS practice.
Qualifications & Key Competencies
Technical Expertise
Minimum 8 years' experience in mechanical building services engineering across commercial workplace or similar sectors.
Strong understanding of HVAC, plumbing, fire protection and integrated MEP systems.
Demonstrated experience developing Basis of Design documentation, technical due diligence and engineering strategies.
Strong understanding of engineering delivery, procurement, constructability and commissioning.
Familiarity with sustainability frameworks including LEED, WELL and low-carbon design principles.
Experience coordinating with architects, contractors, consultants and specialist suppliers.
Professional Capability
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
Strong engineering judgement and sound technical decision-making.
Systems thinking and an understanding of how engineering influences wider project outcomes.
Curiosity and a commitment to continually improving how work is performed.
Ability to balance technical excellence with commercial, programme and delivery considerations.
Confidence working across disciplines and collaborating with globally distributed teams.
Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Commitment to building capability in others through mentoring and knowledge sharing.
Digital & Technical Tools
Experience with BIM and Revit coordination.
Familiarity with engineering analysis and simulation tools appropriate to engineering design.
Comfortable adopting new digital workflows and technologies that improve quality, consistency and efficiency.
Understanding of how data and digital workflows can support better engineering decisions and project outcomes.
What Success Looks Like
You will create clarity where projects are complex, improve how work is performed, build confidence with clients and contractors, contribute to stronger engineering capability across the business and help ETS continue evolving into an integrated, high-value technical practice.
>

teaser: 本岗位聚焦直接空气碳捕集（DAC）、工业烟气碳捕集吸附材料研发，打通材料实验室研发、中试放大、工业化量产与场景落地全链条，主导核心吸附材料迭代创新、工艺开发与降本增效，支撑公司碳捕集核心材料产业化布局，推动低碳、负碳技术商业化应用
jd:
一、岗位概述
>本岗位聚焦直接空气碳捕集（DAC）、工业烟气碳捕集吸附材料研发，打通材料实验室研发、中试放大、工业化量产与场景落地全链条，主导核心吸附材料迭代创新、工艺开发与降本增效，支撑公司碳捕集核心材料产业化布局，推动低碳、负碳技术商业化应用。
>
>二、岗位职责
>1. 全链条材料产业化攻坚
>聚焦碳捕集领域吸附材料技术创新与产业化落地，以市场、客户项目需求为核心导向，攻克材料吸附容量、循环稳定性、生产成本、成型量产等核心技术瓶颈，打通“配方研发-小试-中试放大-量产制备-现场工程应用”完整链路，为公司碳捕集产业布局提供自主可控核心吸附材料支撑。
>2. 研发战略规划落地
>深度跟踪行业市场与客户需求，协同团队制定中长期固态胺吸附材料研发路线与技术战略，对齐公司业务发展目标、重点客户项目需求，统筹推进年度研发计划落地执行。
>3. 新产品研发与配方工艺迭代
>负责吸附新材料开发、制备工艺优化，解决材料工程化应用过程中的各类关键难题；持续迭代、升级现有成熟吸附材料配方；面向不同工业、空气捕集场景开发差异化新型吸附材料，实现材料综合性能提升与规模化生产成本下降。
>4. 全流程实验体系/平台搭建与执行
>独立完成整套实验方案设计、平台搭建、试验实施与验证，覆盖：原料配方筛选优化、微观结构表征、静态/动态吸附性能测试、循环稳定性能、长周期使用寿命评估、小试验证、中试放大制备、工业化工况模拟性能评价等全流程研发试验工作。
>5. 数据管理与技术文档输出
>规范完成实验数据采集、整理、深度分析与周期性复盘，搭建标准化实验档案、研发数据库；独立撰写实验记录、阶段性研发进度报告、项目结题总结、技术对标分析报告等全套技术文档。
>6. 前沿技术调研与创新布局
>持续追踪国内外碳捕集吸附材料最新科研成果、产业化技术路线、竞品材料方案，定期输出行业技术调研报告，结合公司现有技术储备制定差异化研发策略，布局下一代高性能吸附材料开发。
>7. 知识产权与标准化建设
>主导/参与发明专利、实用新型专利挖掘与申报，独立完成技术交底书撰写；参与企业研发标准、材料检测规范、产品技术规格书编制工作。
>8. 跨部门协同项目推进
>联动生产、工艺、市场、工程团队协同解决材料量产、现场应用过程中的技术难题，同步对接外部高校、研究院开展产学研联合研发。
>
>三、岗位任职要求
>1. 学历、专业与项目经验
>全日制博士研究生学历（不含肄业），有机化学、无机化学、高分子化学与物理、材料化工、环境工程、催化化学等相关专业；拥有2年及以上多孔吸附材料、胺基功能材料研发实操经验，具备完整从实验室配方到中试放大落地项目经验者优先。
>2. 表征设备与数据处理能力
>熟练操作热重分析仪(TGA)、气相色谱仪(GC)、傅里叶红外光谱仪(FTIR)等材料表征、气体吸附性能测试设备；可独立完成实验方案设计、数据解析、结果机理验证；熟练使用Origin、Excel开展数据绘图与统计分析，掌握Python数据分析工具者优先。
>3. 专业理论与项目成果
>精通气体吸附、化学吸收、多相催化基础反应机理，具备固态胺、多孔载体、碳捕集吸附材料完整研发与工程实操经验；以第一作者身份发表2篇及以上高水平SCI学术论文、拥有吸附材料相关专利者优先。
>4. 科研与项目综合素养
>具备严谨系统的科研逻辑、标准化规范化实验操作习惯，拥有独立项目统筹管理能力，可同步并行推进多项研发课题；具备优秀执行力、主动解决问题意识，擅长跨部门沟通协作，高效协同工艺、生产、工程团队解决产业化落地技术痛点。
>5. 职业特质与抗压能力
>能适应研发项目阶段性高强度工作，抗压能力突出；具备持续自主创新思维，愿意扎根材料研发与工业化落地，擅长直面并攻克实际工程化复杂难题。
>6. 价值观匹配
>深度认同公司碳捕集、负碳低碳产业发展使命，长期看好DAC、工业碳捕集赛道，对固态胺吸附材料研发、技术商业化落地抱有强烈热情，愿意伴随公司共同成长。

Founded in Hong Kong in 2016 by the French couple Delphine Lefay and Diego Dultzin Lacoste, OnTheList is a leading premium flash sales concept in Asia and the Middle-East. OnTheList works to minimize the problem of excess stock by turning past-season inventory into sustainable opportunities. OnTheList works directly with retail brands and official distributors, turning old inventory into opportunity by providing a sustainable way for brands to sell past-season items that would have otherwise ended up in landfills, while providing the best deals and steep discounts to our OnTheList members. We’ve since expanded to Singapore, Australia, Malaysia, Korea, Shanghai, Beijing, Thailand, and Dubai.

At OnTheList, our values guide everything we do: Family Spirit is driven by humility, fostering genuine connections with our community. jd:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .
Our people at JLL and JLL Technologies are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.
>
Position Overview
The Operations Manager manage the Hong Kong Operations team, ensuring high-quality, compliant, and efficient delivery of data center and server room services in alignment with client standards, SLAs, and business objectives. This role mainly manages the vendors and serves as the primary point of accountability for operational performance, resource planning, vendor coordination, and client satisfaction.
>
What this job involves:
Lead and manage the server room operations with consistent execution, including monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and incident resolution for IT infrastructure (servers, network equipment, power, cooling, etc.).
Oversee capacity planning for server rooms—tracking and forecasting power, cooling, rack space, loading, and network port utilization to support current and future needs. Collaborate with IT and facilities teams to optimize layout and resource allocation.
Review, validate and approve all change requests, permits, and documentation related to IT hardware work including installation, decommissioning, migrations, refreshes, and any other works that may have potential impact.
Manage relationships with vendors and third-party service providers; approve work schedules, supervise on-site activities, and ensure deliverables meet client standards and contractual obligations.
Maintain strict compliance with physical security protocols and environmental controls (temperature, humidity, power redundancy) in all server room facilities.
Ensure accurate and up-to-date inventory records of hardware, software, and network components using designated tools (e.g., Patch Manager).
Drive the development, review, and continuous improvement of standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all server room activities.
Enforce adherence to client policies, industry best practices (e.g., ISO, TIA-942), and regulatory requirements governing data center operations.
Lead participation in disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution to ensure client business continuity.
Collaborate closely with regional IT, facilities, and client teams to align operations with broader technical and strategic goals.
Stay current with emerging data center technologies, trends, and operational efficiencies to enhance service delivery.
>
Required Skills and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in data center or server room operations, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or team lead capacity.
Demonstrated expertise in data center infrastructure, including power, cooling, cabling standards, and hardware lifecycle management.
In-depth knowledge of cabling standard and cable management in data center.
Knowledge in using all standard cable testers used in data centers (e.g., Fluke Networks, VIAVI , or comparable tools) to verify and certify copper and fiber cabling integrity.
Strong knowledge of building services engineering and facility management principles.
Strong troubleshooting and incident handling skills and ability to follow technical procedures accurately.
Experience with ServiceNow or similar ticketing systems is highly desirable.
Proven ability to manage vendors, incidents, and cross-functional projects under tight deadlines.
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Professional certifications such as CDCP, CDCS, CCNA, MCSE, or PMP are highly desirable.
Ability to work collaboratively across local and regional teams and with external vendors.
Fluent Cantonese, English and Mandarin skills are mandatory.
>
This role is part of the APAC Operations team and reports to the APAC Engineering Operations Leadership, and may require occasional travel within Asia. The Operations Manager is accountable for team performance, client satisfaction, and operational excellence across all managed sites in Hong Kong.
>
Location:
On-site –Hong Kong, SAR, China
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

title: Manager, Firewall & Load Balancer Administrator

jd:
Main Responsibilities
Firewall Administration ​
Manage and maintain enterprise firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Checkpoint, F5) across data centers, offices, and branches. ​
Implement and enforce network security policies, access control lists (ACLs), and VPN configurations. ​
Monitor firewall logs and alerts to detect and respond to potential threats. ​
Support secure and reliable connectivity between Hong Kong and Mainland China branches. ​
​Load Balancer Management ​
Administer load balancing platforms (e.g., F5 BIG-IP) to ensure high availability and performance of critical applications. ​
Configure and optimize load balancing rules, SSL offloading, and traffic distribution. ​
Troubleshoot application delivery issues and coordinate with application and infrastructure teams. ​
System Monitoring and Capacity Planning ​
Configure and support SNMP messaging for system monitoring integration. ​
Monitor system performance and resource usage to support proactive planning. ​
Provide annual capacity planning reports covering system utilization and growth forecasts. ​
Patch and Upgrade ​
Perform firmware and software upgrades and patch management to address end-of-support and security vulnerabilities. ​
Upgrade any legacy End-of-Support (EOS) hardware and software components to ensure continued vendor support and system reliability​
Governance & Reporting ​
Maintain documentation for audits and compliance reviews. ​
Conduct System Acceptance Testing (SAT) and user account reviews on a semi-annual basis. ​
Ensure compliance with cross-border data transmission regulations and internal security standards. ​
Disaster Recovery & Resilience ​
Setup and maintain configuration backup to ensure recoverability. ​
Prepare and maintain system disaster recovery (DR) failover procedures. ​
Activate and support DR systems during annual DR drills. ​
Incident & Problem Management ​
Act as first-line response for firewall and load balancer-related incident resolution efforts, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive and corrective actions. ​
Project & Change Management ​
Coordinate in infrastructure projects involving firewall and load balancer deployments or upgrades. ​
Liaise with vendors for procurement, installation, support of relevant hardware and software.​
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Minimum of 5-8 years of experience in firewall administration, load balancer management, and infrastructure operations.
Hands-on experience with Palo Alto, Checkpoint, F5 BIG-IP , VPNs, ACLs, and FireMon for firewall policy management.
Strong knowledge of patching, system upgrades, capacity planning, and disaster recovery.
Familiar with audit support, compliance standards, and cross-border data regulations.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and documentation abilities.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
Prior experience working in the banking industry is preferred.

Monitoring & Alerts: Set up and maintain application alerts, dashboards, and runbooks to detect issues proactively. Respond to incidents and participate in bridge calls until system stability is restored. •
Production Support: Provide timely technical support for production issues, ensuring minimal business disruption and timely resolution.
(5) Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
Technical Documentation: Create and maintain clear, concise technical documentation for reference, reporting, and quality assurance purposes, including AI integration guidelines and prompt libraries.
Knowledge Transfer: Contribute to the team's collective knowledge by documenting root causes, solutions, and best practices for future reference.
(6) Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-regional teams (Vietnam, China) to ensure seamless integration between pre-production, production, and corporate systems.

Job Title: Technical Consultant — Application Support
Location: Causeway Bay, Hong Kong
Job Type: Full-Time
About the Role
Are you the type of person who isn't satisfied with just "turning it off and on again"? Do you want to know why a system failed?
We're looking for a Technical Consultant (Application Support) to be the front-line technical contact for our enterprise solutions. We build self-hosted products on cloud infrastructure that integrate with platforms like ServiceNow and Salesforce. In this role you'll own the front-line technical relationship with our customers — handling enquiries, troubleshooting issues, and guiding users on product features.
This is a support-focused role, but not a script-reading one. We use AI tools daily and expect you to as well — but we need someone who understands what those tools produce and can recognise when an answer is wrong. Fundamentals matter here more than any single platform certification. For a candidate who shows genuine technical depth and consultative instinct, this role is a stepping stone toward a Solution Consultant position.
Responsibilities
Customer Support & Logging: Act as the first point of contact for customer enquiries, providing clear, empathetic, and timely assistance. Maintain accurate logs for every enquiry to ensure proper tracking and resolution.
Troubleshooting & Investigation: Investigate system errors, failed integrations, and operational issues. Dig into logs to find root causes rather than simply escalating. Your scope includes our self-hosted cloud products and their integrations with ServiceNow and Salesforce.
Feature Guidance: Help customers set up and make effective use of platform and product features.
Project & Documentation Support: Assist senior consultants with configuration, light scripting, technical documentation, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) as needed.
On-Call: Occasional urgent support outside office hours on a rotation (compensated with time off in lieu).
Requirements
Education: Degree in any discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience: Around 2 years or more in IT support, application support, helpdesk, or platform/implementation work — but strong fundamentals matter more than years on paper. We'd rather hire a curious candidate who truly understands their systems than someone with longer experience who only follows instructions.
The Investigator Mindset: A logical, systems-thinking approach to troubleshooting. You can explain how something works , not just what to click — and you can reason through a problem without depending on AI to think for you.
Demonstrated Platform Depth: Genuine working knowledge of at least one enterprise platform or cloud application environment (e.g. ServiceNow, Salesforce, or comparable). We don't expect mastery of all of them — we expect evidence that you can learn a platform deeply rather than superficially.
Language: Fluency in Cantonese, English, and Mandarin.
Strong Pluses
Infrastructure and networking knowledge (ports, protocols, server communication) — particularly useful for ServiceNow ITOM Discovery / Service Mapping and for troubleshooting cloud-hosted applications.
Certifications in ServiceNow, Salesforce, a major cloud platform (AWS / Azure / GCP), or CCNA.
Exposure to integrations or REST/SOAP APIs.
What We Offer
5-day work week (Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM).
Annual leave, plus time off in lieu for any out-of-hours support.
Active mentorship and a clear pathway toward a Solution Consultant role.
>
About Recur Limited (~100 words)
Recur Limited is a Hong Kong-based technology consulting firm helping enterprises across Hong Kong and Macau modernise the way they run their service operations.
We specialise in the ServiceNow and Salesforce ecosystems, and we build self-hosted cloud products that extend these platforms into the workflows our clients actually need. Our team works across pre-sales, solution design, implementation, and ongoing support, partnering closely with clients from scoping through go-live and beyond.
We're a lean, technically-driven team that believes fundamentals matter more than buzzwords, and we invest in consultants who want to grow deep expertise alongside genuine consultative skill.
>

jd:
Founded in 1994 and awarded the University title in 2016, The Education University of Hong Kong (EdUHK) is a publicly funded university, dedicated to the advancement of teacher education and related disciplines through a diverse offering of academic, professional and research programmes. The University aspires to become a leading university in the Asia Pacific region and beyond, with a focus on educational and multidisciplinary research, development and innovation. We are committed to nurturing outstanding and caring educators and professionals as well as enhancing the impact of scholarship.
The University has an academic/teaching staff strength of about 460 and total student headcount of about 11,000. It has a Graduate School and three Faculties, namely, Faculty of Education and Human Development, Faculty of Humanities, and Faculty of Liberal Arts and Social Sciences, comprising 14 academic departments, as well as two Academies, Academy for Educational Development and Innovation and Academy for Applied Policy Studies and Education Futures, a number of University-level research centres and Faculty-level research and professional development centres. For more information about the University, please visit http://www.eduhk.hk.
We are looking for suitable candidate(s) to fill the following position(s). If you are excited by the prospect of contributing your expertise to the development of a leading university at the heart of Asia Pacific region and beyond, we would like to hear from you.
Deputy Librarian (Ref: 2600718)
Library
Applications are invited for the position of Deputy Librarian in the University Library. The Library is the key venue and platform of learning, teaching and research of the University, and currently houses one of the most comprehensive collections on education-related subjects and themes in Asia, and a growing collection in complementary disciplines including humanities, social sciences, and creative arts and culture. It consists of the Mong Man Wai Library on the Tai Po Campus and the Tseung Kwan O Study Centre Library. The Library’s total collections exceed 909,000 print and media materials, 152,000 e-journals, 3 million e-books and over 360 on-line databases.
Reporting to the Librarian, the Deputy Librarian is a key member of the Library’s senior management team. He/she will assist and advise the Librarian on the strategic development and transformation of the Library towards emerging areas in higher education such as AI, e-learning, digital scholarship, data science, etc. He/she will lead and coordinate the planning and implementation of new initiatives on service and resource enhancements, and will respond rapidly and proactively to all new developments in learning, teaching and research in higher education. The Deputy Librarian will also assist and deputise the Librarian in overall administration of the Library, formulation of policies, quality assurance of library services, overseeing all Library Sections and Units, as well as working closely with the administration, Academies, Faculties, academic departments and other units of the University, JULAC members and other external partners of the Library.
Applicants should have:
A proven track record of leadership in a university library or relevant key offices, particularly in change management, new service development, new technology applications, etc.;
In-depth knowledge on the latest trends and developments in all major aspects of library and information services;
At least 15 years of post-qualification experience, at least 7 years of which should be at managerial level;
A recognized undergraduate degree plus a postgraduate qualification preferably in librarianship or information management (e.g. ALA-accredited MLS, MCLIP, etc.), postgraduate qualifications in relevant disciplines such as information technology, computer science, data science, management science, etc. will also be considered;
Strong communication, inter-personal and organizational skills;
Proficiency in both Chinese and English will be an advantage.

jd:
ACW Distribution (HK) LTD. is a leading IT solution distributor in Hong Kong for 40 years. To support our expansion, we invite high caliber professionals to join us.

We are seeking a highly skilled and adaptable Senior BI Developer (Multi-Platform) to spearhead our enterprise-wide Business Intelligence (BI) and Data Analytics strategy. This is a critical technical and leadership role within the EBS department. You will serve as our principal architect and administrator, managing a diverse multi-BI tool environment that includes Tableau, FanRuan (FineBI/FineReport), GuanData (观远数据), and Microsoft Power BI .
In this role, you will be responsible for defining our multi-platform visualization roadmap, designing robust data modeling standards, and leading BI project delivery with at least 2 years of hands-on project management experience . You will act as the vital bridge translating complex business logic from senior stakeholders into high-performance, interactive, and localized executive dashboards.
Key Responsibilities
1. Multi-Platform BI Architecture & Administration
Platform Administration: Act as the enterprise administrator for our suite of BI tools, managing multi-tenant sites, licensing, workspace permissions, and gateway configurations across Tableau Server/Cloud, FanRuan (FineBI), GuanData, and Power BI .
Unified Data Governance: Design and implement robust Row-Level Security (RLS) and data masking policies across all four platforms to safeguard sensitive regional financial and operational data.
Performance Optimization: Audit, monitor, and optimize dashboard performance. Direct extract refresh schedules, troubleshoot connection failures, and manage hybrid on-premises and cloud gateways (e.g., Tableau Bridge, FanRuan FineDataLink, and Power BI Gateways).
Cross-Platform Migration: Evaluate business cases to migrate and standardize legacy Excel/SAS reporting models into high-performance dynamic templates across the supported BI tools.
2. Advanced Modeling & Visual Analytics
Multi-Platform Modeling: Master the underlying modeling engines of each tool:
Tableau: Build complex visual metrics using Level of Detail (LOD) expressions, parameters, and Tableau Prep pipelines.
Power BI: Architect reusable semantic data models and write advanced DAX measures for time-intelligence and dynamic KPIs (e.g., MoM%, YTD%, GP Margin).
FanRuan & GuanData: Utilize FineReport/FineBI SQL datasets and GuanData's agile modeling layers to support localized Chinese reporting formats and quick-response retail operations dashboards.
Data Cleaning & Pipeline Management: Collaborate with data engineers to build automated batch ETL/ELT pipelines, consolidating multi-source transactional datasets (from SAP S/4HANA, Google BigQuery, or CRMs) into structured schemas ready for multi-BI consumption.
3. BI Project Delivery & Project Management (Core Focus)
End-to-End Delivery (2+ Years Exp.): Manage the complete project lifecycle for analytics initiatives, from requirement gathering and metric definition to User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment, and post-go-live training.
Agile Task Coordination: Track tasks, dependencies, and critical milestones across cross-functional engineering and business teams using collaborative tools like Jira, Confluence, and MS Project .
SOPs & Documentation: Author comprehensive Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, data dictionaries, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to maintain structural documentation accuracy and enable self-service analytics.
4. Emerging AI & BI Innovations
AI-Enabled Workflows: Implement AI-driven automation workflows (using tools like Dify, LLM APIs, and LangChain) to parse unstructured files and integrate intelligence directly into dashboard reporting systems.
Chat BI Integrations: Experiment with and deploy natural-language query tools, enabling business users to query BI semantic models and retrieve metrics via conversational chatbot interfaces.
Job Requirements
Education & Experience
Academic Background: Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics , Statistics, or related technical fields.
Professional Experience: 3 to 5+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise BI development, data analysis, and reporting.
BI Project Management: Minimum 2 years of direct experience managing and delivering complex BI projects from initial scoping through to deployment.
Infrastructure Admin: Proven experience configuring, managing, and maintaining enterprise-level server environments for Tableau, FanRuan, or Power BI.
Technical & Specialized Skills
BI Tool Ecosystem:
Expert level : Tableau (Desktop, Prep, Server/Cloud) and Power BI (DAX, Power Query).
Strong proficiency : FanRuan (FineBI/FineReport) and GuanData .
Advanced SQL & Scripting: Expert-level SQL proficiency (writing complex window functions, CTEs, and multi-table joins). Experience with Python (Pandas, NumPy) for scripting and data automation.
Big Data Environments: Experience interacting with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google BigQuery, AWS, SAP ERP, or Snowflake ).
Certifications (Highly Valued):
Tableau Certified Data Analyst or Tableau Certified Server Administrator
FanRuan FCP-FineBI / FCA-FineDataLink
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate
PMP (Project Management Professional) or Certified Scrum Master (CSM)

Conduct detailed requirement studies and participate in core system architecture, application design, system development, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

Provide comprehensive tier-3 maintenance and deployment support for external and internal web applications, API platforms, and backend modules.

Degree, Diploma, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related disciplines.

Coordinate with internal users and external vendors to provide application support, troubleshooting, and system recovery
Prepare operational procedures, technical reports, and contingency plans
Monitor contractor deliverables to ensure they are high-quality and submitted on time

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Engineering, or a related IT discipline
Minimum 4 years of IT industry experience, with a focus on system analysis, development, testing, deployment, and vendor management
Strong technical proficiency in C#, .NET, ReactJS, VBA, Web Services, SQL, Stored Procedures, Kubernetes, Docker, Microservices, and MSSQL
Hands-on experience in JavaScript Programming, Linux System Administration, and Client/Server Development.
Familiarity with IT Security, Security Risk Assessment and Audit (SRAA), and Server Virtualization Technology

About us
>
>N PLUS BURGER COMPANY LIMITED is a dynamic and growing food and beverage organisation committed to delivering exceptional dining experiences. >

>
Managing and supervising all front-of-house and back-of-house staff, including scheduling, training, performance management and development
Ensuring exceptional customer service standards are maintained at all times through staff coaching and quality assurance checks
Overseeing daily restaurant operations, including opening and closing procedures, inventory management and cash handling
Monitoring and maintaining food safety, hygiene and health and safety standards in compliance with all relevant regulations
Managing budgets, controlling costs, maximising profitability and analysing financial performance against targets
Maintaining restaurant facilities and equipment in good working order, coordinating maintenance and repairs as needed
Responding to and resolving customer complaints promptly and professionally to ensure customer satisfaction
Implementing restaurant policies and procedures whilst driving continuous improvement initiatives
Liaising with head office on operational matters, reporting on performance metrics and contributing to strategic planning
Recruiting, hiring and retaining quality staff members to build a strong and motivated team
>
What we're looking for
>
>
Proven experience of at least 3-5 years in a restaurant management or similar hospitality management role
Strong leadership and team management capabilities with the ability to inspire, motivate and develop staff at all levels
Excellent customer service orientation with a proven track record of delivering exceptional dining experiences
Sound knowledge of food safety, health and safety regulations and best practices within the hospitality industry
Strong financial acumen with experience in budget management, cost control and P&L analysis
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build positive relationships with customers, staff and stakeholders
Problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound decisions under pressure
Proficiency in restaurant management systems and point-of-sale (POS) software
Fluency in English and Cantonese (written and spoken) is highly desirable
A flexible approach to working hours, including evenings, weekends and public holidays as required by the business
>
What we offer

>We are committed to supporting the wellbeing and professional development of our team members. We offer competitive compensation packages commensurate with experience, opportunities for career progression within our growing organisation, and a supportive work environment where your contributions are valued. We provide ongoing training and development opportunities to help you enhance your skills and advance your career in the hospitality sector. We also offer staff benefits including meal discounts and a positive workplace culture that celebrates teamwork and excellence.
Apply now
>
>If you are an enthusiastic and experienced Restaurant Manager ready to make an impact in a vibrant hospitality environment, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a cover letter outlining your relevant experience, and references from previous employers. Join our team and help us deliver outstanding dining experiences to our customers.
