jd:
We are seeking an Assistant Manager – Digital Marketing & Operations who is as capable working with website architecture and technical configurations as they are with campaign execution. In this role, you will bridge the gap between IT functionality, data-driven decision making, and marketing goals.
>
Core Responsibilities
Website Management & Technical Lead
· Serve as the primary administrator and technical lead for the HKBN Enterprise Solutions website (WordPress).
· Build, optimise, and maintain web pages; manage backend setup; and oversee website content using WordPress or other CMS platforms. Ensure proper functionality of third-party tools, extensions, and theme performance.
· Lead technical troubleshooting efforts – diagnosing and resolving issues related to hosting, server errors, software conflicts, and site speed.
· Manage the UAT (User Acceptance Testing) process for new features or site updates; validate fixes and coordinate with external web vendors to ensure continuous site enhancements.
· Oversee website integrations, including ad tracking codes (Google Tag Manager), analytics platforms, and CRM connectors (Salesforce), ensuring data accuracy and integrity across all systems.
>
E-commerce & Digital Operations
· Manage e-commerce operations, overseeing solution listings, customer lead acquisitions, and the technical integration of online customer journeys.
· Ensure the seamless flow of data between the website, CRM (Salesforce), and other marketing tools to support lead generation and data hygiene.
· Drive brand growth and ROI across digital channels, including Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn, Salesforce, and other emerging platforms.
>
Performance, Data & Analytics
· Own web analytics (Google Analytics, Looker Studio) to monitor site health, user behaviour, and conversion performance – enhancing the overall effectiveness of our online presence.
· Translate complex data into actionable insights; use data to recommend technical improvements (e.g., page speed optimisation) and UX enhancements that drive conversion rates.
· Establish data tracking frameworks to ensure accurate measurement of campaign performance and user interactions.
· Analyse campaign data (traffic, leads, conversions, visibility) and provide recommendations to maximise effectiveness.
>
Marketing Campaign Support
· Execute the technical setup of digital campaigns (Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn), including tracking pixels and data collection.
· Drive SEO performance through technical best practices (site structure, schema markup) in partnership with the content team.
· Execute eDM campaigns via Salesforce Marketing Cloud, handling segmentation, journey setup, and A/B testing.
· Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to align website and e-commerce activities with broader marketing objectives.
· Stay up to date on the latest digital marketing technologies and trends.
>
The Following Attributes will be Valued
· University graduate with at least 5 years of relevant experience; background in agency, website UI/UX management, e-commerce, or B2B IT/technology sectors is preferred.
· Strong IT and technical mindset – you understand WordPress architecture, how third-party tools interact, and how to fix a broken site without relying on a developer for every small task.
· Hands-on experience with website management: proven ability to manage backend setups, coordinate UAT, troubleshoot issues, and work with vendors on web development projects.
· Data literacy: ability to work with data – extract reports, identify trends, and make recommendations based on quantitative insights.
· Knowledge of digital tools: proficiency in Google Analytics, Google Ads, Google Tag Manager, Salesforce, and Looker Studio is considered a strong asset.
· Coding knowledge (basic HTML, CSS, or PHP) is a plus, allowing you to make minor customisations without external help.
· Solid understanding of digital platforms and how to leverage them to drive traffic and engagement.
· A self-motivated and passionate individual who can drive continuous improvement to achieve company goals.
· A good team player with strong interpersonal skills to deal with both internal parties (marketing, sales) and external partners (agencies).
· Proactive, flexible, and creative with a problem-solving attitude.
· Proficiency in spoken and written English and Chinese.
· Capable of working efficiently to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

title: Sous Chef Catering & Strong Asian Cuisine
teaser: Experienced Sous Chef to oversee kitchen catering operations
bullet_points: Friendly working environment, no late nights, large commercial kitchen
Incentive and bonus
Location close to Wong Chuk Hang MTR
jd:
About the role
Shamrock Catering (established 1994) is seeking an experienced and proactive Sous Chef to join our modern, spacious central production kitchen in Wong Chuk Hang. Reporting to the Head Chef / Executive Chef, you will oversee and support the entire kitchen operation. This hands-on leadership role covers daily production for school meal boxes, bento concepts, canapés, banqueting, sit-down menus and delivery catering, as well as regular on-site event support. The role includes operational responsibility for two existing delivery concepts — Southside Pizza Co and Southside Rotisserie — plus the new Vietnamese concept Mr Bahn Mi. You will oversee and continuously improve quality, costs and workflow across these brands, and work closely with management to develop and refine the Mr Bahn Mi concept.
Key responsibilities
Oversee and support the full kitchen operation, ensuring consistent high standards of food quality, presentation, hygiene and efficiency across all production streams.
Oversee the day-to-day running of the two delivery concepts (Southside Pizza Co and Southside Rotisserie) and the new Mr Bahn Mi Vietnamese concept; actively improve existing quality standards, food costs and operational workflow.
Work closely with management to develop, refine and grow the Mr Bahn Mi concept, including menu development, production systems and quality consistency.
Support the Head Chef with all catering events and attend events regularly to supervise plating, service and quality control.
Develop and execute monthly and weekly meal plans and menu cycles within strict food-cost budgets.
Proactively propose and create new dishes on a regular basis — seasonal specials, innovative bento boxes, canapés and complete sit-down menus — with a strong focus on Southeast Asian flavours and current trends.
Manage the complete ordering process for ingredients and supplies, particularly for school lunch-box, bento and delivery programmes.
Calculate ingredient costs, maintain competitive pricing and implement effective food-waste reduction strategies.
Create, update and enforce standardised recipes and procedures to guarantee consistency across all concepts.
Train, supervise and motivate the kitchen team to uphold food safety, hygiene and quality standards.
About you
Minimum 10 years' professional experience in a catering company, private club, hotel or high-volume production kitchen.
Proven leadership experience supervising kitchen teams in a catering, club or hotel environment.
Strong practical expertise in Southeast Asian cuisine and banqueting.
Demonstrable ability and drive to create new seasonal dishes, bento boxes, canapés and sit-down menus regularly.
Ability to oversee and improve quality, costs and workflow across multiple concepts (delivery brands and new product lines).
Strong computer skills (menu software, costing tools, ordering platforms, Microsoft Office or equivalent).
Willingness and ability to attend client events regularly (including evenings and weekends as required).
Must be available for early morning starts when required and late finishes on request.
Solid knowledge of food safety, hygiene and HACCP procedures.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
About us
Shamrock Catering (established 1994) operates a modern, spacious central production kitchen in Wong Chuk Hang, Southern District, Hong Kong, just 5 minutes' walk from Wong Chuk Hang MTR station.

title: Senior BI Analyst
teaser: Multi-Platform Modeling
bullet_points: 5 day work
Tableau and Power BI
jd:
ACW Distribution (HK) LTD. is a leading IT solution distributor in Hong Kong for 40 years. To support our expansion, we invite high caliber professionals to join us.
>
We are seeking a highly skilled and adaptable Senior BI Developer (Multi-Platform) to spearhead our enterprise-wide Business Intelligence (BI) and Data Analytics strategy. This is a critical technical and leadership role within the EBS department. You will serve as our principal architect and administrator, managing a diverse multi-BI tool environment that includes Tableau, FanRuan (FineBI/FineReport), GuanData (观远数据), and Microsoft Power BI .
In this role, you will be responsible for defining our multi-platform visualization roadmap, designing robust data modeling standards, and leading BI project delivery with at least 2 years of hands-on project management experience . You will act as the vital bridge translating complex business logic from senior stakeholders into high-performance, interactive, and localized executive dashboards.
Key Responsibilities
1. Multi-Platform BI Architecture & Administration
Platform Administration: Act as the enterprise administrator for our suite of BI tools, managing multi-tenant sites, licensing, workspace permissions, and gateway configurations across Tableau Server/Cloud, FanRuan (FineBI), GuanData, and Power BI .
Unified Data Governance: Design and implement robust Row-Level Security (RLS) and data masking policies across all four platforms to safeguard sensitive regional financial and operational data.
Performance Optimization: Audit, monitor, and optimize dashboard performance. Direct extract refresh schedules, troubleshoot connection failures, and manage hybrid on-premises and cloud gateways (e.g., Tableau Bridge, FanRuan FineDataLink, and Power BI Gateways).
Cross-Platform Migration: Evaluate business cases to migrate and standardize legacy Excel/SAS reporting models into high-performance dynamic templates across the supported BI tools.
2. Advanced Modeling & Visual Analytics
Multi-Platform Modeling: Master the underlying modeling engines of each tool:
Tableau: Build complex visual metrics using Level of Detail (LOD) expressions, parameters, and Tableau Prep pipelines.
Power BI: Architect reusable semantic data models and write advanced DAX measures for time-intelligence and dynamic KPIs (e.g., MoM%, YTD%, GP Margin).
FanRuan & GuanData: Utilize FineReport/FineBI SQL datasets and GuanData's agile modeling layers to support localized Chinese reporting formats and quick-response retail operations dashboards.
Data Cleaning & Pipeline Management: Collaborate with data engineers to build automated batch ETL/ELT pipelines, consolidating multi-source transactional datasets (from SAP S/4HANA, Google BigQuery, or CRMs) into structured schemas ready for multi-BI consumption.
3. BI Project Delivery & Project Management (Core Focus)
End-to-End Delivery (2+ Years Exp.): Manage the complete project lifecycle for analytics initiatives, from requirement gathering and metric definition to User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment, and post-go-live training.
Agile Task Coordination: Track tasks, dependencies, and critical milestones across cross-functional engineering and business teams using collaborative tools like Jira, Confluence, and MS Project .
SOPs & Documentation: Author comprehensive Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, data dictionaries, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to maintain structural documentation accuracy and enable self-service analytics.
4. Emerging AI & BI Innovations
AI-Enabled Workflows: Implement AI-driven automation workflows (using tools like Dify, LLM APIs, and LangChain) to parse unstructured files and integrate intelligence directly into dashboard reporting systems.
Chat BI Integrations: Experiment with and deploy natural-language query tools, enabling business users to query BI semantic models and retrieve metrics via conversational chatbot interfaces.
Job Requirements
Education & Experience
Academic Background: Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics , Statistics, or related technical fields.
Professional Experience: 3 to 5+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise BI development, data analysis, and reporting.
BI Project Management: Minimum 2 years of direct experience managing and delivering complex BI projects from initial scoping through to deployment.
Infrastructure Admin: Proven experience configuring, managing, and maintaining enterprise-level server environments for Tableau, FanRuan, or Power BI.
Technical & Specialized Skills
BI Tool Ecosystem:
Expert level : Tableau (Desktop, Prep, Server/Cloud) and Power BI (DAX, Power Query).
Strong proficiency : FanRuan (FineBI/FineReport) and GuanData .
Advanced SQL & Scripting: Expert-level SQL proficiency (writing complex window functions, CTEs, and multi-table joins). Experience with Python (Pandas, NumPy) for scripting and data automation.
Big Data Environments: Experience interacting with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google BigQuery, AWS, SAP ERP, or Snowflake ).
Certifications (Highly Valued):
Tableau Certified Data Analyst or Tableau Certified Server Administrator
FanRuan FCP-FineBI / FCA-FineDataLink
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate
PMP (Project Management Professional) or Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
Language Requirements
Fluency in English and Mandarin (both written and spoken) is required to coordinate with regional technical teams and global stakeholders.

財務及營運經理 — 頂級腕錶零售

Legacy Artisan 是香港頂級腕錶零售商，成立六年。我們正在做一件香港零售業少有的事：
讓 AI 系統處理日常帳目，由人做把關。

我們期望你：
• 熟悉存貨密集型生意的帳務（存貨估值、賬齡、成本歸集）
• 熟練使用雲端會計系統，處理得到系統之間的對帳
• 具管理經驗——本崗位轄下有線要管，不是一個純做數的崗位
• 願意運用 AI 工具，並講得出如何覆核它的產出
入職條件：
• 會計學位，或專業會計資格（HKICPA／ACCA／CPA Australia 或同等）
• 中英文良好 ——能以中英文處理對外文件，及與銀行、核數師往來
• 持牌會計師，或具存貨密集型行業（零售／貿易）帳務經驗者優先
• 具管理經驗者優先
我們提供：
• 月薪 HK$25,000 – HK$33,000 （薪酬按經驗及面試表現釐定）＋表現花紅（達標另計）
• 工作時間：星期一至五 10:00 - 19:00；星期六 10:00 - 17:00（五天半工作）；所有紅日假期休息
• 晉升路徑：經理 → 高級經理 → 部門負責人
• AI 協作的財務營運崗位 ，走在行業前面
• 與創辦人直接共事，參與公司數碼化建設
關於 Legacy Artisan
Legacy Artisan 創立於 2020 年，是植根於香港的頂級腕錶 O2O 零售品牌，旗艦店位於尖沙咀 K11 Atelier Victoria Dockside。 品牌理念「Once upon a watch...」——以時間之名，見證生命奇蹟。 六年連續榮獲「正版正貨承諾」、「商界展關懷」認證。 我們正推進 AI 化營運升級，並開拓新的業務項目。
申請方法 ：請將履歷及可到職日期電郵至 ••••@legacyartisan.com 。
應徵者提供之個人資料絕對保密，只作招聘用途。
>
>
Finance & Operations Manager — Luxury Watch Retail
Legacy Artisan Limited | K11 Atelier Victoria Dockside, Tsim Sha Tsui
Every watch that passes through our hands must stand up to both the books and the stockroom. This role watches over both.
Legacy Artisan is a leading luxury watch retailer in Hong Kong, now in our sixth year. We are doing something few Hong Kong retailers have done: letting an AI system handle day-to-day bookkeeping, so that people can focus on getting things right.
A reconciliation produced by AI is not usable until you have checked it yourself. That is the line for this role.
What you will do:
• Monthly closing and reconciliation across two sets of books (retail / trade)
• Inventory discipline: ageing, slow-moving stock, capital tied up in each individual watch
• Managing the operations handover and quality control lines
• Day-to-day dealings with external accountants, banks and the MPF trustee
• Working with the company's AI tools, and reviewing their output yourself
What we look for:
• Familiar with inventory-heavy accounting (valuation, ageing, cost allocation)
• Fluent with cloud accounting systems and cross-system reconciliation
• Management experience — this role has lines to run, not just books to keep
• Willing to work with AI tools, and able to explain how you check their output
Requirements:
• A degree in Accounting, or a professional accounting qualification (HKICPA / ACCA / CPA Australia or equivalent)
• Good written Chinese and English — able to handle external documents and correspondence with banks and auditors in both
• Qualified accountants, or candidates with inventory-heavy (retail / trading) accounting experience, preferred
• Management experience preferred
What we offer:
• Monthly salary HK$25,000 – HK$33,000 (actual offer depends on experience and interview performance), plus a performance bonus on top when targets are met
• Hours: Monday to Friday 10:00 - 19:00; Saturday 10:00 - 17:00 (5.5-day week); all public holidays off
• Career path: Manager → Senior Manager → Head of Department
• An AI-collaborative finance and operations role, ahead of the curve
• Direct work with the founder on the company's digitalisation
About Legacy Artisan
Founded in 2020, Legacy Artisan is a Hong Kong-based luxury watch O2O retailer, with our flagship at K11 Atelier Victoria Dockside, Tsim Sha Tsui. Our brand idea is "Once upon a watch..." — to bear witness to life's milestones, through the language of time. Certified under the Hong Kong "Genuine Goods Pledge" and "Caring Company" schemes for six consecutive years. We are advancing an AI-driven upgrade of our operations, alongside new business ventures.
To apply: please email your CV and availability to ••••@legacyartisan.com .

title: Data Engineer

jd:
About the Role
We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our AI Business Development Team and support the development of our AI-powered platforms and solutions across multiple project domains. The role’s primary focus is the platform, which is an AI-driven system that matches candidate CVs to job descriptions using semantic, embedding-based techniques, with involvement in other AI initiatives as required.
Responsibilities
Document Ingestion & Data Pipelines
• Design, build, and maintain OCR-based ingestion pipelines that convert CVs and job descriptions into structured, searchable data , operating on cloud-based infrastructure with secure storage and point-in-time data recovery, to support the AI matching workload (primarily batch processing).
• Develop and maintain scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines (e.g. on Apache Airflow) that extract, normalise, and feature-engineer CV and JD data for the matching engine.
• Integrate data from diverse sources, including internal databases, document files, and APIs.
• Design and maintain Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERD) and data schemas; produce data quality reports and implement data-validation frameworks.
• Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across the data lifecycle.
Semantic Matching & Embeddings
• Build and maintain the components that generate vector embeddings of CV and JD content (e.g. BERT) into the matching pipeline, and maintain vector storage and similarity search (e.g. PostgreSQL with pgvector).
• Support and extend the LLM-assisted domain dictionary used to map related skills and terminology (so that, for example, a requirement for one cloud platform recognises an equivalent platform).
• Tune and evaluate matching quality the relevance and ranking of CV–JD matches and iterate on the pipeline to improve accuracy.
• Support deployment of matching/embedding workloads into production and monitor their performance.
Cloud Infrastructure
• Implement and manage cloud-based data solutions (e.g. AWS S3 for storage, EC2/SageMaker for batch model compute, Lambda for orchestration where appropriate).
• Optimise data storage and processing for cost-efficiency and performance, particularly for batch embedding workloads.
• Support data-store and pipeline architecture design and maintenance.
Data Quality, Governance & Privacy
• Implement data validation, monitoring, and quality-assurance processes.
• Maintain documentation for data models, pipelines, and system architecture.
• Handle sensitive personal data (CV information) in compliance with the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (PDPO) and internal data-protection and egress controls.
>
Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field.
• Hands-on experience in data engineering or a related role, with strong Python and SQL for data processing. (Seniority open, see note below.)
• Experience with OCR-based document ingestion/parsing (e.g. extracting structured data from CVs, forms, or similar documents).
• Experience with NLP/text-processing techniques for document parsing and feature extraction.
• Experience with embeddings and vector search/vector databases (e.g. pgvector or equivalent).
• Experience using LLMs for data tasks, such as skill/terminology extraction, tagging, or generating a domain dictionary from text data.
• Experience with ETL tools and frameworks (e.g. Apache Airflow, dbt), and with relational databases (PostgreSQL essential; MongoDB or similar an advantage).
• Understanding of information-retrieval / matching concepts (ranking, relevance, similarity).
• Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably AWS (S3, EC2, Lambda; SageMaker for model compute).
• A relevant degree (Computer Science, IT, Data Engineering, or related), strong problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
>
Preferred (Bonus Skills)
• Experience with ML frameworks (e.g. scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow) or managed ML pipelines (e.g. SageMaker).
• Understanding of REST API development for data-service integration.
• Understanding of CI/CD practices and version control (Git).
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with sprint-based delivery.
• Relevant cloud or data-engineering certification (e.g. AWS Certified Data Engineer Associate) is advantageous.
• Familiarity with data-visualisation / BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, QuickSight).

1. Facilities Operations & Technical Support
Oversee the daily maintenance of various building services and proprietary facilities, including but not limited to electrical, HVAC, plumbing, and Fire Service Installations.
Provide hands-on technical support and work alongside the technician team to identify, diagnose, prompt resumption and solve complicate site issues and emergency breakdowns.

About the Role
We are seeking a skilled and proactive BIM E&M Coordinator to oversee the implementation, management, coordination, and production of BIM deliverables for 2–3 government infrastructure projects in Hong Kong. This is a key role that bridges design, construction, and facility management, ensuring that all BIM outputs meet client expectations and project standards.

CCBM (CIC Certified BIM Manager)
CCBC (CIC Certified BIM Coordinator)

Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail.

title: Specialist, Licensing and Regulatory Registrations Hong Kong
teaser: Expertly guide HK's regulatory compliance as a trusted advisor for a leading global bank.
jd:
Job Summary
>
The Specialist, Licensing and Regulatory Registrations, Hong Kong is a key team member responsible for the Bank’s first line coordination and execution of licensing, registration and regulatory approval activities across Hong Kong, ensuring the firm and relevant individuals maintain the permissions, registrations and notifications required to operate in compliance with applicable local regulatory requirements.
>This role carries out the day-to-day execution and coordination of licensing and regulatory registration processes, ensures timely submissions, renewals, notifications and record maintenance in line with the expectations of relevant Hong Kong regulators, including the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, Securities and Futures Commission, and other applicable regulatory bodies.
>The position acts as a trusted advisor to business, control and senior management stakeholders on licensing implications of organisational, personnel and business changes, supporting effective regulatory engagement, accurate documentation, and strong oversight of registration-related obligations across the Hong Kong franchise.
Key Responsibilities
>
Processes
>• Manage and coordinate licensing, registration and notification activities for the Hong Kong franchise, including submissions, renewals, variations and ongoing regulatory filings with relevant authorities.
>• Maintain the firm’s Hong Kong licensing and registration inventory, ensuring regulatory records, registers, approvals and supporting documentation remain accurate, complete and up to date.
>• Provide HKMA, SFC, IA and MPFA’s licensing-related advisory (e.g. registration, competence and fit and proper requirements).
>• Ensure timely regulatory filings for appointment/cessation/change of senior regulatory appointments (including HKMA S72B Manager, Appointee under Management Accountability Executive Officer, SFC Managers-in-Charge, Responsible Officer & Licensed Representative / IA Responsible Officer / MPFA Responsible Officer (“licensed individuals”)).
>• Liaise with business / other internal stakeholders and support engagement with regulators for arranging application, notification and cessation in relation to licensed individuals.
>• Keep track on staff’s movement and change of personal particular to file necessary regulatory notification.
>• Maintain licensing and registration record for regulated staffs and perform weekly reconciliation. Share licensing data to other counterparts for MI or other appropriate purpose.
>• Review and access CPT accreditation for licensed individuals. Formulate and generate CPT reports and ensure all licensed individuals have fulfilled the CPT training hours by year end.
>• Follow up on staff HKSI licensing examination status and ensure fulfilment of required license examination within the grace period
>• Arrange temporary HKMA Relevant Individual license for overseas staff if needed.
>• Assist in maintaining and updating licensing related policy/ process documents. Propose enhancement to the current licensing process to reduce operational errors or increase efficiency.
>• Conduct annual Fit and Proper attestation for the regulated roles and escalate any exception identified.
>• Remind the licensed individuals on regulatory notification / reporting requirements.
>• Assist to handle any audit request, compliance review or regulatory inspection relating to the HK licensing and registration processes.
>• Handle ad-hoc projects and other tasks as assigned.
People & Talent
>• Partner with local, regional and global stakeholders to coordinate licensing and registration requirements and ensure consistent implementation of regulatory obligations in Hong Kong.
>• Build effective working relationships with business leaders, Compliance, Legal, HR and Operations to assess regulatory impacts and support timely execution of approval and registration requirements.
>• Support transparent and professional engagement with regulators and internal stakeholders by delivering clear updates, accurate documentation and responsive issue management.
Risk Management
>• Ensure licensing and registration activities are conducted in line with applicable Hong Kong laws, regulations, regulatory guidance and internal policy requirements.
>• Promote strong awareness of licensing and registration obligations across relevant stakeholders, helping embed regulatory requirements into business-as-usual processes.
>• Identify, escalate and support remediation of licensing, registration and regulatory compliance risks, including issues arising from delayed submissions, incomplete records or changing business activities.
Governance
>• Design, implement and maintain robust processes and controls to support licensing, registration, renewal and notification activities, including governance, attestations, approvals and document retention.
>• Identify process gaps and drive continuous improvement to enhance efficiency, transparency and control across Hong Kong regulatory registration activities.
Regulatory & Business Conduct
>• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
>• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
>• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Key stakeholders
>• Compliance
>• Legal
>• HR
>• Operations
>• Authorities
Skills and Experience
>
• Governance
>• Risk Management
>• MS Office, Excel, Word & Power Point
Qualifications
>
• Familiar with HKMA, SFC, IA and MPFA’s licensing or regulated persons frameworks in Hong Kong.
>• Educated to degree level or equivalent, legal education/background would be very beneficial.
>• At least 2 years of relevant experience managing or supporting licensing, registration or regulatory approval processes in Hong Kong and engaging with regulators where required.
>• Ability to manage and handle the licensing and registration processes independently.
>• Ability to maintain confidentiality, demonstrating high levels of discretion and integrity.
>• Strong knowledge of governance, risk management and control frameworks relevant to regulated entities in Hong Kong.
>• Excellent knowledge of MS Office, including Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
>• Ability to work collaboratively across local or global teams in a dynamic environment.
About Standard Chartered
>
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
Together we:
Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
What we offer
>
In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

About the Role
>As our Digital Trust and Resilience Senior Analyst, you will lead and perform technology risk assessment and security compliance activities central to our global operations. You will coordinate annual IT internal and external audit programs, including ISO and SOC 2 certifications across our key markets. These certifications are critical to accelerating customer onboarding and streamlining annual regulatory audits worldwide. You will also run mandatory employee security awareness training globally, and drive the automation of evidence collection to improve efficiency. In this role, you will identify compliance gaps, support remediations, and provide technical guidance across all business units.
>AI is fundamental to how we work. In this position, you will help us build AI automations, workflows, and agents to boost the efficiency of Digital Trust & Resilience operations. You do not need to be an AI researcher. You just need to understand compliance risks and have a drive to learn and apply AI tools.
Responsibilities:
>
Coordinate and perform annual IT internal audits and external audits for ISO and SOC 2 certifications across global markets, ensuring certifications are maintained to support customer and partner onboarding and regulatory audit readiness
Run global, regulator-mandated employee security awareness and compliance training campaigns, including tracking, reporting, and continuous improvement
Automate evidence collection and compliance workflows to drive efficiency gains and scale operations in response to growing regulatory demands
Participate in internal security and privacy assessments, external audits, compliance certifications, and risk management activities
Provide complete and accurate responses to internal and third-party enquiries on security compliance
Perform periodic technical, organizational, and third-party risk and control assessments, and manage remediation activities to completion
Design and maintain control frameworks required to comply with international standards and local regulations across all operating jurisdictions
Identify and drive process improvements to streamline global security compliance operations and protect team capacity

At least 2-5 years of experience in information security, privacy, IT audit, or IT risk management
Demonstrated experience conducting IT internal and/or external audits, including ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 22301, ISO 42001, SOC 1, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, SOX, cloud technologies, and data protection or equivalent certifications and regulations
Experience running compliance training programs and reporting for a global workforce
Hands-on experience with evidence collection automation or compliance workflow AI tooling is a strong advantage
Experience working with external auditors and/or regulators
Preferred:
Proficiency in English with the ability to engage overseas counterparts and auditors
Experience in information security and privacy management in virtual assets, fintech, artificial intelligence (AI), online services, and global platform services
Relevant certifications, such as CISSP, CRISC, CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 LA, CIPT, CIPP/E, or CIPP/US
Knowledge of global regulatory frameworks and demonstrated experience managing regulator relationships across jurisdictions, including GDPR, DORA, CFTC, MiCA, HKMA, and HK SFC.
Experience establishing information security and privacy frameworks to meet local regulatory requirements
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical issues for non-technical business stakeholders
Interest and understanding of Blockchain and AI technologies
Collaborative team player with a positive attitude, detail-oriented mindset, and commitment to continuous learning

title: Head of Operations
location: San Po Kong, Wong Tai Sin District
teaser: Run product development, sourcing and commercial ops for our AI-native platform — factories across Asia, distributors across EMEA.
jd:
About us
F. Bosch International Limited is the Hong Kong arm of the German medical brand F. Bosch (est. 1924). We distribute high-quality medical and hospital supplies to B2B customers across EMEA and the Americas.
We run the business on our own AI-native platform: a Customer Portal, a Supplier Portal and an online Order Builder that lets a distributor put together a full container order and pay for it without a single email. It is built with AI and built for AI, and we are now extending that approach across the whole operation. This role is central to it.
What you will do
We work with AI in everything we do. Not as a tool you reach for occasionally, but as the default way every task gets done. If you are doing something manually that a model or an agent could do better, that is the problem to solve, not the job.
We are looking for someone who wants to grow the company and grow with it. You will own how F. Bosch operates and you will be expected to keep raising the bar: faster, cleaner, more automated, every quarter. If you see a process that should not exist, kill it. If you see something the team should be doing better, say so. We want someone who pushes, not someone who waits to be asked.
You will sit at the centre of both sides of the funnel. Factories in China, Malaysia and Thailand on one side. Importing distributors across Europe, the Middle East and Africa on the other. Understanding both, and connecting them well, is what makes this business work.
You will work in a high-caliber team alongside AI engineers and builders and commercial operations colleagues. You will have significant independence and the mandate to decide how best to build and coordinate external resources (auditors, accountants, creative studios, regulatory consultants) while continuously upgrading and updating the tech stack.
Product development and quality
• Develop products for the markets we sell into: specification, materials, sizing, packaging format and how each product is positioned against what is already on the shelf
• Own the creative side of building a branded product from scratch, including artwork, packaging design, multi-language labelling and instructions for use, working with our designer and the factories, and keep upgrading it as markets and regulations move
• Strengthen the inspection regime. We already inspect: third-party pre-shipment inspections, factory audits, laboratory testing and batch verification are part of how we ship. Your job is to take that further: tighten it, systematise it, and use AI to make it faster and harder to slip through
• Own regulatory compliance and get it right, not just adequate: EU MDR, PPE Regulation, ISO 13485, EN 455 and the technical files behind them
• Hold the line. We ship under a hundred-year German name and the target is zero defects, not acceptable defects
Commercial
• Onboard new distributors: run them through partnership application, documentation, payment terms and first order, and make the experience fast and impressive
• Onboard new suppliers: qualification, documentation, pricing structure and terms
• Negotiate with factories on pricing, minimum order quantities, lead times and payment terms. You will own real commercial outcomes, not just paperwork
• Be a direct point of contact for customers and factories, and build genuine relationships on both sides
• Look for margin wherever it is hiding: better sourcing, better mix, better terms, fewer wasted steps
Operations
• Design, build and run AI workflows that handle banking payments (including Airwallex), monthly payroll, supplier bills, sales invoices and bank reconciliation in Zoho Books
• Maintain and continuously improve accounting records, monthly closings, budgets and payment tracking
• Coordinate with freight forwarders and factories on shipping documentation, payment schedules and delivery timelines
• Handle company administrative matters: insurance renewals, government filings, regulatory correspondence
• Support the Managing Director with ad-hoc coordination and systems work
• Understand every process end-to-end, question the current flow, and design smart ways to automate, AI-charge and continuously upgrade them so that the Order Builder experience and overall operations keep improving
In-person tasks (sporadic)
• Collect shipping documents from Mong Kok
• Visit the office for mail collection, registrations and the annual ISO audit
What we are looking for
• Native or near-native English, written and spoken. This is essential: you will negotiate with factories, correspond with European distributors and Hong Kong regulators, and represent the company in writing
• You must already have the right to work in Hong Kong. We are not sponsoring a visa for this role
• You already work AI-first. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, agents, automation platforms, whatever gets the job done. Tell us what you have built or automated, however small
• Commercial, entrepreneurial instinct. You enjoy negotiating, you are comfortable asking for a better price, and you think about margin without being asked to
• Ambitious, and open about it. You want more scope in twelve months than you have on day one
• Comfortable holding colleagues, suppliers and partners to deadlines and quality, including people who do not report to you
• Comfortable with cloud software (Zoho Books, Google Workspace, Microsoft Excel, Airwallex) and basic bookkeeping
• Self-starter who thrives with autonomy and can manage their own schedule with minimal supervision
• You measure yourself on outcomes, not hours logged
• Organised, reliable, detail-oriented and proactive
• Based in Hong Kong with ability to travel to Mong Kok and San Po Kong when needed
• Diploma or degree preferred. 0 to 5 years relevant experience welcome if AI capability is strong

Experience building simple AI agents, document automation, or process automation. Working Cantonese is useful for Mong Kok document collection and government filings. title: Card Specialist
teaser: Turn your TCG passion into a career! Join us as a Card Specialist to authenticate high-value collectibles and manage premium grading submissions.
jd:
About the role
We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Card Specialist / Card Grader to join our retail and grading operations team. The role will be responsible for assessing, authenticating and pre-grading trading cards, sports cards and other collectibles, while in charging the end-to-end grading submission process and customer journey.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in card grading, grading submissions, card shop operations or high-volume card handling. He/she should have deep knowledge of TCG, sports cards, card condition assessment, grading standards, market trends and collector behaviour, with the integrity and attention to detail required to handle high-value collectibles.
Key responsibilities
Conduct detailed visual inspections of trading cards, sports cards and collectibles to assess surface condition, corners, edges, centering, print quality and overall card condition.
Research, identify and authenticate collectible cards, including detecting reprints, alterations, trimming, counterfeits, printing errors and suspicious items.
Apply established grading standards and company-specific criteria consistently when assessing card condition and expected grading outcomes.
Pre-grade customer and shop submissions across major grading authorities, including PSA, BGS and CGC, and advise on suitable grading tiers and realistic expected outcomes.
Manage the end-to-end grading submission process, including card assessment, order creation, packaging, shipping, tracking, receiving and customer updates.
Accurately record card details, grading assessments, serial numbers, submission status and customer information in the inventory / submission management system.
Support quality control by maintaining consistent, fair and objective grading standards across all submissions and internal assessments.
Handle, sleeve, package and store high-value cards safely to protect their condition throughout the grading and submission process.
Evaluate walk-in collections and individual cards for buy, sell and trade-in opportunities, providing fair and informed valuations where required.
Monitor secondary market prices, card trends, population reports, grading results and customer demand to support accurate assessments and commercial decisions.
Assist customers with grading enquiries, card condition explanations, submission options and basic market information in a clear and professional manner.
Support the development and improvement of grading submission SOPs, workflow, record-keeping and handling procedures.
Share product knowledge, grading observations and market insights with the store team, and help train junior staff on basic grading and handling practices.
Maintain a clean, organized and secure work environment for card inspection, storage and handling.
Perform other duties as assigned to support grading operations, shop floor activities and business needs.
Requirements
3 years or above hands-on experience in card grading, grading submissions, card shop retail, trading card dealing, collectibles operations or high-volume card handling is preferred.
Deep knowledge of TCG, including Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, sports cards, including NBA, MLB, NFL, football or other major trading and sports cards is a must.
Good understanding of grading standards, card condition assessment, grading tiers, submission procedures and the collector market.
Familiarity with PSA, BGS, CGC or other recognized grading authorities, including submission processes, grading standards and fee structures.
Eye for Detail: Exceptional visual acuity and the ability to identify card condition issues, including scratches, dents, whitening, print lines, centering issues, surface wear, edge damage and corner wear.
Experience identifying altered, trimmed, counterfeit or otherwise suspicious cards is highly preferred.
Strong attention to detail, visual accuracy and manual dexterity when handling fragile or high-value cards.
High level of Integrity and ethical standards; must be honest and objective to maintain the shop's reputation.
Familiarity with comic book grading standards (CGC / CBCS) and experience assessing non-card collectibles is a plus.
Good interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain grading results and submission options to customers where required.
Good command of Cantonese; English and Mandarin are preferred, ability to communicate in Japanese is a plus but not required.
Able to work independently while also supporting the wider retail and operations team.
Certification, training or prior working experience with a recognized grading authority such as PSA, BGS, CGC or equivalent is a plus.
Why Join Us?
Join a fast-growing Hong Kong brand at the forefront of the trading card and collectibles market, combining professional grading knowledge, premium retail service and strong collector community engagement.
You will play a key role in building trust with collectors by supporting accurate card assessment, transparent grading submissions and responsible handling of high-value collectibles. The role offers hands-on exposure to TCG, sports cards, graded cards, submission logistics, market pricing, customer engagement and daily store operations.
We offer a competitive compensation package with career development opportunities as the brand expands its retail, grading submission, eCommerce and community presence.
We take care of our teammates to take great care of themselves and their families so we all can perform our best at work!
25-day paid time off, 20-week maternity, 8-week paternity, plus family/pet care, marriage, birthday Leave, and more.
US$1.5M Health insurance per teammate
Life insurance

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory Affairs professional with hands-on experience in generic drug registration, gap analysis and HA (Hospital Authority) tendering processes in Hong Kong. In this role, you will ensure compliance with local regulatory requirements, manage submissions to the Department of Health (DH), and support tender applications for public hospital listings. This is a great opportunity for a detail-oriented regulatory professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working closely with cross-functional teams to bring pharmaceutical products to market.
Key responsibilities
Prepare, review, and submit generic drug registration dossiers (CTD/eCTD format) to the Hong Kong Department of Health (DH) and other regulatory bodies.
Monitor and interpret evolving regulatory requirements for pharmaceuticals in Hong Kong.
Manage the HA tendering process, including preparation of regulatory documents for tenders, compliance checks, and post-submission follow-ups.
Liaise with health authorities, internal stakeholders, and third-party vendors to ensure smooth regulatory approvals.
Conduct gap analyses for existing and new product registrations to ensure compliance.
Maintain up-to-date compliance as per local regulatory guidelines.
Support post-approval variations, renewals, and labelling updates as needed.
Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Pharmacovigilance, and Commercial teams to align regulatory strategies.
About you
Bachelor's or Master's degree in pharmacy, life sciences, or chemistry.
2+ years of hands-on experience in drug registration and dossier submissions in Hong Kong (CTD/eCTD), HA tendering process (public hospital procurement submissions).
Knowledge in regulatory compliance for pharmaceuticals (HK DH, PMDA, FDA, or EMA experience a plus).
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex regulatory guidelines.
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) in English and Cantonese (Mandarin a plus).
Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple deadlines.
Experience working with local distributors or local pharmaceutical companies preferred.
Experience in Pharmacovigilance is an advantage, but not a requirement.
Benefits
Competitive salary.
Medical insurance coverage.
18 days annual leave + public holidays.
Opportunity to work on diverse regulatory projects in a dynamic team.
About us
For over 15 years, Camber Pharmaceuticals has been one of the fastest-growing generics companies in the United States. Since its inception, Camber has shown a tradition of excellence and a deep commitment to providing cost-effective processes to treat a wide range of therapeutic categories. Through our parent company, Hetero, Camber is building on the strengths of vertical integration in discovery research, process chemistry, API manufacturing, formulation development, and commercialization. Hetero is India's largest privately held pharmaceutical company and a world leader in API production, with a strong global presence in over 145 countries. Saving lives is our passion, and we continue to help shape a healthier world through affordable medications.

Senior Clinical & Regulatory Affairs Specialist
Applications are invited for appointment as Senior Clinical & Regulatory Affairs Specialist (Ref. H01/2026/053).
Job Description
Study biomedical technologies and products, and investigate pre-clinical and clinical approval strategies at the US FDA, China NMPA, Japan PMDA, European EMA, Australia TGA, and other regulatory bodies.
Coverage includes medical devices, drugs, and medical computer software, including AI tools and data science applications.
Develop detailed plans for obtaining regulatory approval, from conducting pre-clinical studies for clinical trial entry, to running and completing clinical trials required for market authorisation.
Draft, explain, negotiate, and deliver high-quality presentations of regulatory plans to investors, companies, regulatory bodies, medical doctors, CROs, CDMOs, and other relevant stakeholders.
Act as the primary contact point for regulatory officers, medical professionals, investors, company representatives, research teams, consultants, and manufacturers. Represent ABIC in various meetings and produce all necessary written materials to drive projects forward through effective communication.
Manage projects by calculating and tracking budgets and expenses, and closely follow up on project milestones to ensure they are executed according to schedule, without delays or budget overruns.
Identify and recruit clinical doctors, hospitals, and clinical groups to participate in clinical studies. Deliver presentations and negotiate with these parties to secure their support for clinical projects, ensuring they meet the needs and requirements of both ABIC and investors.
Scope of work includes both Investigator-Initiated Trials (IIT) and sponsored trials, and also pre-clinical operations.
Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of conducting clinical studies and serve as the primary author for relevant documentation, including clinical protocols, informed consent forms, collaboration agreements, Institutional Review Board (IRB) submission packs, and progress reports.
In addition to drafting documents, effectively deliver oral presentations as required.
Serve as the primary point of contact to support and liaise with clinical doctors, nurses, laboratory operators, and logistics personnel, ensuring the smooth daily operation of projects.
For pre-clinical development, develop, monitor, and track in-vitro, in-vivo (animal), and data science studies to ensure valid planning and adequate progress towards securing approval from pre-clinical to clinical stages.
For manufacturing, act as the primary person to source, screen, negotiate contracts with, and monitor the progress of CDMOs or internal manufacturing teams. Ensure products and prototypes are adequately prepared to facilitate the commencement of clinical studies and obtain approval for human trials.
Develop and execute plans in collaboration with relevant teams to create Drug Development Tools (DDT), New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), ISTAND qualifications, organ-on-chip models, in silico analyses, and other methodologies intended for qualification by the FDA or other regulatory bodies.
Develop and manage Quality Management Systems (QMS) for biomedical product development.
Travel as needed for meetings and work-related duties, under the instruction of ABIC supervisors.
Frequent travel to the Chinese Mainland and other overseas regions is expected.
Actively participate in commercialisation activities, including identifying and engaging with investors who support biomedical projects.
Conduct business pitches, prepare business financial projections, draft agreements, and proactively seek and negotiate business partnerships.
Play a core role in pitching to stakeholders across both the commercial and government sectors, including investment funds, corporate entities, government units, and science parks.
Seek business operations and investment opportunities. Act as a proactive, outgoing, and communicative negotiator capable of sourcing and engaging with both scientific and commercial (non-scientific) individuals and organisations.
Build and maintain strong, trusting relationships with external parties to benefit both the scientific and commercial objectives of the business.
Share knowledge with, educate, and train both internal and external teams on topics including pre-clinical and clinical studies, qualification and approval processes, and CDMO/CRO management.
Work flexibly to meet project milestones and coordinate effectively within a team under the supervision of senior staff members of the Centre.
Perform any other tasks specified by your supervisor that are not mentioned above.
As ABIC is not a large-scale organisation, you will be expected to undertake a variety of new tasks as required by your supervisor. There are no rigid boundaries to your job scope. Your scope of work is not fixed, and will change when instructed by your supervisor. You must remain flexible regarding your job scope when requested by your supervisor.
Skills and Requirements
PhD degree in Healthcare, Life Sciences, or a related discipline from a university (with the specific subject area ranked within the world’s top 100)
At least 5 years of experience in running pre-clinical operations, and also clinical studies through hospital IRBs and securing regulatory approvals from FDA, NMPA, EMA and/or PMDA.
In-depth knowledge of regulatory approval processes and requirements for medical devices and/or biologics across key markets.
Ability to deliver excellent presentations to investors and business partners.
Highly outgoing and extroverted personality; very skilled at building networks and relationships with new partners for both commercial and research operations.
Speaks excellent English and Putonghua; able to write professionally in Chinese and English with high-quality output.
Proven experience in writing, submitting, and managing regulatory dossiers, including pre-submission meetings and responding to authority queries.
Corporate R&D hands-on experience is a MUST.
Ability to quickly learn and acquire highly sophisticated scientific and business knowledge (not just scientific or business alone, but both).
Capability to independently run projects without close supervision or guidance.
Highly ambitious and very hardworking (this is not a standard 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. job).
Willing to work outside normal office hours and on weekends.
Willing to undertake frequent travels (to both Chinese Mainland and overseas) when requested.
A salary commensurate with qualifications and experience will be offered.
Applicants should submit their up-to-date C.V., quoting the job reference number, with information of current/expected remuneration and availability, to ••••@abic.hk .
The review of applications will commence as soon as possible and continue until the posts are filled. The personal data provided in your application process will be used for recruitment and other employment-related purpose. The personal data may be transferred and disclosed to, and used by HKU Innovation Holdings Limited and The University of Hong Kong for the above purposes.
We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

>
About the Role
The Platform Enablement & Automation team owns configuration management across Payoneer's products and services, defining how they operate for different customers, partners, and markets. This scope spans pricing and fee structures, eligibility and limit policies, onboarding, and the business rules and operational controls that govern product behavior across regions.
The team functions as the rapid-delivery layer between a business requirement and a fully productized solution. When a business unit requires a new capability, a pricing change, or a configuration deployed at short notice, the team delivers it at production quality without waiting for the full product and engineering build cycle. To operate at scale, the team builds and owns its internal platform, and is progressively evolving into an AI-native, automation-first function.
This is a hands-on, individual-contributor position focused on engineering delivery and technical ownership rather than people management. The successful candidate will serve as a core builder of the platform, working across the full technology stack, from user interface through backend services to data and deployment, and will provide the technical depth and redundancy that prevents the platform from depending on any single individual.
Working in close partnership with the business teams the platform serves, the successful candidate will translate their requirements directly into working software and help extend the platform outward as it grows to support strategic partners. The role also partners with the team's Director to shape the platform roadmap and deliver against it, in daily collaboration with R&D and Product in Glilot.
Hong Kong | Full Time | Hybrid
What you will do
Design, build, and maintain the internal platform across the full stack, comprising a modern front end (React, TypeScript), Node.js backend services, and both document and relational data layers.
Engage directly with the business teams the platform serves, capturing requirements firsthand and delivering solutions that eliminate manual, repetitive work.
Provide technical depth and redundancy across the platform to reduce dependency on any single individual or component.
Develop practical, end-to-end solutions, translating business requirements into a sound technical approach and a working implementation.
Leverage AI-assisted development to prototype, build, and iterate rapidly, converting concepts into production-ready software.
Build and extend the platform's AI-native and automation capabilities, including AI-assisted workflows, agents, and self-service, as the domain expands.
Manage version control, branching, and release processes across Sandbox, QA, and production environments, and own the associated deployments.
Contribute to the platform's external-facing layer as it is extended toward strategic partners.
Maintain code quality and long-term maintainability through sound documentation, standards, and engineering practices.
Who you are
Two to four years of hands-on software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of features and projects from concept through production.
A broad engineering foundation and the versatility to work across the full stack rather than within a single narrow specialization.
Proficiency with a modern JavaScript / TypeScript stack (React on the front end, Node.js on the back end), and the ability to become productive quickly in unfamiliar parts of a stack.
A working command of version control and release management (Git or Azure DevOps), including branching, merging, and multi-environment deployment.
Sound solution-design judgment: the ability to translate ambiguous requirements into a clear technical approach and execute it.
Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools and a demonstrated ability to build efficiently and to a high standard with them.
The ability to work directly with business stakeholders and translate their needs into working software.
A pragmatic, execution-oriented approach, with a bias toward shipping, iterating, and taking ownership from concept through production.
Nice to Have
Existing familiarity with Payoneer's platform, systems, and business operations.
Experience with both document databases (e.g., MongoDB) and relational databases (SQL / MSSQL).
Familiarity with AI and LLM platforms, agentic workflows, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems.
Experience with SSO / SAML authentication, APIs, and system integration.
Prior contribution to an internal platform or developer-facing tooling.
Experience operating within a Windows / IIS hosting environment.

Role Title
APAC GCIB Business Controls Officer – Director / Vice President
Business Overview
Our Global Corporate & Investment Banking business focuses on building long-term relationships with more than 6,000 large U.S. and multinational corporations, financial institutions and financial sponsors. We provide strong advisory expertise, capitalizing on powerful mergers and acquisitions, corporate banking, treasury, debt and equity product expertise to deliver integrated financial solutions.
Job Description
The role revolves around undertaking and supporting supervision and business controls activities in the Global Corporate and Investment Banking (“GCIB”) Business Controls organization, focused on the LATAM region. Candidate must be able to thrive in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment while ensuring the Line of Business (“LOB”) is in compliance with applicable laws/rules, regulations and implementing industry best practices. Primary Business Controls Officer (“BCO”) responsibilities include:
Creating, enhancing and oversight of Front Line Unit (“FLU”) controls and processes that create the framework that makes up the business operating environment, which include the administration and enforcement of the supervisory program
Working closely with LOB Supervisors and delegates/support groups in managing the day-to-day supervision infrastructure (e.g., supervisory responsibilities matrices, supervisor alignments, supervisor acknowledgements/attestations, etc.), including performing delegated supervisory tasks as required
Performing GCIB centralized functions and controls routines (e.g., BCO led Quality Assurance (“QA”) routines)
Maintaining global transparency and consistency (and regional customization where appropriate) of business controls driven processes/controls and supervisory accountabilities, including enhancement of associated documentation (e.g. Written Supervisory Procedures, Desktop procedures/guidelines, etc.); Includes understanding corresponding policies to local laws/rules/regulations
Participating in LOB and programmatic governance routines and internal/external exams, including preparing documentation, contributing towards meeting materials, and presenting to senior business and support/control partner leaders (and regulators as required)
Participating in LOB and programmatic governance routines, including preparing documentation, contributing towards meeting materials, and presenting to senior business and support/control partner leaders
Partnering with GCIB COO teams to supporting LOB on internal exams (e.g., audits, targeted risk assessments, etc.) and external regulator meetings/exams, including preparing LOB leaders for meetings, providing exam responses and documentation, and presenting to auditors, risk, regulators as required.
Driving Operational Risk and Operational Excellence program deliverables on behalf of the FLU/LOB (e.g., Risk and Control Self Assessments, Operational Events, Metrics, Single Process Inventory., etc.)
Collaborating with LOB and Control/Support Partner groups (Operations, Legal and Compliance, Finance, Risk, Technology, HR, Audit) to ensure end-to-end processes for all client and deal/transactional activity are controlled, including working with these partners to improve the quality of supervisory reporting/tools and FLU controls/monitoring processes
Undertaking Business Controls program-wide and large scale Cross GCIB initiatives to enrich the GCIB control framework, including ownership of identification through resolution of Audit Issues and performance of deep-dives to identify control weaknesses or gaps in processes/activities requiring remediation; Includes maintaining thorough documentation through the course of projects in order to present project progress updates and results to GCIB senior management (e.g., PowerPoint Presentations are a common request)
Requirements
Strong academic background or equivalent experience
An understanding of Global Corporate and Investment Banking products, services and processes
Good IT skills (e.g., MS Office tools), especially PowerPoint and Excel, and the ability to develop ad hoc solutions
Ability to run complex tasks and deploy collaborative and analytical approaches
Strong organizational, analytical and communication skills.
Exceptional relationship management skills – ability to be comfortable liaising with Senior Business Controls Management, Line of Business Management, and control functions (e.g. Compliance, Audit, Technology, Operations, Human Resources, etc.) to identify potential improvements, develop strategies to implement change, and oversee/manage implementation.
Profile/Skills
Self-motivated and results oriented with strong desire to succeed
Takes initiative and demonstrates focused desire to drive improvements, including able to deliver results with limited direction and supervision
Professional approach with a clear and logical thought process and attention to detail
Shows initiative and reacts quickly to changes in priorities with the ability to quickly learn new processes and procedures
Excellent verbal and written communication skills (including presentation skills) with ability to simplify complex information into messages targeted to both targeted groups and large audiences, including various levels of leadership
Excellent critical thinking/problem solving skills
Ability to make recommendations and provide guidance to effectively advance projects across a globally integrated enterprise

title: Food & Workplace Safety Officer
teaser: Food safety and workplace safety are non-negotiable in everything we do.
jd:
About Us
Epicure Catering is a leading commercial catering group serving international schools and institutional clients across Asia. In Hong Kong we operate multiple school and site kitchens, serving thousands of meals every day. Food safety and workplace safety are non-negotiable in everything we do.
About the Role
We are looking for a Food & Workplace Safety Officer to support HSE (Health, Safety, Environment) oversight across our Hong Kong operations. Working closely with the HSE Manager, you will visit our kitchens and service sites regularly, carry out hygiene and safety inspections, support HACCP compliance, deliver training to frontline teams, and help site managers close out corrective actions.
This role is open to graduates with a relevant degree, as well as candidates with professional experience. What matters most is attention to detail, a practical mindset, and a genuine interest in food and workplace safety.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct routine food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety inspections across Hong Kong kitchens and service points
Monitor HACCP records, temperature logs, cleaning schedules, and pest control reports; escalate non-conformances
Support investigation of incidents, accidents, near accidents, and customer complaints, and track corrective actions to closure
Deliver induction and refresher training to kitchen and service staff on food hygiene, allergen management, chemical handling, PPE, and safe work practices
Maintain HSE documentation, registers, risk assessments, and audit records
Assist with preparation for internal audits, client audits, and inspections by the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department and Labour Department
Support allergen management controls and menu-related food safety checks
Help promote a positive safety culture on site, working alongside chefs, site managers, and operations teams
Prepare simple inspection reports and monthly HSE summaries for the HSE Manager
Requirements
Essential
Degree or higher diploma in Food Science, Food Safety, Environmental Health, Occupational Safety and Health, Nutrition, Hospitality, or a related discipline
Good spoken Cantonese and English; written Chinese and English
Willingness to travel between sites across Hong Kong and to work early morning shifts when required
Comfortable working in commercial kitchen environments (heat, noise, standing, cold rooms)
Strong attention to detail, good record-keeping habits, and confidence engaging with frontline teams
Proficient with Microsoft Office / Google Workspace
Advantageous
HACCP, ISO 22000, food hygiene, or occupational safety certification
Registered Safety Officer / Safety Supervisor qualification, or working towards one
Prior exposure to catering, food manufacturing, hospitality, or retail food operations
Experience with school or institutional catering environments
Additional Requirements
Successful candidates must complete pre-employment background screening and, given our work in school environments, meet our safeguarding and child protection clearance requirements
Valid right to work in Hong Kong
What We Offer
Structured training and professional development, including support towards recognised HSE and food safety certifications
Direct mentoring from an experienced HSE Manager
Clear career path towards senior HSE and food safety roles within a growing regional group
Competitive salary, medical insurance, MPF, staff meals, and generous annual leave
Exposure to a multi-site, multinational operation
>
>
關於我們
>
Epicure Catering 是一家領先的商業餐飲集團，為亞洲各地的國際學校和機構客戶提供餐飲服務。我們在香港經營多家學校和場所廚房，每天供應數千份餐點。食品安全和工作場所安全是我們一切工作的首要任務。
>
職位描述
>
我們正在尋找一位食品及工作場所安全主任，負責協助我們在香港的營運進行 HSE（健康、安全、環境）監管。您將與 HSE 經理緊密合作，定期巡視我們的廚房和服務場所，進行衛生和安全檢查，支援 HACCP 合規性，為第一線團隊提供培訓，並協助場所經理完成整改措施。
>
此職位開放給擁有相關學位的畢業生以及具有專業經驗的候選人。我們最重視的是注重細節、務實精神以及對食物和工作場所安全的真正興趣。

主要職責

* 在香港的廚房和服務點進行日常食品安全、衛生和工作場所安全檢查

要求

>
* 注重細節，有良好的記錄習慣，並能自信地與第一線團隊溝通
>
* 熟練使用微軟辦公室軟體/Google辦公室軟體
>
加分項
>
* 持有HACCP、ISO 22000、食品衛生或職業安全認證
>
* 持有註冊安全主任/安全主管資格，或正在努力取得該資格
>
* 擁有餐飲、食品製造、飯店或零售食品營運經驗
>

>
其他要求
>
* 成功應徵者必須完成入職前背景調查，並且鑑於我們在學校環境中的工作，必須符合我們的保障和兒童保護審查要求
>
* 擁有在香港工作的有效權利
>
我們提供
>
* 系統化的培訓和職業發展，包括支持認可的健康、安全和環境 (HSE) 及食品安全認證
>
* 經驗豐富的 HSE 經理的直接指導
>
* 在不斷發展的區域性公司中，擁有清晰的職業發展路徑，可晉升至高級 HSE 和食品安全職位集團

* 具競爭力的薪資、醫療保險、強積金、員工餐和優良的年假
>
* 有機會接觸多地點、跨國運營

Lead the cybersecurity team in delivering high-quality cybersecurity services and engineering capabilities, ensuring effective resource planning, performance management, staff development, and a culture of operational excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Master's degree or equivalent in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, or a related field. Comprehensive professional experience may be considered in lieu of a master's degree.
Demonstrated people management and leadership experience, including managing cybersecurity professionals, setting objectives and priorities, allocating resources, managing performance, and coaching and developing team members to build a high-performing cybersecurity team.
Strong cybersecurity engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to design and deliver secure, resilient, scalable, and maintainable cybersecurity solutions in complex enterprise environments, applying sound engineering principles, standards, testing, automation, and quality assurance practices.
Strong program and project management experience, with a proven track record of developing and executing cybersecurity roadmaps and delivering complex cybersecurity programs and initiatives on time and to a high standard, including effective management of priorities, resources, dependencies, risks, vendors, and stakeholders.
Strong technical analysis and problem-solving skills; experience of DevSecOps toolsets would be an advantage.
Demonstrated solid knowledge of information security principles, practices, and regulations, including knowledge of international security frameworks and standards, such as the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK, CIS, ISO/IEC 27000 Series, and COBIT.

Strong organizational and critical thinking skills.
Effective written and verbal communication skills in English.
