title: Scientist – Cell Biology & Hydrogel Encapsulation
teaser: We seek a Scientist to lead cell culture and hydrogel formulation for our AI-driven microfluidic encapsulation platforms.
jd:
Job Title: Scientist – Cell Biology & Hydrogel Encapsulation
Location: Hong Kong / Shenzhen (on-site)
Reports to: Senior Scientist / R&D Director
>
Role Overview
We are a high-growth biotech instrumentation company developing advanced cell sorting and microencapsulation platforms that combine microfluidics, AI-driven image analysis, and high-sensitivity optical detection. Our RAINSort platform performs label-free, brightfield, AI-driven cell sorting and microfluidic droplet encapsulation, and has generated preclinical proof-of-concept data — including encapsulated islet cell studies demonstrating glycemic control in animal models — in support of applications spanning cell and gene therapy manufacturing, regenerative medicine, and synthetic biology.
We are seeking a Scientist to lead the cell culture and hydrogel formulation work that sits at the heart of our encapsulation pipeline. In this hands-on role, you will develop and optimise hydrogel systems for encapsulating mammalian and other cell lines, working closely with our microfluidics, optical, and software engineering teams to translate biological and material requirements into robust, manufacturable encapsulation protocols. We need an expert individual contributor who thrives on solving challenging cell culture and biomaterials problems and delivering high-quality, reproducible encapsulated cell products for life-science and therapeutic applications.
>
Key Responsibilities
• Cell Culture: Culture, expand, and maintain a range of mammalian and other cell lines and primary cells relevant to our application programs — including primary pancreatic islet cells, iPSC-derived cells, immune cells, mesenchymal stem cells, CHO, or others, as well as microbial culture of bacteria, yeast, or algae — with rigorous attention to viability, sterility, and mycoplasma testing.
• Hydrogel Formulation & Optimisation: Design, formulate, and optimise hydrogel systems (e.g., alginate, PEG-based, or other biocompatible polymers) specifically for cell encapsulation, tuning gelation chemistry, mechanical properties, permeability, and biocompatibility to the requirements of each cell type and application.
• Microfluidic Encapsulation Integration: Work closely with microfluidics and optical engineering teams to adapt hydrogel-cell formulations for droplet generation on the RAINSort platform, troubleshooting issues such as viscosity mismatches, clogging, gelation kinetics, and capsule uniformity.
• Capsule Quality & Performance Characterisation: Develop and run assays to evaluate capsule quality metrics — encapsulation efficiency, empty-capsule carryover, post-encapsulation cell viability, membrane permeability, mechanical integrity, and long-term functional performance (e.g., glucose-stimulated insulin secretion for islet cell capsules).
• Application-Specific Development: Support specific application programs across the Company's adjacency areas, including pancreatic islet / artificial pancreas encapsulation, iPSC-derived nephron progenitor cell encapsulation, CAR-T and Treg cell therapy encapsulation, MSC/exosome spheroid production, organoid biobanking, and other cell encapsulation projects.
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with the optical and software engineering teams to co-develop encapsulation protocols compatible with automated AI-driven sorting, and work with business development to translate partner and customer requirements (e.g., academic and pharma collaborators) into cell culture and formulation protocols.
• Customer acquisition and support: Assist in identifying potential customers/user leads, contacting them, and acquiring customers for our products, as well as follow up support and technical advisement.
• Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed lab notebooks, SOPs, and technical reports for cell culture and hydrogel formulation work. Support regulatory submissions (e.g., ISO 13485) and GMP-adjacent documentation with clear, traceable records.
Core Qualifications
• Education: Master's degree or PhD in Cell Biology, Bioengineering, Chemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Materials Science, Biomaterials, or a closely related field. Bachelor's with exceptional previous industry experience may be considered.
• Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, with direct, demonstrable experience in hydrogel formulation and optimisation for cell encapsulation. Experience with microfluidic encapsulation, cell therapy manufacturing, or biomaterials-based drug/cell delivery is required.
Technical Skills
• Proficiency in mammalian and other cell line culture techniques: passaging, expansion, cryopreservation, and viability assays (e.g., Trypan blue, Calcein-AM/EthD, flow cytometry-based viability).
• Hands-on hydrogel/biomaterial formulation experience: alginate, PEG-based, gelatin methacrylate (GelMA), collagen, or other biocompatible polymers, with an understanding of ionic, photo-, or thermal crosslinking chemistries.
• Experience characterising hydrogel properties, including rheology, swelling ratio, degradation kinetics, mechanical testing (compression/tensile), and permeability/diffusion assays.
• Familiarity with microfluidic droplet generation and cell encapsulation techniques (e.g., flow-focusing, T-junction, or coaxial encapsulation).
• Understanding of cell–material interactions, biocompatibility, and immune response considerations relevant to encapsulated cell therapies.
• Experience with relevant analytical and characterisation tools: fluorescence/confocal microscopy, flow cytometry, and functional assays (e.g., ELISA, glucose-stimulated insulin secretion).
• Instrument Integration: Demonstrated ability, or strong willingness, to work closely with optical and microfluidics engineering teams to co-develop encapsulation protocols compatible with automated cell sorting and imaging platforms. Understanding of how fluidic flow, formulation viscosity, and gelation timing affect encapsulation outcomes.
• Problem-solving & Analytical Mindset: Capable of systematically diagnosing formulation issues (e.g., inconsistent gelation, capsule fragility, viability loss) and iterating rapidly. Strong statistical skills for characterising reproducibility and batch-to-batch consistency.
• Communication: Fluent in English and Mandarin — able to write precise technical documentation, present findings in PPT, and engage in technical discussions with international partners. Cantonese is preferred as well for local supplier and team communication.
>
Preferred Differentiators
• Direct experience with pancreatic islet cell or other therapeutic endocrine cell encapsulation programs.
• Experience working with iPSC-derived cell types
• Experience culturing or formulating immune cells (CAR-T, Treg) or supporting cell and gene therapy manufacturing workflows.
• Familiarity with GMP-adjacent or regulated cell therapy manufacturing environments.
• Background in synthetic biology, 3D bioprinting, and organoid culture .
• Publication record or patents in biomaterials, hydrogel science, or cell encapsulation.
>
Compensation & Benefits
• Salary: Competitive monthly package, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
• Performance-based bonus and potential equity/stock options.
• Comprehensive medical insurance
• Professional development: conference attendance, external training, and collaboration with academic/industrial partners.
• Opportunity for career progression as the company expands.
>
Work Authorisation: Hong Kong (required)
Languages: English, Mandarin and Cantonese (preferred)

La Filière Internationale suit le International Primary Curriculum (IPC) et le English National Curriculum qui incluent les diplômes de l’IGCSE et l’IB Diploma Programme. En 1988, le LFI est devenu la première école internationale autorisée à délivrer le programme IB à Hong Kong.
>
Aujourd’hui le LFI est une des plus grandes écoles internationales de Hong Kong et accueille plus de 2,800 élèves, 60% en filière française et 40% en filière internationale, rassemblant plus de 40 nationalités différentes.

La mission du Lycée est de favoriser, avec les familles, le rayonnement d’une communauté culturellement diversifiée qui sera source d’inspiration pour nos jeunes ; c’est au sein de cette communauté qu’ils atteindront leur plein potentiel et deviendront des élèves indépendants et volontaires, ainsi que des citoyens responsables, ouverts sur le monde et respectueux des valeurs humanistes.
>
About the French International School
>
Established in 1963, the French International School (FIS) is the oldest international school in Hong Kong and was the first school in Hong Kong to offer the IB (in 1988). It is a dynamic educational institution, which welcomes over 2,800 students from around the world. It offers both French and international curricula and is one of the largest French schools in Asia.
>
FIS currently operates four campuses, next year all of which will accommodate students in the International Stream. Regarding the three primary schools, one is surrounded by greenery in Jardine’s Lookout and another campus is by the sea in Tseung Kwan O and the third is a beautiful campus in Chai Wan
>
FIS is a private, not-for-profit organization. In the last five decades, it has grown from a small school with 35 students to one of the most renowned international schools in the region. Its students are from 40 countries speaking some 30 languages – it is a truly multicultural learning environment.
>
FIS operates two streams, French and International. The French Stream follows the French national curriculum and has approximately 1700 students. The International Stream follows an English and Mathematics curriculum based on the English national curriculum and also the International Early Years Curriculum (IEYC) and International Primary Curriculum (IPC) leading to the International Middle Years Curriculum (IMYC) in years 7 and 8, then to IGCSE and finally the International Baccalaureate in Years 12 and 13. Job Description
We are the Alibaba Infrastructure Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of infrastructure across the globe. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.
The Controls team serves as the regional technical capability center for infrastructure automation and monitoring systems. We bridge global headquarters engineering with regional deployment operations, owning the technical standards, platform development, and integration architecture for Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), and Environmental Monitoring Systems (EMS). Our mission is to ensure that all infrastructure's automation and monitoring meets Alibaba's global reliability standards through rigorous technical governance, code-level quality assurance, and systematic knowledge transfer to regional deployment teams.
We operate as a matrix organization combining both infra operations engineers and platform development engineers, enabling us to address complex technical challenges that span infrastructure systems, software platforms, and regional deployment contexts. We actively seek engineers who can bring proven practices in observability, automation, and incident management to the infra controls domain — accelerating the evolution of our monitoring and automation capabilities through cross-domain knowledge migration.
1. Own regional technical standards for BMS/EPMS/EMS integration, defining monitoring specifications, protocol requirements, and data quality benchmarks to ensure standardized, reliable monitoring coverage across all regional infrastructure.
2. Lead EMS integration projects across regional colocation providers through structured program management. Coordinate cross-functional resources (internal engineering, colo provider teams, platform vendors) to ensure standardized telemetry access, data quality, and alarm management aligned with Alibaba global EMS standards.
3. Develop integration tools, data validation scripts, and platform components to automate monitoring deployment, configuration, and quality assurance. Apply cloud-native practices (IaC, CI/CD, observability frameworks) to build and maintain the regional integration toolchain, improving delivery efficiency and reducing manual errors.
4. Serve as regional technical escalation point for complex BMS/EPMS/EMS integration faults. Lead root cause analysis using structured methodologies (post-incident review, blameless retrospectives), develop permanent corrective actions, and establish knowledge base entries to prevent recurrence across the regional fleet.
5. Review and validate electrical and HVAC automation control logic implemented by colocation providers. Orchestrate technical experts and vendor resources to ensure control strategies meet reliability, efficiency, and safety standards before production deployment.
6. Conduct systematic technical risk assessment of regional automation infrastructure, including single points of failure analysis, redundancy validation, and mitigation roadmap development. Drive risk closure through structured follow-up with colo providers and internal stakeholders.
7. Establish regional technical training programs for controls deployment engineers and local FM/FE teams. Transfer integration methodologies, debugging techniques, and operational best practices to build sustainable regional technical capability.
8. Collaborate with global headquarters on platform roadmap, standards evolution, and tool development. Represent regional perspectives in global architecture reviews and ensure global policies are adapted to local infrastructure contexts.
Position Requirement
"Job Responsibilities:
1. Own regional technical standards for BMS/EPMS/EMS integration, defining monitoring specifications, communication protocol requirements, and data quality benchmarks. Ensure all regional infrastructure achieve standardized, reliable monitoring coverage.
2. Lead EMS integration projects across regional colocation providers through structured program management. Coordinate cross-functional resources (internal engineering teams, colo provider technical staff, platform vendors) to ensure standardized telemetry access, data quality, and alarm management aligned with Alibaba global EMS standards.
3. Develop integration tools, data validation scripts, and platform components to automate monitoring system deployment, configuration, and ongoing quality assurance. Apply cloud-native engineering practices (Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, observability frameworks) to build and maintain the regional integration toolchain, improving delivery efficiency and reducing manual errors.
4. Serve as regional technical escalation point for complex BMS/EPMS/EMS integration faults. Lead root cause analysis using structured methodologies (post-incident review, blameless retrospectives), develop permanent corrective actions, and establish knowledge base entries to prevent recurrence across the regional fleet.
5. Review and validate electrical and HVAC automation control logic implemented by colocation providers. Orchestrate technical experts and vendor resources to ensure control strategies meet reliability, efficiency, and safety standards before production deployment.
6. Conduct systematic technical risk assessment of regional automation infrastructure, including single points of failure analysis, redundancy validation, and mitigation roadmap development. Drive closure of identified risks through structured follow-up with colo providers and internal stakeholders.
7. Establish regional technical training programs for controls deployment engineers and local FM/FE teams. Transfer integration methodologies, debugging techniques, and operational best practices to build sustainable regional technical capability.
8. Collaborate with global headquarters on platform roadmap, standards evolution, and tool development. Represent regional technical perspectives in global architecture reviews and ensure global policies are adapted to local infrastructure contexts. Drive continuous improvement by introducing cloud reliability engineering practices (SLO/SLI management, error budgets, chaos engineering principles) into infra operations where applicable."

(a) 申請人於獲聘時必須已成為香港特別行政區永久性居民。
>(b) 作為提供平等就業機會的僱主，政府致力消除在就業方面的歧視。所有符合基本入職條件的人士，不論其殘疾、性別、婚姻狀況、懷孕、年齡、家庭崗位、性傾向和種族，均可申請本欄內的職位。
>(c) 非公務員職位不屬於公務員編制內的職位。申請人如獲聘用，將不會按公務員聘用條款和服務條件聘任。受聘的申請人並非公務員，不符合資格獲調職、晉升或轉職至公務員職位。
>(d) 薪酬、聘用條款及服務條件，應以獲聘時的規定為準。
>(e) 如果符合訂明入職條件的應徵者人數眾多，政府可以訂立篩選準則，甄選條件較佳的應徵者，以便進一步處理。在此情況下，只有獲甄選的應徵者會獲邀參加遴選面試。
>(f) 政府的政策，是盡可能安排殘疾人士擔任適合的職位。殘疾人士申請職位，如符合入職條件，無須再經篩選，便會獲邀參加遴選面試。在適合受聘而有申報為殘疾的申請人和適合受聘程度相若的其他申請人當中，招聘當局可給予前者適度的優先錄用機會。有關政府聘用殘疾人士的政策及其他相關措施載列於《用人唯才：殘疾人士申請政府職位》的資料冊內。申請人可於公務員事務局網站（https://www.csb.gov.hk）內的「公務員隊伍的管理 — 聘任」下參閱該資料冊。
>(g) 持有本港以外院校／非香港考試及評核局頒授學歷的人士亦可申請，惟其學歷必須經過評審以確定是否與職位所要求的本地學歷水平相若。有關申請人必須於截止申請日期後的一星期內把所持修業成績表副本及證書副本電郵至••••@sb.gov.hk 。
>(h) 受聘人在獲聘前須接受品格審查。

About the role
This role is open to 2026 graduates, based at our Dymind Hong Kong subsidiary. You will be responsible for end-to-end IVD reagent R&D and registration, covering raw material screening, performance validation, registration documentation, and laboratory management.
Key responsibilities
Participate in or lead technical R&D of IVD reagent kits across multiple platforms, including raw material screening, reaction system development, formulation optimization, process development, and scale-up from lab-scale trials to pilot production.
Design performance validation protocols for IVD reagents, conduct testing for core metrics including sensitivity, specificity and stability, perform statistical analysis of experimental data, and draft research reports.
Drive product optimization based on test results; maintain accurate R&D records, and prepare R&D standards, process documentation, and quality system documents.
Compile registration submission materials for IVD reagents, including product technical specifications, analytical performance data, stability study data, and Instructions for Use (IFU); independently prepare full sets of English registration technical documents.

Partnering closely with the WRB HK Chief Operating Officer, you will lead the oversight and management of non-financial risks across the WRB business, ensuring a high-quality control environment is maintained in all activities.
Your responsibilities will include establishing and maintaining effective governance frameworks and infrastructure to enforce compliance with internal policies and external regulations across the full range of non-financial risks — encompassing Customer Due Diligence, Anti-Money Laundering, sanctions, sales suitability, fraud prevention, cross-border risk, and information and asset protection. Governance & Risk Management
>
Provide leadership to uphold a strong control environment that supports WRB’s business operations within defined risk tolerances and regulatory expectations.
Monitor effectiveness of risk management frameworks and drive continuous improvements to processes and controls.
Embed Enterprise Risk Management principles and frameworks across the business, fostering a risk-aware culture.
Collaborate closely with audit teams to identify and resolve operational losses or control weaknesses.
This role offers a unique opportunity to lead risk governance in a dynamic market environment, contributing directly to the bank’s sustainable growth and reputation for integrity.

>
Lead and manage regulatory audit and inspection processes for the WRB business in Hong Kong, effectively representing the bank and building strong relationships with regulatory bodies.
Collaborate with governance committees to ensure product processes comply with regulatory standards and internal policies.
Continuously identify and assess new and emerging risk sources arising from regulatory changes, market developments, new products, and shifts in business strategy.
Develop and deliver targeted training and communications to increase risk awareness and promote proactive risk management across frontline teams.
Ensure the design and implementation of effective controls to mitigate identified risks, and oversee remediation actions where required to maintain compliance with global standards and local variations.
Functional & Business Alignment

Regulatory Compliance

Embed compliance with laws, regulations, and internal policies across all relevant WRB activities.
Drive initiatives that support the Bank’s Conduct Principles, ensuring fair client outcomes, market integrity, and effective financial crime controls.

Responsibilities:
Lead the cybersecurity team in delivering high-quality cybersecurity services and engineering capabilities, ensuring effective resource planning, performance management, staff development, and a culture of operational excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Lead the planning, design, deployment, testing, optimization, and integration of cybersecurity technologies, as well as manage product features and capabilities, to protect information and prevent unauthorized access and attacks against AIIB's IT environment.

Continuously assess the maturity and effectiveness of cybersecurity capabilities, identify improvement opportunities, and lead the implementation of enhancements to strengthen the Bank's cyber resilience.

Strong program and project management experience, with a proven track record of developing and executing cybersecurity roadmaps and delivering complex cybersecurity programs and initiatives on time and to a high standard, including effective management of priorities, resources, dependencies, risks, vendors, and stakeholders.

Menzer International (Hk) Limited is a professional integrated garment manufacturing and trading company rooted in Hong Kong and supported by a self-owned garment factory in Dongguan. Our founder possesses 20 years of profound experience in garment foreign trade. Capitalizing on Hong Kong’s free trade port advantages, we focus on providing high-quality, customized OEM and ODM garment processing and manufacturing services for fashion brands, retailers and wholesalers across Europe, America, the Middle East, Australia and other global markets. With stable factory production capacity, mature quality control system and flexible customization solutions, we deliver one-stop garment manufacturing services to meet diversified overseas market demands.
Job Overview
We are seeking a proactive Overseas Business Development Executive to independently develop and expand global garment client resources. The core responsibility of this role is to explore potential overseas brand clients and wholesalers, promote our professional garment OEM/ODM customized processing services, complete business negotiation, order conversion and long-term customer maintenance, and continuously expand the company’s global market share and overseas business layout.
Core Job Responsibilities
Overseas Customer Development (Core Duty) : Independently develop new overseas clients targeting Europe, America, the Middle East, Australia and other mainstream markets through online platforms, social media, email development, overseas exhibitions and other channels. Precisely locate garment brands, chain retailers and bulk wholesalers with OEM/ODM customization demands, and establish effective business connections.
OEM/ODM Service Promotion & Solution Customization : Conduct in-depth communication with overseas clients to fully understand their product positioning, style requirements, fabric standards, craft details, order volume and budget demands. Professionally introduce our one-stop garment OEM (original equipment manufacturing) and ODM (original design manufacturing) services, provide targeted customized production solutions including pattern design, sample making, mass production and quality inspection, and match personalized service schemes for different client needs.
Full-cycle Business Negotiation & Order Execution : Responsible for the whole business process from client inquiry reception, technical confirmation, quotation negotiation, sample confirmation to contract signing and order confirmation. Cooperate with the Dongguan factory to follow up production progress, ensure product quality and delivery cycle meet client requirements, and guarantee smooth order delivery and settlement.
Market Analysis & Business Optimization : Continuously track the latest trends, popular styles, price systems and competitor dynamics of the global garment OEM/ODM market. Collect and sort out effective market information and client demand feedback, assist the company in optimizing product customization schemes and market development strategies, and improve the competitiveness of our processing services.
Long-term Customer Relationship Maintenance : Establish and maintain stable, friendly cooperative relationships with new and existing overseas clients. Conduct regular customer follow-ups, tap into repeat order demands and secondary customization needs, deepen long-term strategic cooperation, and enhance customer loyalty and business repurchase rate.
Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or above in International Trade, English, Business Administration, Textile and Garment or related majors; fluent oral and written English, capable of independent overseas business communication and negotiation without language barriers.
Familiar with the operation logic of garment foreign trade business, understand the basic process and technical standards of garment OEM/ODM processing; candidates with relevant garment foreign trade development experience or overseas customer resources are highly preferred.
Possess independent overseas customer development ability, familiar with mainstream foreign trade development channels such as B2B platforms, Google search, LinkedIn, Facebook and overseas industry exhibitions.
Have strong market acumen, business negotiation skills and customer demand insight, able to accurately grasp client OEM/ODM customization needs and output professional service solutions.
Be proactive, resilient and goal-oriented, with good cross-departmental coordination ability, able to efficiently connect customer demands with factory production to ensure smooth project implementation.
Familiar with foreign trade business processes including quotation, sample making, order confirmation, delivery and customs clearance is a plus.
Job Benefits
Platform Advantages : Supported by self-owned Dongguan factory + Hong Kong free trade port, with stable production capacity, competitive pricing and reliable product quality, easy to develop and convert overseas clients.
Business Support : Provide professional OEM/ODM product materials, factory qualification certificates, market case resources and full-process business guidance.
Performance Incentives : Attractive basic salary + high business commission + performance bonus + year-end bonus, unlimited income ceiling for excellent developers.
Career Development: Independent control over client resources and a clear promotion path from Business Supervisor to Business Supervisor/Manager. High-performing individuals may be promoted to company partners and receive year-end profit sharing.
Social Security: Flexible working hours and office space (work from home or in the office, performance-driven), holiday benefits, regular team building activities, and other comprehensive welfare benefits.

>(a)(i)持有本港任何一所大學頒授的一級或二級榮譽化學學士學位，或具備同等學歷，而修畢的學分或完成的試卷最少有三分之二為化學科目；以及

>(c)符合語文能力要求，在綜合招聘考試的兩張語文試卷(中文運用及英文運用)中取得「一級」成績，或具備同等成績(見註項(a)) ；
>及
>(d)在《基本法及香港國安法》測試取得及格成績(見註項(b))。
註:
(a)綜合招聘考試能力傾向測試的成績分為及格或不及格。
>綜合招聘考試中文運用及英文運用試卷的成績分為二級、一級或不及格，並以二級為最高等級。
政府在聘任公務員時，香港中學文憑考試中國語文科第5級或以上成績；或香港高級程度會考中國語文及文化、中國語言文學或中國語文科C級或以上成績，會獲接納為等同綜合招聘考試中文運用試卷的二級成績。香港中學文憑考試中國語文科第4級成績；或香港高級程度會考中國語文及文化、中國語言文學或中國語文科D級成績，會獲接納為等同綜合招聘考試中文運用試卷的一級成績。
香港中學文憑考試英國語文科第5級或以上成績；或香港高級程度會考英語運用科C級或以上成績；或General Certificate of Education (Advanced Level) (GCE A Level) English Language科C級或以上成績，會獲接納為等同綜合招聘考試英文運用試卷的二級成績。香港中學文憑考試英國語文科第4級成績；或香港高級程度會考英語運用科D級成績；或GCE A Level English Language科D級成績，會獲接納為等同綜合招聘考試英文運用試卷的一級成績。
在International English Language Testing System (IELTS)學術模式整體分級取得6.5或以上，並在同一次考試中各項個別分級取得不低於6的人士，在考試成績的兩年有效期內，其IELTS成績可獲接納為等同綜合招聘考試英文運用試卷的二級成績。IELTS考試成績必須在職位申請期內其中任何一日有效。
(b)政府會測試所有應徵公務員職位人士的《基本法》及《香港國安法》知識。在《基本法及香港國安法》測試取得及格成績是所有公務員職位的入職條件。申請人必須在《基本法及香港國安法》測試中取得及格成績方會獲考慮聘用。
如申請人在申請公務員職位時仍未曾參加相關的《基本法及香港國安法》測試或未曾在相關的《基本法及香港國安法》測試考獲及格成績，仍可作出申請。他們會被安排在招聘過程中參加相關《基本法及香港國安法》測試。
(c)申請人須電郵綜合招聘考試/香港中學文憑考試/香港高級程度會考/IELTS考試成績證明、修業成績表及學位文憑的副本，以及詳列學歷/專業資格及相關工作經驗的履歷到••••@wsd.gov.hk 。
職責:
水務化驗師的主要職責是:(a) 管理組內與化驗室的日常運作及人員、監察水質並執行物理、化學、細菌、生物和輻射等檢測，並就水務設施的處理過程提供意見及管控；(b) 分析水質數據，就水安全、水質或水處理等各類技術問題展開調查；(c) 執行輻射測量計劃，處理放射性物質和放射防護事務，並就相關法定程序提供意見；(d) 為化驗室和外勤工作的人員提供訓練；及(e) 執行總水務化驗師指派的其他工作。

title: PCGS Operations Assistant/Operator
location: Tsim Sha Tsui, Yau Tsim Mong District
teaser: We are currently looking for an Operations Assistant to join Operation Team.
jd:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible coins, trading cards, Funko Pops!, video games, event tickets, autographs, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, PSA Games, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 1,700 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana and offices in Jersey City, Seattle, Hong Kong, Paris, Shanghai, and Tokyo.
>
We are currently looking for an Operations Assistant (Operator) to join Operation Team.
This role reports to the Operations Manager and will be based in the Hong Kong.

· Perform manual production tasks in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
· Assist in product inspection and grading support activities
· Handle products with care to avoid damage during processing
· Follow detailed work instructions to complete tasks accurately and consistently
· Identify and report product defects, abnormalities, or quality issues in a timely manner
· Support labeling, packaging, and other finishing processes
· Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment
· Ensure compliance with company quality standards and operational guidelines
· Work closely with team members and supervisors to achieve daily production targets
· Assist with basic data entry and documentation as required
· Photographic record keeping
>
Who You Are
· Strong attention to detail and good hand-eye coordination
· Ability to perform repetitive tasks with consistency and accuracy
· Basic understanding of quality control concepts is a plus
· Responsible, patient, and able to work in a structured and standardized environment
· Good teamwork and communication skills
>

>
Collectors 是全球領先的創新科技公司，致力於為收藏家提供增值服務。我們為數以百萬計創下紀錄的收藏品提供評級、鑑定、託管及交易服務，同時持續推動流程現代化與數碼化，以實現我們協助收藏家追求熱情的使命。我們誠邀優秀人才加入不斷成長的團隊。

主要職責

● 影相留底
>
職位要求
● 細心，具良好手眼協調能力
● 能夠穩定及準確地完成重複性工作
● 具備基本品質控制概念者優先
● 有責任感、有耐性，能適應標準化及結構化工作環境

薪酬

title: Clinical Research Associate
teaser: Clinical Research Associate to manage clinical trials from site identification through close-out.
jd:
Key Responsibilities
Support country and site feasibility assessments, site identification, site qualification and site-selection activities.
Conduct or support site qualification visits, site initiation visits, interim monitoring visits, remote monitoring activities and close-out visits in accordance with the approved monitoring plan.
Manage assigned clinical trial throughout study lifecycle, from site identification and activation monitoring and close-out.
Serve as a primary point of contact for investigators, study coordinators, pharmacists and other site personnel.
Build and maintain effective working relationships with investigators and site teams to support timely study start-up, patient recruitment and study delivery.
Ensure that clinical trials are conducted in accordance with the protocol, ICH-GCP, applicable local and international regulations, SOP and study-specific plans.
Review source documentation, electronic case report forms and other clinical records to verify subject eligibility, protocol compliance, data accuracy, completeness and consistency.
Identify, document and follow up on protocol deviations, data queries, monitoring findings and corrective actions.
Monitor site recruitment, subject retention, study timelines and other site-performance indicators, and escalate risks or delays to the Director of Clinical Operations.
Review the timely reporting and documentation of serious adverse events, adverse events of special interest and other safety information in collaboration with the Medical and Pharmacovigilance teams.
Monitor investigational product storage, handling, dispensing, temperature records, reconciliation and accountability at sites.
Support the management of laboratory samples, central laboratory activities, imaging requirements and other study-specific vendor processes.
Ensure that essential study documents are complete, accurate and filed promptly in the Investigator Site File and Trial Master File.
Support the maintenance of inspection-ready clinical documentation throughout the study lifecycle.
Coordinate with CROs and external service providers, monitor assigned deliverables and follow up on operational issues and action items.
Work cross-functionally with Medical, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Data Management, Biostatistics, Clinical Supply and other internal and external stakeholders.
Prepare monitoring reports, site follow-up communications, study trackers, status reports, meeting materials and operational metrics within required timelines.
Participate in study-team meetings and provide clear updates on site progress, recruitment, risks, issues and proposed mitigation measures.
Support clinical study audits, regulatory inspections and the preparation and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Perform other clinical operations duties reasonably assigned by the Director of Clinical Operations.
Qualifications and Experience
Bachelor’s degree or above in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, medicine, biomedical sciences or another relevant healthcare discipline.
At least two years of clinical research experience, including independent monitoring experience in interventional pharmaceutical clinical trials.
Experience in Phase II or Phase III multinational or multi-regional clinical trials is preferred.
Oncology and/or ophthalmology clinical trial experience is strongly preferred. Experience in breast cancer studies would be an advantage.
Good working knowledge of clinical trial processes, ICH-GCP, informed consent requirements, safety reporting, essential documents and clinical data review.
Familiarity with Hong Kong ethics committee, Hospital Authority and Department of Health clinical trial procedures or experiences in other Aisia pacific and/or USA clinical study process would be an advantage.
Knowledge of FDA, NMPA or other international clinical trial requirements would be beneficial.
Experience with electronic data-capture systems, clinical trial management systems, electronic Trial Master Files and other clinical technology platforms is preferred.
Candidates with more extensive monitoring experience may be considered for appointment as Senior Clinical Research Associate.
Skills and Competencies
Strong site-management and relationship-building skills.
Excellent attention to detail, organisational ability and commitment to clinical quality.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and meet demanding study timelines.
Proactive problem-solving skills with the ability to identify, assess and escalate clinical risks appropriately.
Strong written and spoken English.
Proficiency in Cantonese and Mandarin is preferred.
Effective communication and collaboration skills when working with international and cross-functional teams.
Willingness and ability to travel within Hong Kong, Mainland China and internationally as required by the studies.
What We Offer
Direct involvement in global, late-stage clinical development programmes.
Broad sponsor-side exposure across clinical trial planning, execution, monitoring and oversight.
The opportunity to work closely with experienced clinical leadership and international investigators.
A collaborative and fast-growing biopharmaceutical environment based in Hong Kong.
Opportunities for professional development and increased responsibility as HHP’s global clinical portfolio expands.

title: Manager – Veterinary Nursing Training
teaser:

Promote a culture of safety, welfare, and...
jd:
Roles & Responsibilities
Training Programme Design
Develop structured, multi‑phase practical training curricula for entry‑level vet nurse trainees.
Create weekly modules, skill checklists, and competency milestones.
Design hands‑on learning activities aligned with clinic workflows and case types.
Produce training materials such as SOPs, manuals, videos, and assessment tools.
Practical Training Delivery
Provide on‑site coaching in animal handling, clinical nursing, diagnostics, surgical support, and patient care.
Demonstrate procedures using a “observe → assist → perform under supervision → perform independently” progression.
Conduct skills labs, simulations, and supervised practice sessions.
Ensure trainees follow low‑stress handling and welfare‑first practices.
Assessment & Quality Assurance
Develop and administer competency assessments (skill sign offs).
Evaluate trainee performance and provide structured feedback.
Identify learning gaps and implement remediation plans.
Audit training quality, safety compliance, and documentation standards.
Safety & Compliance
Establish and enforce safety protocols for animal handling, sharps, chemicals, radiology, and infection control.
Ensure training activities comply with local veterinary regulations and clinic policies.
Promote a culture of safety, welfare, and professionalism.
Mentorship & Stakeholder Support
Train clinic mentors and supervisors.
Facilitate communication between trainees, mentors, and veterinary surgeons.
Advise clinic leadership on training capacity, workflow integration, and resource planning.
Design and Deliver Practical Training for Other Animal-Care Roles with the Society
Customer Services (CS)
Training on basic animal welfare knowledge, triage questioning, client communication, and service flow.
Ensure CS staff understand clinical terminology, appointment types, and safety protocols.
Homing Assistants
Training in behaviour assessment, adoption counselling, animal handling, and welfare monitoring.
Develop SOPs for homing procedures, matching assessments, and post‑adoption support.
Inspectorate
Training on triage, animal first aid, monitoring vital signs
Ensure inspectors understand clinical red flags and referral pathways.
Kennel Keepers / Animal Attendants
Training in husbandry, cleaning protocols, enrichment, feeding, monitoring, and low‑stress handling.
Develop competency checklists for daily care routines and welfare standards.
Qualification & Requirements
Registered Veterinary Nurse (RVN), Licensed Veterinary Technician (LVT), or equivalent qualification.
Minimum 10 years’ experience in veterinary nursing experience.
Experience in training, mentoring, or supervising junior staff will be an advantage.
Strong knowledge of small animal clinical procedures, anaesthesia, diagnostics, and patient care.
Clinical expertise in general practice nursing and patient care.
Instructional design for practical, competency‑based training.
Good presentation and facilitation skills.
Coaching and mentorship with clear communication and patience.
Assessment literacy for evaluating skills and knowledge.
Safety leadership and risk management.
Professionalism and ethical decision‑making.
Organisational skills for managing multiple trainees and clinics.
On site work in SPCA veterinary clinics / hospitals, and / or training centres is required.
Physical work involving animal handling, lifting, and clinical procedures.
Travel between clinic locations if supporting multiple sites is required.

title: Claims Specialist
teaser: This is an exciting opportunity to join Swiss Re's Life & Health Reinsurance Market Unit in Hong Kong as a Claims Specialist, where your technical...
jd:
Are you a seasoned claims professional with a passion for technical excellence and a drive to make a real difference in the Life & Health reinsurance space? If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and want to be at the heart of a dynamic team shaping the future of claims management across Asia Pacific, this could be the role for you.
>About the Role
>This is an exciting opportunity to join Swiss Re's Life & Health Reinsurance Market Unit in Hong Kong as a Claims Specialist, where your technical expertise will directly influence the quality and integrity of claims decisions across the HKTW portfolio. You'll be a key contributor to a team that values precision, fairness, and continuous improvement — working at the intersection of client service, governance, and claims innovation.
>Reporting to the Head of L&H Underwriting, Claims & HNW for Hong Kong & Taiwan, you will play an instrumental role in delivering a meaningful, best-in-class claims service while sharing expertise with clients and internal stakeholders across the region.
>Key Responsibilities
Maintain governance guidelines and quality control for a robust operation of HKTW L&H Claims and ensuring adherence to relevant frameworks and standards
Manage and assess claims with technical rigor, delivering fair, accurate, and timely decisions that align with policy terms, conditions, and pricing assumptions
Support Claims Reviews and Audits within the internal framework, providing actionable recommendations to improve both technical decision-making and operational efficiency to enhance clients' claims standards
Support client engagement through visits and training sessions, enhancing the quality and effectiveness of claims management
Support the development of training materials and programs tailored to client requirements and emerging industry topics
Provide technical input on emerging issues and actively support process enhancement initiatives
Maintain accountability for individual claim quality, accuracy, turnaround times, and a high standard of customer service
>About the Team
>The Underwriting and Claims team is part of Life & Health Reinsurance Market Unit Hong Kong & Taiwan. The team is responsible for delivering disciplined, high-quality risk selection for HNW business while supporting sound management of the in-force portfolio. Working closely with cross-functional teams across L&H, the team applies deep underwriting expertise and portfolio insights to support strong new business margins, sustainable client solutions, and informed portfolio decisions — all while championing operational excellence, risk governance, and continuous improvement across the HNW underwriting value chain.
>About You
You are a technically strong, detail-oriented claims professional who brings both depth of expertise and a collaborative spirit to everything you do. You are comfortable navigating complexity, engaging with clients, and contributing to a team culture that values curiosity, integrity, and continuous learning. You know how to balance the detail with the bigger picture — and you're not afraid to challenge the status quo when it leads to better outcomes.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:
University degree or equivalent qualification in insurance, business, financial services, law, or a medical discipline
5+ years of experience in critical illness, disability, death and medical claims within an insurance or reinsurance environment, with demonstrated technical proficiency in assessing complex claims.
Strong knowledge of Life & Health insurance/reinsurance, including technical claims assessment, underwriting principles, and product knowledge
Proven analytical capability, including experience handling and interpreting large volumes of data to inform decisions and identify trends
Excellent communication skills in English and Cantonese, with the ability to present, influence, and engage effectively with both
internal stakeholders and external clients; proficiency in Mandarin will be considered an asset
Experience working in cross-functional teams, with the ability to build strong relationships across diverse groups
Curiosity and courage to challenge existing approaches, bringing fresh thinking that enhances business outcomes
Ability to step back from details to see the bigger picture.
The base salary range for this position will be shared with you during the interview process
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

(a) 全面管理青年事務組相關的行政支援及執行工作，並確保符合政府最新訂立的相關關鍵績效指標；

(a) 獲取錄者將按非公務員合約條款聘用，為期兩年;

>(c) 一般為5天工作，並按需要於晚間、週末、公眾假期，或前往內地或海外執行職務。
(a) 受聘人如能圓滿地履行合約，期間表現和行為一直保持高水平，即可獲發約滿酬金。該筆酬金加上政府根據強制性公積金計劃所作的供款，相等於所得底薪總額的10%。
>(b) 12天年假、根據香港《僱傭條例》規定給予而又適用之休息日，法定假日(或另定/代替假日)、公眾假期、產假/侍產假和疾病津貼。
>(c) 強制性公積金供款。
(a) 除另有指明外，申請人於獲聘時必須已成為香港特別行政區永久性居民。
>(b) 作為提供平等就業機會的僱主，政府致力消除在就業方面的歧視。所有符合基本入職條件的人士，不論其殘疾、性別、婚姻狀況、懷孕、年齡、家庭崗位、性傾向和種族，均可申請本欄內的職位。
>(c) 非公務員職位並不是公務員編制內的職位。應徵者如獲聘用，將不會按公務員聘用條款和服務條件聘用。獲聘的應徵者並非公務員，並不會享有獲調派、晉升或轉職至公務員職位的資格。
>(d) 入職薪酬、聘用條款及服務條件，應以獲聘時之規定為準。
>(e) 如果符合訂明入職條件的應徵者人數眾多，招聘部門可以訂立篩選準則，甄選條件較佳的應徵者，以便進一步處理。在此情況下，只有獲篩選的應徵者會獲邀參加招聘考試╱面試。
>(f) 政府的政策，是盡可能安排殘疾人士擔任適合的職位。殘疾人士申請職位，如其符合入職條件，毋須再經篩選，便會獲邀參加招聘考試／面試。在適合受聘而有申報為殘疾的申請人和適合受聘程度相若的其他申請人當中，招聘當局可給予前者適度的優先錄用機會。有關政府聘用殘疾人士的政策及其他相關措施載列於《用人唯才：殘疾人士申請政府職位》的資料冊內。申請人可於公務員事務局互聯網站參閱該資料冊，網址如下：https://www.csb.gov.hk內的 “公務員隊伍的管理-聘任”。
申請人必須透過公務員事務局的G.F. 340網上申請系統 (https://www.csb.gov.hk) 作網上申請。申請書如資料不全或以親身、郵寄、傳真或電郵方式遞交，概不受理。

Job Description:
>This role is responsible for supporting Global Financial Crimes Investigations in submitting Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs), through the review of Activity Intelligence Reports (AIRs), preparation of SAR narratives, and quality review of SAR narratives for submission to Money Laundering Reporting Officers (MLROs).
The successful candidate will act as a key partner to MLROs and investigative teams, ensuring SAR narratives clearly articulate suspicious activity, are factually accurate, and comply with applicable regulatory, legal and policy requirements. The role requires the ability to review complex financial crime investigations, assess investigative findings, and communicate conclusions effectively through concise, high-quality written narratives.
Key responsibilities include maintaining adherence to strict regulatory and internal service level agreements, identifying potential quality concerns, supporting continuous improvement initiatives, and contributing to the effective mitigation of financial crime risk across multiple jurisdictions.
Responsibilities:
Draft clear, accurate, and comprehensive SAR narratives that effectively communicate suspicious activity, financial crime typologies, customer behaviour, transactional activity, and investigative findings.
Perform quality reviews of draft SAR narratives to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, internal standards, and jurisdiction-specific reporting expectations.
Partner closely with Money Laundering Reporting Officers (MLROs) to support regulatory reporting decisions and facilitate timely filing of SARs with applicable Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs).
Challenge and provide feedback on AIR quality, investigative findings, and narrative completeness where additional information or clarification is required.
Ensure all assigned work is completed within established regulatory and internal service level agreements while maintaining high quality standards.
Identify trends, recurring quality issues, and opportunities to enhance narrative consistency, investigative outputs, and reporting effectiveness.
Support governance, quality assurance, and continuous improvement initiatives related to SAR reporting and financial crime investigations.
Escalate risks, issues, and emerging financial crime concerns through appropriate governance channels.
Maintain current knowledge of applicable AML regulations, financial crime typologies, and jurisdiction-specific SAR reporting
Required Skills:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
Demonstrable Anti-Money Laundering (AML), financial crimes, investigations, compliance, intelligence, or sanctions experience.
Experience reviewing investigations, AIRs, case documentation, or regulatory reporting submissions.
Excellent written communication skills with the ability to translate complex investigative findings into concise and effective regulatory narratives.
Experience interpreting financial crime typologies and identifying suspicious activity indicators.
Ability to analyse large volumes of information and exercise sound judgement in a risk-based environment
Proven stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively with investigators, MLROs, compliance partners, and senior stakeholders.
Desired Skills:
ACAMS, ICA, or equivalent financial crime certification.
Experience drafting or reviewing Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs).
Knowledge of global financial crimes regulations and international reporting requirements.
Experience working with Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs), regulatory reporting teams, or MLRO functions.
Knowledge of global banking products, transaction flows, and associated financial crime risks

title: FCC Advisor, Onboarding

jd:
Job Summary
>
The CDD/FCC Advisor role provides specialist client due diligence, financial crime risk, and policy advisory support for SME and Corporate onboarding, periodic reviews, trigger reviews, and related client lifecycle activities. The role is responsible for advising frontline, Client Management Unit (CMU), and relevant control teams on CDD requirements, risk assessment standards, documentation expectations, escalation handling, and process interpretation. The role supports the delivery of consistent, risk-based, and commercially practical CDD outcomes while ensuring adherence to applicable Group policies, procedures, regulatory expectations, and conduct standards.
Key Responsibilities
>
Strategy
>• Support the SME and Corporate banking business model by providing clear, risk-based advisory guidance on client onboarding, review, and maintenance requirements.
>• Contribute to the continuous enhancement of CDD standards, controls, and advisory practices to improve quality, consistency, and operational efficiency.
>• Promote a balanced approach between business enablement, client experience, regulatory compliance, and financial crime risk management.
Business
>• Provide timely advisory support to Relationship Managers, CMU, CDD Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders on SME and Corporate CDD cases, including complex ownership, sanction escalation, adverse media, industry risk, shell company indicators, and other enhanced due diligence considerations.
>• Review and advise on escalated cases, exceptions, policy interpretation queries, and risk-based documentation requirements to enable appropriate client lifecycle decisions.
>• Support business teams in understanding CDD requirements and resolving advisory queries in a clear, practical, and consistent manner.
>• Identify recurring themes, process gaps, and training needs arising from advisory queries and quality assurance observations.
Processes
>• Apply and interpret relevant CDD, AML, sanctions, customer risk assessment, and client lifecycle procedures for SME and Corporate clients in accordance with Group and local requirements.
>• Maintain effective advisory logs, case records, rationale documentation, and audit trails to support transparency, quality assurance, and regulatory review readiness.
>• Support the development, review, and communication of process notes, and guidance materials for SME and Corporate, CDD stakeholders.
>• Coordinate with Relationship Managers, CMU, CDD Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders to facilitate timely resolution of cases, rectification items, quality findings, and process clarification requests.
People & Talent
>• Act as a subject matter resource for SME and Corporate FCC and CDD matters and support knowledge sharing across frontline, CMU, CDD Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders.
>• Provide coaching, guidance, and constructive feedback to stakeholders to improve case quality, risk awareness, and first-time-right outcomes.
>• Collaborate effectively across teams and promote a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and disciplined execution.
Risk Management
>• Identify, assess, escalate, and help resolve financial crime, conduct, compliance, and operational risks arising from SME and Corporate CDD cases and advisory activities.
>• Ensure advisory guidance reflects applicable AML, sanctions, fraud, reputational risk, and customer risk assessment requirements.
>• Support the timely escalation of higher-risk matters, policy deviations, control gaps, and emerging risk themes to appropriate governance forums or senior stakeholders.
>• Contribute to remediation, rectification, and assurance activities where SME and Corporate CDD advisory input is required.
Governance
>• Operate within applicable governance, delegated authority, escalation, and record-keeping requirements.
>• Provide accurate and balanced management information, thematic updates, and advisory insights to support governance oversight and process improvements.
>• Support adherence to Group, Country, Business, and Functional policies and procedures, including timely communication of relevant updates to stakeholders.
Regulatory & Business Conduct
>• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
>• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
>• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Key stakeholders
>• SME and Corporate Relationship Managers and frontline business teams
>• Client Management Unit / CDD Operations
>• Financial Crime Compliance, Sanctions, and Compliance teams
>• Audit, and Risk teams
>• Product, Process, and Transformation teams involved in SME and Corporate client lifecycle management
Other Responsibilities
>• Embed Here for good and the Group’s brand and values in the SME and Corporate related FCC and CDD advisory function. Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures, including support for policy implementation, process improvement, stakeholder training, audit or assurance requests, and cross-functional initiatives relevant to SME client lifecycle and financial crime risk management.
Skills and Experience
>
• Client Due Diligence / Know Your Customer
>• Financial Crime Compliance
>• Risk Assessment and Escalation
>• Policy Interpretation and Advisory
>• Stakeholder Management and Communication
>• Process Improvement and Quality Assurance
Qualifications
>
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Finance, Risk Management, Law, Compliance, or a related discipline.
>• Over 3 years of solid experience in FCC and/or CDD within SME and Corporate Banking.
>• Knowledge of Corporate Banking operation model in complexity structure is preferable.
>• Knowledge of business model in both HK and China is preferable.
>• Project Management Experience and/or MI Analysis Skill is preferable.
>• Not mandatory unless required by local regulatory or business requirements.
>• Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, ACAMS, compliance, AML, sanctions, or risk related qualifications are preferred but not mandatory.
>• Strong written and spoken English. Chinese language capability, including Cantonese and/or Mandarin, is preferred.
About Standard Chartered
>
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
Together we:
Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
What we offer
>
In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Support Innovation and Change. Partner with local Control Management teams on strategic initiatives and projects, contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Positive attitude, strong team spirit, and outstanding collaboration skills.
Ability to navigate and influence within a complex organizational structure involving multiple stakeholders at various levels
High level of accuracy and ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.

4. 编写培训材料、SOP及速查指南，并在上线前面向一线服务人员及相关方开展培训与宣导；
5. 上线后监控系统表现、用户使用情况及运营指标，作为数字化服务问题的第一升级对接人，排查问题并协调IT及时解决；

7. 确保所有数字化方案符合内部政策、监管要求及数据隐私规范，并对所有流程及系统变更保持规范的文档与版本管理。

>
Qualifications:
1. Bachelor’s degree or above in Business Administration, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.
2. 3–5 years of relevant experience in client service operations, digital transformation, or business analysis within the financial services, banking, or fintech sectors, with a proven track record in digitalizing client-facing processes (e.g., account opening, CRM, client portals).
3. Solid understanding of client lifecycle management and frontline service workflows, with a strong ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
4. Hands-on experience with UAT, system rollout, and change management; familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies is preferred.
5. Proficient in process mapping tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart) and basic data analysis; knowledge of regulatory requirements (e.g., KYC, AML, GDPR/PIPL) is a strong plus.
6. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge business and IT teams; strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with exceptional attention to detail.
7. Self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, evolving environment; able to remain calm and effective under pressure, demonstrating strong resilience when handling urgent issues.
8. Client-centric and a strong team player with a collaborative attitude; fluent in both English and Chinese (Mandarin), written and spoken.
任职资格:

2. 3–5年金融机构、银行或金融科技领域客户服务运营、数字化转型或业务分析经验，具有面向客户的流程（如开户、CRM、客户门户）线上化落地经验者优先；
3. 深入理解客户生命周期管理与一线客户服务流程，具备将业务需求转化为技术规格的较强能力；
4. 具有UAT、系统上线及变更管理实操经验，熟悉敏捷/Scrum模式者优先；
5. 熟练使用流程绘制工具及基础数据分析，了解KYC、反洗钱、GDPR/PIPL等监管要求者更佳；
6. 优秀的沟通与利益相关方管理能力，能有效衔接业务与IT团队，具备较强的分析与解决问题能力，注重细节；
7. 自驱力强，以结果为导向，能在快节奏变化环境中同时推进多个项目；抗压力强，能够在压力下保持冷静与高效，妥善处理紧急问题；
8. 以客户为中心，具备良好的团队合作精神与协作意识，中英文（普通话）流利，书面与口语俱佳。

jd:
About the role
We are seeking a highly motivated and creative Scientist / Senior Scientist – Translational Pharmacologist to join our discovery team in Hong Kong with experience in pulmonary drug formulation and who possesses a multidisciplinary skill set integrating pharmaceutical sciences, biomedical engineering aerosol technology and pharmacokinetics to design, optimize and develop inhaled therapeutics for local or systemic delivery via respiratory tract to treat cancer and inflammation.
Key responsibilities
Design, conduct, and oversee pharmacology studies that support the development of anticancer small molecules in in vitro and in vivo animal models, including selection of cancer cell lines, patient-derived organoids, patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models, and conventional xenograft efficacy models. Specifically, you must be able to: (a) evaluate compound antitumor activity using modern efficacy-assessment techniques, (b) conduct pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) studies to assess disposition, tissue distribution, and delivery strategies, including pulmonary delivery, to optimize therapeutic exposure and maximize antitumor activity.
Develop or select relevant translational biomarkers to monitor drug activity.
Collaborate closely with medicinal chemistry teams and external institutions to guide lead optimization through integrated analysis of potency, selectivity, PK/PD, efficacy, and biomarker data.
Support development from lead optimization through IND-enabling studies and early clinical development.
Manage external CRO and academic collaborations to achieve project objectives.
Present scientific findings to internal project teams, senior management, external collaborators, and at scientific meetings.
Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, patent applications, and regulatory documentation.
About you
PhD in Pharmacy, Pharmacology, Pharmaceutical Sciences or a related discipline.
Postdoctoral and/or pharmaceutical industry experience in oncology drug discovery.
Strong knowledge of animal models of cancer and molecular pharmacology.
Experience in translational research and technology transfer from bench-scale formulation to clinical trial is desirable.
Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) evaluation of lung tissue distribution, systemic absorption, clearance and bioavailability.
Bridging PK/PD data in animal models to humans, including modeling dose-response relationships and optimizing therapeutic index.
Experience with pulmonary drug delivery/inhaled therapeutics will be required.
Strong background in translational research to develop biomarkers is required.
Hands-on experience tumor measurement techniques in animal models, molecular and cellular biology techniques including cell culture, qPCR and high-content imaging, etc.
Excellent experimental design, analytical thinking and scientific communication skills.
Strong scientific judgement, creativity and problem-solving ability.
Excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary teams.
Excellent written and spoken English; fluency in Cantonese and Mandarin.
About us
OncoNex-Remunity Therapeutics group of companies is a clinical-stage biotech focused on discovering and developing next-generation safe and effective targeted anti-cancer therapeutics. Our pipeline is built around precision oncology, leveraging deep expertise in biologics, kinase biology, medicinal chemistry and translational science to develop best-in-class therapies for patients with cancers driven by actionable genomic alterations. Our multidisciplinary research team integrates medicinal chemistry, translational pharmacology, biomarker science, drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics (DMPK), and drug delivery sciences to develop innovative precision medicines with optimized efficacy, safety and patient convenience.
Benefits
Contribute directly to the development of first-in-class and best-in-class precision oncology medicines.
Work in a highly collaborative international environment integrating medicinal chemistry, structural biology, translational science and clinical development.
Participate in every stage of drug discovery, from target validation through clinical candidate selection.

Outstanding opportunities for scientific leadership, publication, patent generation and career advancement.

2）基金及專戶營運風險管控。統籌基金、專戶全流程風險核查；監控資產淨值核算差異、對賬中斷、結算失敗、企業行動處理疏漏；監督投資者客戶盡職調查及反洗黑錢（KYC/AML）流程，把控申贖條款、贖回限制豁免、第三方付款審批等操作風險。

4）建立及優化內控體系、規章制度及標準作業流程（SOP），定期修訂風險管理流程文件；事前識別產品營運、交易、估值、申贖環節潛在風險，開展新產品風險盡調；建立投資違規登記簿、對賬差異登記簿、第三方評估登記簿、交易異常預警登記簿；定期開展內部風險自查、流程漏洞排查，完善中後台內控缺失環節。
5）業務持續運作及數據安全管理。跟進災難復原計劃（BCP），定期覆核異地數據備份、系統災難復原成效；管控投資者主檔、交易登記簿、估值數據等機密資料權限及保密管理，監督全體員工遵從文件保密規範。

入職要求
1）學士或以上學歷，金融、會計、法律、統計、財務管理等相關專業；
2）3 年或以上香港證監會持牌資產管理公司、基金行政管理人或託管行風險管理 / 合規相關工作經驗，熟悉香港證監會公募基金內控規則；
3）具備完整風險管理實務經驗，精通 Bloomberg AIM 風險預警系統，熟悉跨境證券、債券、衍生工具交易風險管控邏輯；熟悉基金估值、清算、申贖全流程操作風險點；
4）能獨立編製風險管理登記簿、違規記錄、風險報告，對數據敏感度高，可獨立識別、追溯及完結各類操作及合規風險；
5）邏輯縝密、責任心強，具備對接監管機構、外部合作單位的溝通能力；中英文讀寫流利，能操粵語者優先；
6）熟悉客戶盡職調查及反洗黑錢（KYC/AML）流程、業務持續運作計劃（BCP）、文件保密管理體系，有內部審計、合規自查經驗者優先。

Experience in chip design, fabrication, or simulation (e.g., COMSOL, Lumerical, Sonnet).
Strong skills in programming, data analysis, and scientific communication.

The Director, APAC & China Trade owns end‑to‑end trade outcomes, spanning trade operations in APAC and regional trade compliance across APAC markets and Mainland China. This role serves as the single accountable regional leader for customs compliance, broker governance, duty payments, audit readiness, and trade execution, ensuring alignment to global standards while managing region‑specific regulatory complexity. The role partners closely with the Global Trade Compliance CoE, Fulfillment, Technology, Finance, Tax, and Legal teams to deliver compliant, cost‑effective, and scalable trade operations and regional compliance.
Set the regional direction for trade across APAC and Mainland China, balancing global standards with local regulatory realities to deliver compliant, cost‑effective, and scalable trade operations.

Define and govern the regional customs broker strategy by authoring and approving statements of work, setting and monitoring KPIs, leading quarterly business reviews, selecting and transitioning brokers, and driving corrective actions where performance gaps exist.
Ensure entry quality and compliance assurance by establishing risk‑based controls, approving post‑entry corrections and prior disclosures, setting documentation timeliness standards, and owning regional entry accuracy performance and reporting.
Lead duty stewardship across jurisdictions by approving assessments, ensuring accurate and on‑time duty and tax payments and reconciliations, and reporting duty spend, savings, opportunities, and exposure.
Oversee Free Trade Agreement (FTA) and duty‑optimization programs to ensure correct eligibility and supplier evidence, prevent misuse, realize savings, and support readiness for new and expanding distribution centres (e.g., Singapore and Japan).
Set regional audit readiness standards by defining audit playbooks and recordkeeping requirements, leading responses to customs authorities, and managing material findings and escalations in partnership with Trade Compliance CoE.
Lead the regional operating model and talent strategy, managing a multi‑country organization, setting SLAs with Fulfilment, Supply Chain and Finance, and developing leaders to scale consistent execution.
Act as the regional owner of trade systems and data stewardship by ensuring trade data quality (HTS, COO, MID, valuation, entries), signing off on data requirements and UAT for trade‑critical changes, and escalating systemic issues to the Trade Compliance CoE.

Significant experience operating in APAC and China
Proven leadership of multi‑country teams in complex regulatory environments
Deep expertise in customs compliance, broker management, and duty optimization
Strong regulatory engagement and audit leadership capability
Executive‑level stakeholder management across Legal, Finance, Operations, and Technology
High‑judgement decision‑making in ambiguous, high‑risk environments
Ability to balance global standards with local regulatory realities

Acknowledges the presence of choice in every moment and takes personal responsibility for their life.
Possesses an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovates to achieve great results.
Communicates with honesty and kindness, and creates the space for others to do the same.

工作职责
Job Title: Technical Assistant（BioCRF）质谱色谱方向
工作岗位：技术助理（BioCRF）质谱色谱方向
Department: Biosciences Central Research Facility (BioCRF), HKUST (GZ)
部门：生物科学中央实验室，香港科技大学（广州）
*该岗位的用工形式为派遣，依法缴纳五险一金，受聘者将与第三方派遣公司签订合同。
Job Posting Details
Formally established in June 2022, the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)(HKUST(GZ)) is a cooperatively run higher education institution between the Chinese mainland and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. HKUST(GZ) has obtained approval from the Ministry of Education (MoE) and become the first legally independent educational institution co-established by the Mainland and Hong Kong since the announcement and implementation of the “Outline Development Plan for the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area” and the “Overall Plan for Deepening Globally Oriented Comprehensive Co-operation amongst Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao in Nansha of Guangzhou”. With a spirit of pioneering innovation, HKUST(GZ) charts new territories in cross-disciplinary education and explores new frontiers in pedagogies, aiming to serve as a role model of the mainland-Hong Kong integrated educational development and become a world-famous high-level university, endeavoring to nurture future-oriented, high-level, and innovative talents.
HKUST(GZ) comprises four Hubs, namely Function Hub, Information Hub, Systems Hub, Society Hub and offers 15 postgraduate degrees. The admission of undergraduate students will begin in 2023, with the first batch of programs covering artificial intelligence, data science and big data technology.
The Biosciences Central Research Facility (BioCRF) at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) is a cutting-edge core facility for biotechnological research. It offers advanced research platforms, state-of-the-art equipment, professional services, training and educational programs to support researchers in utilizing the latest biotechnological tools and techniques. The facility is designed to support in-house researchers as well as research community from academic institutions and industry.
香港科技大学（广州）生物科学中央实验室（BioCRF）是生物技术与科学研究的前沿中心。实验室提供先进的研究平台、前沿的实验设备、专业的技术服务与培训以及丰富的教育资源，以支持科研人员使用最新的生物科学技术与工具。实验室旨在为来自校内以及其他学术机构和工业界的广大科学研究人员提供全面的技术支持与科研服务。了解更多香港科技大学（广州）生物科学中央实验室（BioCRF）相关信息可以访问： https://biocrfgz.hkust-gz.edu.cn/。
岗位职责：
1. 负责仪器设备的日常管理和维护，确保其稳定、高效运行；
2. 负责样品的制备、检测及数据分析，保证实验结果的准确性与可靠性；
3. 编写仪器操作规程（SOP），为科研人员提供专业培训和技术指导；
4. 组织学术交流活动，包括研讨会、用户培训和技术工作坊等，促进新技术推广应用；
5. 监督实验室安全管理，确保所有操作符合健康安全规范；
6. 完成上级交办的其他相关任务。
Key Responsibilities:
1. Perform daily maintenance on the instruments.
2. Perform sample preparation, testing, and data analysis.
3. Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for instruments and provide professional training and technical guidance to researchers.
4. Organize academic exchange activities, including seminars, user training, and technical workshops to promote new technologies.
5. Ensure the adherence to safety practices per Health and Safety regulations.
6. Complete other tasks assigned by supervisors.
任职要求
职位要求：
1. 生物科学及相关专业硕士及以上学历；
2. 熟悉液相色谱仪、质谱仪器的样品制备、仪器操作及数据分析方法的优先；
3. 具备良好的英语能力，能够熟练阅读英文文献、操作流程及设备说明书，同时具有良好的中英文写作能力；
4. 具有强烈的责任心和团队协作精神，工作细致认真，善于沟通，有较强的学习能力和解决问题能力。
Qualifications:
1. Master's degree or above in Biological Sciences or related fields.
2. Preference will be given to candidates familiar with sample preparation, instrument operation, and data analysis methods for liquid chromatographs and mass spectrometers.
3. Strong English proficiency with ability to read scientific literature, operational procedures, and equipment manuals; good writing skills in both Chinese and English;
4. Strong sense of responsibility and team spirit, detail-oriented, excellent communication skills, strong learning ability and problem-solving skills.

Complete project research, including but not limited to preparation of test scheme, pharmaceutical experimental research (formulation, technology, quality control, and stability, etc).

The candidate should be familiar with the primary manufacturing processes for oral solid dosage forms, such as direct compression, dry granulation, and wet granulation. • 技術：熟練使用 Qiskit / Cirq / PennyLane 等量子計算框架；熟練 Python；具備扎實的量子力學、線性代數與算法建模能力。
• 具備獨立設計研究方案並推進至成果輸出的能力。
• 語言：具備良好的中英文能力，並能撰寫英文技術論文。
>
優先考慮條件
• 具備真機實驗與誤差緩解的實踐經驗。
• 具備量子算法在生物醫藥或材料領域的交叉研究成果。
• 有同行評審期刊／會議論文發表。
