>At STERRY, we're not your average marketing agency—we're the rocket fuel behind crowdfunding and e-commerce success. Since day one, we've helped clients generate over $100 million in trackable online revenue through strategies rooted in measurable performance.
About the Role
>We are looking for a highly organized and technically skilled Freelance Fashion / Product Developer Designer to join our team remotely. In this role, you are the critical bridge between our creative design team and our overseas/domestic manufacturing partners.
Since we operate 100% remotely, your success depends on your ability to translate ideas into flawless digital blueprints, manage factory relationships via email and video calls, and self-manage your workflow across different time zones. You will not just draw; you will engineer garments for commercial production.
Key Responsibilities
>1. Technical Development
Translate initial creative sketches and mood boards into highly detailed digital Tech Packs (using Adobe Illustrator, CLO 3D, or Excel) that include graded specs, construction callouts, stitch types, and trim details.
Research, recommend, and source appropriate fabrics, hardware, and wash finishes that match the design intent while meeting cost and sustainability targets.
Conduct remote fit sessions (via Zoom/Teams), providing clear digital comments and photos to factories on pattern adjustments and construction fixes.
2. Remote Factory & Vendor Communication
Serve as the main point of contact for our manufacturing partners via email, WhatsApp, and scheduled video conferences.
Negotiate pricing, lead times, and minimum order quantities (MOQs) remotely.
Troubleshoot production issues in real-time by reviewing factory-reported problems through shared digital files (Google Drive, Dropbox) and providing immediate solutions.
3. Project & Timeline Management
Own the production calendar from sample stage to bulk delivery, ensuring all milestones are met despite geographic distances.
Proactively flag potential delays (e.g., fabric shortages, sample failures) to the internal team using project management tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, or Slack).
4. Quality Assurance & Costing
Establish clear quality standards (AQL levels) and ensure factories adhere to them via remote inspection checklists.
Breakdown garment costs (Costing Sheets) to ensure the final product sits within the target wholesale and retail margins.
What We Are Looking For
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design, Fashion Merchandising/Product Development, or related field is a plus—but what truly matters is your attitude and ability to grow. Eagerness to learn is just as valued as experience.
Experience: 3+ years of experience in fashion product development, technical design, or production management (freelance or in-house).Must have proven experience in apparel development, with specific expertise in intimate wear.
Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in creating Tech Packs (Adobe Illustrator is a must; CLO 3D or Browzwear is a huge plus). Strong knowledge of woven, knit, and cut-and-sew construction.
Remote Work Proficiency:
Digital Collaboration: Comfortable using Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, and other project management tools daily.
Communication: Excellent English written and verbal skills
Problem Solving: Ability to diagnose a fit or construction issue from photos/videos sent by a factory and explain the fix clearly without being physically present.
Home Office Setup: You must have a reliable high-speed internet connection, a quiet space for video calls.
Portfolio Requirement: Please submit a portfolio showcasing your relevant apparel and intimate wear development work. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
Preferred
Experience working directly with Asian or European manufacturing hubs.
Familiarity with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) software.

teaser: As our first Data Governance Manager, you will build Reap's data governance function from scratch, starting with the client data segregation...
jd:
Founded in 2018
Security at Reap
>
Reap builds financial connectivity for a multi‑rail world-traditional finance, stablecoins, and real‑time payments. Security is foundational to that mission. We're looking for a pragmatic engineer who can turn regulation into robust systems, and complex threats into clear controls. You'll partner with Engineering, Risk, and Operations to keep value moving safely, globally, and 24/7.
Your Mission
>
Reap is mid-acquisition by Payward/Kraken and we have a live contractual problem: Client requires that no Payward employee can access client data held by Reap. Today we have no data catalogue, no classification scheme, and no audit trail that proves the boundary is being enforced. That is the gap you will close.
As our first Data Governance Manager, you will build Reap's data governance function from scratch, starting with the client data segregation framework as your day-one priority and expanding into a full DCAM-aligned programme across all five of our jurisdictions. This is a hands-on builder role in a company that is growing fast and needs the data infrastructure to match.
What You Will Do
>
• Build and own the data segregation framework: map every data asset across our production systems, Snowflake, dashboards, and pipelines; classify it as Restricted; and put the access controls in place that keep Payward-affiliated personnel out.
• Stand up the Data Governance Council and chair it: bring together CISO, CRO, COO, Head of Product, Head of Engineering, and CFO into a functioning quarterly governance body with a real decision log.
• Publish and enforce the Data Classification Policy across all of Reap's jurisdictions: four tiers, applied from day one, with data as the first use case.
• Own our GDPR Article 30 Records of Processing Activities for data flows and keep them current as we add products and geographies.
• Build the enterprise data catalogue: document lineage, ownership, and access rights for our highest-risk data domains, starting with and payment card data.
• Own our DSAR process end-to-end in coordination with our external DPO.
• Lead the five-phase DCAM-aligned Data Governance programme beyond the client foundation: data quality, metadata management, data catalogue tooling, and control integration with our security stack.
Your Superpowers
>
• 5+ years in data governance, data management, or a CDO/data office function. You have built programmes, not just documented policies.
• You have done this in a regulated environment. Financial services, fintech, or crypto is a strong plus. You understand what it means when a regulator asks for evidence.
• Hands-on with at least one data catalogue tool. Alation, Atlan, Collibra, or Microsoft Purview. You have procured or deployed one, not just evaluated it.
• You have designed and enforced data classification schemes. Including in environments with third-party data segregation obligations.
• GDPR Art. 30 ROPA ownership. You know what a defensible ROPA looks like and how to keep it current without it becoming a once-a-year exercise.
• You are a programme manager who can run a governance council. You get busy senior stakeholders into a room, make decisions, and close loops.
Nice to Have
>
• CDMP or CIPP/E certification.
• Experience with DORA operational risk data requirements.
• Familiarity with PDPA (Singapore) and PDPO (Hong Kong).
Why You Will Love It Here
>
• You will be Reap's first Data Governance Manager, with the scope and budget to build the function properly.
• The requirement gives you an immediate, concrete, business-critical problem to solve from day one.
No ambiguity about where to start.
• You will work directly with the CISO with full exec visibility.
• We are an AI-first company. You will have access to AI tools and the space to use them to move faster.
Benefits you'll enjoy
>
A vibrant, inclusive work culture.
Annual leave to relax and recharge, plus public holidays.
Health insurance budget.
Be part of a fast‑growing global team.
Flexible remote work options.
Home office equipment budget.
Your own Corporate Reap Card-no more out‑of‑pocket spending.
>

Formally established in June 2022, the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)(HKUST(GZ)) is a cooperatively-run university between the Chinese mainland and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. HKUST(GZ) has obtained approval from the Ministry of Education (MoE) and become the first legally-independent educational institution co-established by the Mainland and Hong Kong since the announcement and implementation of the “Outline Development Plan for the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area” and the “Overall Plan for Deepening Globally Oriented Comprehensive Co-operation amongst Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao in Nansha of Guangzhou”. With a spirit of pioneering innovation, HKUST(GZ) charts new territories in cross-disciplinary education and explores new frontiers in pedagogies, aiming to serve as a role model of the mainland-Hong Kong integrated educational development and become a world-famous high-level university, endeavoring to nurture future-oriented, high-level and innovative talents.
In response to the increasingly complex challenges faced by the rapidly changing world, HKUST(GZ) adopts a brand-new and cross-disciplinary academic structure featuring “Hub” and “Thrust” to substitute the conventional one characterized by “school” and “department”, facilitating cross-disciplinary integration while vigorously developing emerging and frontier disciplines. title: International Pilates Master Instructor Trainer (國際普拉提 Master 培訓導師)
location: Tsim Sha Tsui, Yau Tsim Mong District
teaser: International Pilates Master Instructor Trainer - you will lead premier certifications, innovate evidence-based curricula, mentor aspiring trainers.
jd:
International Pilates Master Instructor Trainer
I. Professional Certification and Qualification Thresholds
· Highest-Level Certification: Hold internationally issued credentials as a "Certified Instructor Trainer" or "Master Mentor."
· Instructor Training Experience: Have fully led at least 10 cohorts of Teacher Training Programs (IT/Teacher Training) and successfully guided over 50 trainees to obtain internationally recognized coaching certifications.
II. Curriculum Development and System-Building Capabilities
· Syllabus Design: Possess the ability to independently compile training materials, establish assessment standards, and design teaching modules, with the flexibility to tailor training outlines according to organizational focus (e.g., rehabilitation-oriented, body sculpting, or athletic performance).
· Tiered Training Planning: Able to establish a "Train-the-Trainer Ladder System," clearly defining competency indicators and advancement pathways for teaching assistants, instructors, and master trainers.
III. Trainer Mentorship and Supervisory Functions (Train the Trainer)
· Teaching Methodology Instruction: Skilled in coaching prospective trainers in "instructional communication," "tactile cueing precision," and "classroom pacing control," providing systematic refinement through class observations, video playback reviews, and one-on-one feedback sessions.
· Simulated Assessments: Capable of designing scenario-based drills and emergency-response case studies (e.g., client injuries, movement plateaus) to evaluate trainee instructors' adaptability and professional decision-making.
· Teaching Quality Assurance: Establish KPI evaluation systems for trainers (e.g., trainee pass rates, satisfaction scores, injury complaint rates), and conduct periodic re-training and technique updates.
IV. Depth of Professional Knowledge
· Anatomy and Biomechanics: Possess advanced knowledge of functional anatomy, biomechanics, and motor neuroscience, with the ability to provide trainers with evidence-based guidance on "movement contraindications and alternative modifications" for special populations (e.g., prenatal/postnatal clients, post-surgical patients, scoliosis cases).
· Academic Integration: Able to incorporate the latest sports science research into training content, guiding trainers to develop an "evidence-based" teaching mindset.
V. Language and Communication Requirements
· Proficiency in English is required for reading and interpreting original professional literature, with the ability to support international exchanges or overseas training programs when necessary.
· Leadership Qualities: Demonstrate strong presentation skills and interpersonal influence, with the capability to lead internal teaching and research meetings, deliver public lectures, and conduct master workshops.
---
國際普拉提 Master 培訓導師
一、專業認證與資歷門檻
· 最高階認證：持有國際頒發之 “認證培訓導師”（Certified Instructor Trainer） 或 “大師級導師”（Master Mentor） 資格
· 導師培訓經歷：曾完整主導過10期以上 的師資培訓課程（IT/Teacher Training Program），並成功輔導50位以上 學員取得國際認證教練資格。
二、課程研發與體系建構能力
· 課綱設計：具備獨立編撰培訓教材、制定考核標準、設計教學模組的能力，能根據機構定位（如康復取向/體態雕塑/運動表現）調整培訓大綱。
· 分級培訓規劃：能建立 “培訓師階梯制”，明確區分助教、講師、主培訓師的能力指標與晉升路徑。
三、導師培育與督導職能（Train the Trainer）
· 教學技法傳授：擅長輔導準培訓師的 “教學表達力” 、“觸覺引導精準度” 與 “課堂節奏掌控” ，能透過觀課、錄影回放、一對一反饋進行系統性打磨。
· 模擬評核：能設計情境演練與突發狀況考題（如學員受傷、動作瓶頸），評估受訓導師的應變與專業決策力。
· 教學品質監控：建立培訓師的 KPI考核制度（如學員通過率、滿意度、受傷投訴率），定期進行教學複訓與技術更新。
四、專業知識縱深
· 解剖與力學：具備進階功能解剖學、生物力學與動作神經科學知識，能針對特殊族群（孕產、術後、脊椎側彎）給予培訓師 “動作禁忌與替代方案” 的教學指導。
· 學術銜接：能將最新運動科學研究融入培訓內容，引導培訓師建立 “實證導向” 的教學思維。
五、語文與溝通條件
·需具備流利英文，能閱讀並解析原版專業文獻，必要時可支援國際交流或海外培訓課程。
· 領導氣質：具備優秀的簡報力與影響力，能主持內部教研會議、公開講座與大師工作坊。
